# Senior Digital Marketing Manager

Finix Payments

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4560129074663814372?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=17758049&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6184321673406391925&crId=US_0US_0)

San FranciscoMarketing – Marketing /Full-time /On-siteAbout FinixFinix is building the global operating system for fintech, starting with payments. From startups to publicly traded companies, Finix processes tens of billions of dollars annually both in-store and online. Finix was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco.To date Finix has raised over $200M, including a $75M Series C led by Acrew Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners and backed by American Express Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Homebrew, Inspired Capital, Visa, and othersAbout the RoleWe're looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Manager who loves the craft of paid digital — someone who obsesses over performance data, isn't afraid to challenge assumptions, and gets genuine satisfaction from turning a good campaign into a great one. You'll own our paid programs end-to-end: strategy, execution, optimization, and reporting. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership and a real seat at the revenue table.Your Team:You'll join a collaborative marketing team and work cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Content/Creative. You'll report directly to the Head of Marketing and partner closely with the CEO on strategy and performance reviews. You won't be handed a playbook — you'll help write it.What you'll do: Own the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid digital campaigns across SEM, paid social, display, video, and remarketing — with a sharp focus on pipeline and revenue impactContinuously test and experiment: new channels, new ad formats, new messaging — if there's a better way, you'll find itWrite compelling direct response copy for ads and landing pages that actually convertBuild and present clear, honest performance narratives to the CEO and senior leadership — wins, losses, and what's nextPartner with Sales to align digital programs with the full customer lifecycle and maximize marketing ROIWork with Content and Creative to develop targeted experiences across key customer segmentsDesign and run A/B tests and segmentation strategies that systematically improve performanceManage budget and spend with Finance, keeping campaigns efficient and accountableMaintain and improve performance dashboards in partnership with Marketing and Revenue OpsWhat you bring: 5+ years managing B2B direct response digital marketing programs — SEM, paid social, remarketing, display/videoProven ability to launch and scale PPC campaigns with clear ROI; hands-on experience with CPM, CPC, and CPA media buyingFluency in web analytics, ad tracking, A/B testing, tag management, and CMS toolsExperience with HubSpot, LinkedIn Ads, and Google AdsStrong data instincts — you can dig into numbers, find the story, and communicate it clearly to any audienceA direct, open communicator who gives and receives feedback wellComfortable with ambiguity and energized by a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and initiative is rewardedWhat would make us excited:Experience at a hyper-growth B2B SaaS companyFamiliarity with revenue operations and attribution modelingBackground writing direct response or performance marketing copy$140,000 - $190,000 a yearFinix is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected class.Role: Senior Digital Marketing ManagerLevel: IC4+Location: San Francisco, CABase Salary Range: $140,000/yr to $190,000/yr + equity + benefitsOur salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries at our headquarters in San Francisco, California. Individual pay is determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

# Senior Digital Marketing Specialist

Full-time

The Automotive Marketing Group

[Baton Rouge, LA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Baton-Rouge%2C-LA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4442041146461559624?p=1&pos=0&rgn=19933&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2757547806431711431&crId=US_0US_0)

Applications MUST be sent directly on our site, LinkedIn applications will NOT be reviewed:

Headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, **The Automotive Marketing Group (AMG)** is a full-service advertising agency specializing in the automotive industry. We combine strategy, creative, media, analytics, and technology to help automotive clients grow in an increasingly complex digital landscape.

We are currently looking for an experienced **Sr. Digital Marketing Specialist** to join our team and grow with our company.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, technically capable, resourceful, and passionate about digital marketing. You should have significant hands-on experience developing digital advertising strategies, managing multiple clients and campaigns, analyzing performance data, optimizing toward measurable results, and staying ahead of changes across search, social, AI, analytics, and digital advertising.

This is a senior-level, hands-on position. You will work across multiple digital platforms while also communicating directly with, vendors, creative teams, and internal leadership.

Experience in the **automotive industry** is highly preferred, but we are also interested in candidates from other fast-paced, performance-driven industries who can bring strong digital marketing and analytics expertise to the role.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop, implement, manage, and optimize digital advertising strategies across **Google Ads, Meta, YouTube, Display, Digital Video, Email, Chat GPT and other digital platforms**
- **Build and optimize Google Search, Performance Max (PMAX), Display, YouTube, and other Google Ads campaigns**
- **Manage campaign budgets, pacing, bidding strategies, targeting, audiences, creative assets, and conversion goals**
- **Monitor campaign performance and continually test and optimize campaigns to improve conversions, cost efficiency, and overall results**
- **Assist with Search Engine Optimization (SEO)** initiatives
- Help develop and implement strategies surrounding **AI visibility, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and visibility within AI-powered search and answer platforms**
- **Stay current on emerging AI advertising opportunities and help evaluate, implement, and manage platforms such as ChatGPT Ads and other AI-driven advertising products**
- **Create, maintain, test, and troubleshoot website tags, pixels, conversions, and tracking implementations**
- **Work extensively with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific conversion tracking**
- **Develop and maintain custom events, key events, conversion actions, and measurement strategies, including Automotive Standards Council Events (ASC)**
- **Work with website providers and third-party vendors to troubleshoot tracking and conversion issues**
- **Monitor and analyze website traffic, user behavior, campaign attribution, and conversion performance**
- **Build reports and dashboards using GA4, Looker Studio, Google Ads, Meta, and other reporting platforms**
- **Translate campaign and analytics data into meaningful recommendations for clients**
- **Communicate directly with clients regarding campaign strategy, performance, opportunities, and recommendations**
- **Manage and evaluate digital vendors, including reviewing products, capabilities, tracking methodologies, performance, and integrations**
- **Stay current on legal, privacy, manufacturer, and automotive advertising compliance requirements**
- **Work closely with graphic designers and other creative team members to develop effective digital advertising assets**
- **Develop presentations and proposals for clients and prospective clients**
- **Manage multiple projects, clients, campaigns, and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail**
- **Continually research emerging digital marketing technologies, advertising platforms, measurement solutions, AI tools, and industry trends**

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Mass Communication, Advertising, Analytics, or a related field **or equivalent professional experience**
- **Approximately 4+ years of hands-on digital advertising and/or digital marketing experience preferred**
- **Advanced working knowledge of Google Ads** , including Search and **Performance Max (PMAX)**
- **Strong understanding of paid search strategy, keyword management, bidding strategies, audiences, conversion optimization, and campaign structure**
- **Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4)** and **Google Tag Manager**
- **Strong understanding of digital conversion tracking, attribution, tagging, pixels, events, and UTM parameters**
- **Experience analyzing campaign performance and making data-driven optimization recommendations**
- **Experience managing multiple campaigns, accounts, clients, and budgets simultaneously**
- **Strong organizational and project-management skills**
- **Excellent attention to detail**
- **Strong written and verbal communication skills**
- **Ability to clearly explain digital marketing performance and technical concepts**
- **Self-motivated, self-directed, and comfortable taking ownership of projects**
- **Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced agency environment**

**Preferred Experience**

**Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:**

- **Automotive digital marketing or automotive advertising**
- **Automotive Standards Council (ASC) Key Events** , including familiarity with automotive website conversion events, vendor integrations, and measurement
- **AI visibility / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**
- **ChatGPT Ads or other AI-platform advertising products**
- **Advanced Performance Max (PMAX)** campaign management and optimization
- Google Search Console
- Google Merchant Center
- Google Business Profile
- Meta Ads Manager
- YouTube advertising and YouTube Studio
- Looker Studio
- Advanced Google Tag Manager implementations
- Website conversion tracking and troubleshooting
- Vendor-side tracking integrations and third-party website technology
- Digital video, OTT/CTV, and programmatic advertising
- Adobe Creative Suite
- Experience evaluating and managing digital marketing vendors

Google Ads, Analytics, Microsoft Advertising, Meta, or other relevant industry certifications are a plus, but **demonstrated hands-on experience and the ability to produce results are more important than certifications alone.**

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who doesn’t simply launch campaigns and monitor dashboards. The right person wants to understand **why performance changed, how tracking works, where opportunities are being missed, and what we can do next to improve results.**

**You should be comfortable digging into data, troubleshooting technical issues, testing new strategies, learning new platforms, communicating with vendors, and presenting recommendations.**

**Because digital marketing continues to evolve rapidly – particularly with AI, automation, privacy, attribution, and search – we value candidates who are naturally curious and committed to continuing education.**

**Position Details**

- Full-time, **40-hour-per-week** position
- **On-site position in Baton Rouge, Louisiana**
- **Candidates currently located outside the Baton Rouge area must be willing to relocate**
- **Competitive compensation based on experience**
- **Benefits package available**
- **The Automotive Marketing Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer**
- **Please, no phone calls**

# Senior Paid Search Manager, Digital

Full-time

Realtime.

[Denver, CO](https://jooble.org/jobs/Denver%2C-CO)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1215008780986837776?p=1&pos=0&rgn=321&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8653321248726899026&crId=US_0US_0)

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Senior Paid Search (PPC) Manager is the central hub for digital campaign execution and operational performance across a portfolio of accounts. This role serves as the client’s key point of contact for all day-to-day Paid Search matters, ensuring flawless delivery of the Account Director’s high-level strategic focus and the Operational Lead’s channel strategy and best practices.

For small to mid-size clients, this role may operate as the primary channel contact for assigned channels, alongside operational executives. If you are a data-driven paid search expert who thrives on precision execution, client partnership, and continuous innovation, this role is for you.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- **Operational Client Liaison:** Serve as the primary client contact for all Paid Search campaign performance, reporting, timelines, and execution details.
- **Operational Excellence:** Oversee Paid Search channels and operational executives to ensure all campaigns are executed on time, on budget, and to the highest standard of quality, adhering to best practices and campaign KPIs.
- **Performance & Execution:** Act as the Paid Search operational expert, troubleshooting complex execution challenges and ensuring all campaign activities are aligned with strategy. Provide hands-on support for campaign optimization, testing, PCA, and other strategic needs. Establish innovation and testing roadmaps to ensure operational account growth.
- **Operational Efficiency:** Champion the use of proprietary AI technology to automate tasks and streamline workflows, maximizing operational efficiency.
- **Strategic Collaboration:** Partner closely with Account Directors to provide operational insights and data that inform strategic planning and effective measurement. Ensure tactical execution is viable and aligned with the client’s goals.
- **Team & Workflow Management:** Manage the flow of work and communication between the client and internal operational teams, ensuring briefs are clear and deliverables are met.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

- 2+ years of experience managing digital advertising campaigns in Paid Search, with proven hands-on execution and optimization across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.
- Experience in other channels such as Paid Social, Programmatic, Retail Media, and Affiliates is desirable.
- Proven track record of meeting digital campaign performance KPIs.
- Hands-on, in-platform campaign management experience.
- A working understanding of tracking, tagging, and measurement fundamentals (UTM tagging, Google Analytics, platform tracking).
- Excellent analytical skills with a data-first approach to campaign strategy, performance, optimization, and decision-making.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously to meet objectives and key deadlines.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience liaising directly with clients.
- Highly organized, adaptable, and comfortable working across diverse campaigns and channels.
- Ad platform certifications are a plus.

# Senior Performance Marketing Manager

$110k - $135k

Full-time

Liberty Home Guard

[Brooklyn, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/Brooklyn%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4546152967715710864?p=1&pos=0&rgn=32654&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6672088619530776780&crId=US_0US_0)

**Title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Paid Search, Paid Social, Video & Attribution)**

**The Impact You Will Have:**

Liberty Home Guard is the country's fastest-growing and best-rated home warranty provider, named U.S. News Best Home Warranty Company Overall for 2026-27. We are seeking a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own the strategy, execution, and measurement of our paid acquisition program across paid search (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), paid social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and similar platforms), digital video (YouTube), and Connected TV (CTV) bought programmatically through a demand-side platform. Paid search is the foundation of the program; CTV, paid social, and video are how we build demand above it, and multi-touch attribution is how we hold every channel to the same standard. This is a hands-on role for a marketer who is equally comfortable inside an ad account and inside a spreadsheet: someone who has managed substantial budgets, treats attribution and incrementality as core parts of the job rather than reporting afterthoughts, and stays ahead of a rapidly changing paid media landscape.

The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of experience managing Google Ads and Microsoft Ads campaigns, has bought and optimized Connected TV through a DSP, has run paid social and video campaigns, has successfully overseen six-figure monthly advertising budgets, and understands how to drive measurable growth while maintaining strong return on ad spend (ROAS). This person will also own our multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros) and will be the one the leadership team relies on to answer what is actually working. Home services or home warranty industry experience is a significant advantage.

The right candidate is both strategic and highly tactical: passionate about performance marketing, energized by testing and learning, and comfortable making data-driven decisions that directly affect business growth. You will manage the day-to-day optimization of campaigns across every paid channel and lead the larger strategic work of helping multiple service lines grow through paid media. In practice, you will be the marketing team's quantitative expert: the owner of how we measure, attribute, and evaluate every paid dollar we spend.

**Your duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:**

- Develop, execute, and optimize paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other relevant platforms.
- Manage monthly paid media budgets exceeding $100,000 across search, social, and video while maximizing lead quality, conversion volume, and return on investment.
- Create and execute campaign strategies across multiple service lines, geographic markets, and business objectives.
- Continuously monitor campaign performance, identifying opportunities to improve CTR, Quality Score, conversion rates, CPL, CPA, and ROAS.
- Conduct ongoing keyword research, competitive analysis, audience segmentation, and bidding optimization.
- Build and test ad copy, creative, landing page recommendations, audience strategies, and campaign structures through disciplined A/B and holdout testing.
- Analyze performance data using Hyros, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and other reporting tools.
- Stay current on emerging search trends, AI-driven search experiences, automation, Performance Max, changes in Google's advertising ecosystem, developments across paid social and streaming video platforms, and evolving best practices.
- Collaborate with SEO, creative, web development, sales, and leadership teams to ensure integrated digital marketing strategies.
- Produce clear reporting and actionable insights for leadership with recommendations for continued growth.
- Ensure accurate conversion tracking, offline and phone-sale conversion imports, attribution, and campaign measurement across all paid channels.
- Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), extending to TikTok, Pinterest, and similar platforms as the business warrants.
- Plan, launch, and optimize digital video campaigns on YouTube, including audience definition, creative sequencing, and view-through and search-lift measurement.
- Own our Connected TV program end to end: manage buys through our CTV demand-side platform partner, define household and geographic targeting against our customer profile, set reach and frequency goals, manage publisher and app inventory mix, rotate and test creative, and control pacing and spend.
- Measure CTV on incrementality rather than platform attribution: design and read geo holdouts and ghost-bid tests, track branded search and direct traffic lift on a lag, reconcile vendor readouts against our own CRM and analytics data, and make scale, hold, or pause recommendations on that evidence.
- Own our multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros): maintain the tracking implementation and cost-data integrations, audit data integrity, and produce journey-level reporting on cost per acquisition, ROAS, and lead-to-sale conversion by channel.
- Design and run incrementality tests (geo holdouts, ghost bids, platform lift studies) for upper-funnel channels, and distinguish true incremental contribution from platform-attributed results before budget decisions are made.
- Build and maintain the weekly and monthly paid performance reporting framework for leadership, and serve as the team's quantitative authority on what is working, what is not, and why.
- Manage relationships with media platforms, agency partners, and measurement vendors, and evaluate new channel and vendor proposals against a consistent measurement standard.

**Requirements:**

- 5+ years of hands-on PPC/Paid Search experience managing performance marketing campaigns.
- Proven success managing monthly paid media budgets of $100,000+.
- Deep expertise with Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and Meta Ads Manager.
- Strong understanding of bidding strategies, attribution models and their limitations, incrementality measurement, audience targeting, conversion optimization, and campaign automation.
- Experience managing campaigns across multiple brands, business units, or service lines simultaneously.
- Exceptional analytical skills, with the statistical judgment to separate real performance changes from noise and turn data into decisions.
- Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets for modeling and analysis, including building auditable, formula-driven reports.
- Excellent communication and project management skills.
- Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
- Hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns, Meta at minimum, with TikTok or Pinterest a plus.
- Hands-on experience planning, buying, and optimizing Connected TV campaigns through a demand-side platform (for example Vibe, The Trade Desk, StackAdapt, MNTN, or comparable), including household targeting, frequency management, inventory selection, and creative rotation.
- Working understanding of how CTV is measured: view-through and impression-to-visit attribution, branded search and direct traffic lift, geo holdout and lift-study design, and the limits of platform-reported results.
- Experience managing YouTube or other digital video campaigns alongside search and social.
- Experience implementing and operating a multi-touch attribution platform (Hyros, Northbeam, Triple Whale, or comparable), including pixel and server-side tracking and cost-data integrations.
- Experience designing or interpreting incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies) and communicating results clearly to non-technical leadership.

**Preferred (nice to have):**

- Home services or home warranty marketing experience strongly preferred (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, restoration, pest control, garage doors, landscaping, etc.).
- Experience generating high-volume lead generation campaigns.
- Familiarity with CRM integrations, call tracking platforms, and offline conversion tracking, particularly for phone-led sales models.
- Experience with Local Services Ads (LSAs).
- Experience with AI-powered campaign optimization tools and automation workflows.
- Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for data analysis.
- Experience running CTV alongside a brand search program and quantifying the relationship between the two.
- Familiarity with CTV and streaming inventory sources (Hulu, Tubi, Pluto TV, Roku, Sling, Peacock and similar) and their audience profiles.
- Experience producing or briefing 15- and 30-second video creative for TV and streaming placements.
- Familiarity with media mix modeling or marketing econometrics.

**Pay Rate:** $110K - $135K annually.

# Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Part-time/Hourly)

Navan

[Austin, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Austin%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/239569977924253088?p=1&pos=0&rgn=47831&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1108520130657794317&crId=US_0US_0)

Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Part-time/Hourly) Location: Austin, TX; Remote (USA)
Department: Marketing
We are looking for a high-energy Senior Performance Marketing Manager to join us as a dedicated contractor. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Digital Demand Generation, you will be the driving force behind our performance on high-intent and community-driven channels. You aren't just "managing" ads; you are owning the pipeline generated from Reddit, X, and our primary review platforms (G2, Capterra). We need a "plug-and-play" expert who moves fast, thrives in a high-growth environment, and requires zero ramp-up time to deliver impact.
This role is an hourly, part-time Navan employee and will be expected to work 25-30 hours / week.
**What You’ll Do:**
Channel Ownership: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of paid campaigns across Reddit, X (Twitter), and B2B Review Sites (G2, Capterra).
Creative Velocity: Partner closely with the creative team to develop platform-native assets. You’ll proactively manage creative refreshes to combat ad fatigue and ensure our brand cuts through the noise.
Review Site execution : Execution and management of paid placements and lead generation on review platforms including G2 and Capterra.
Strategic Optimization: Go beyond clicking buttons. You will analyze full funnel metrics and buyer Intent signals to adjust budget and bidding strategies and pivot spend toward high-converting campaigns in real-time.
Account Hygiene & QA: Maintain obsessive attention to detail regarding tracking links, UTMs, and lead flow. You will perform regular audits to ensure zero "attribution leaks" between platforms and Salesforce.
Performance Reporting: Deliver weekly "Winner/Loser" reports and monthly QBRs. We value insights over data dumps—your reports must focus on lead conversion and pipeline impact, not just vanity metrics like impressions.
**What We’re Looking For:**
5+ Years of Experience: Proven track record in Paid Media or Performance Marketing, specifically within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience building and scaling campaigns within Reddit Ads and X Ads Manager . You know the nuances of these communities and how to convert them.
Review Site Mastery: Deep knowledge of managing bids and lead-gen programs on G2 and Capterra
Technical Proficiency: Expert-level proficiency in Asana, Jira, and Google Products . You must be comfortable navigating Salesforce to track lead lifecycle and attribution.
Scrappy & Self-Directed: You are a proactive problem solver who doesn't wait for a brief to optimize a failing campaign.
Experience with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) platforms and strategies.
About Navan
Navan (Nasdaq: NAVN) is the leading all-in-one business travel , payments, and expense management platform that makes travel easy for frequent travelers. From finding flights and hotels to automating expense reconciliation, with 24/7 support along the way, Navan delivers an intuitive experience travelers love and finance teams rely on. See how Navan customers benefit and learn more at navan.com .
Culture of Excellence
Our team is our competitive edge — a high-performance group of smart, driven people committed to winning together. This dedication to excellence is why we’ve been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built In (2023–2026), a G2 Best Global Software Company (2025-2026), a CNBC Disruptor 50 (2022-2025), and a Forbes Fintech 50 (2022-2025). At Navan, we provide an environment where top talent excels, offering the autonomy and fast-paced trajectory needed to build a defining career and do the best work of your life.
Navan offers a comprehensive benefits program designed to support your well-being, financial security, and life outside of work. Our benefits, thoughtfully tailored by country to meet local needs, include healthcare coverage, insurance offerings, and wellness resources for you and your family.
We support long-term financial growth through retirement savings programs and opportunities to participate in our equity plans, so you can share in Navan’s success. To promote balance, we offer flexible time off, country-specific holidays, and paid parental leave for all new parents. Additional benefits include connectivity and commuting support, mental health resources, and exclusive travel-related perks. Wherever you’re based, our benefits evolve with you.
Workplace Policy
Navan believes in the value of in-person connections, whether that’s sitting down to have lunch with one another, taking a walking 1:1, or collaborating in a room together. The connections forged through face-to-face interactions improve company culture and drive business results. Navan invests in global office spaces — in the U.S., Europe, and Asia, among others — that feel welcoming. In-office perks such as company-provided lunches and happy hours create a strong team environment to help you do your best work. Our employees work from the office four days a week. Please expect this policy for all roles that are tied to an office.
Navan is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the bases of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We prohibit any such discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.
Accommodations
Navan complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local law. Navan will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability in connection with applications for employment as required by law.

Job Search Best Practices
We have been made aware of recruitment scams involving fraudulent attemptsto lure job seekers into sending money or personal information in returnfor fake job offers or coerce them into purchasing equipment by electronicfunds transfer (Zelle, Venmo, etc.) Legitimate Navan recruiters will neverask for money in any recruitment or onboarding activities. # Senior Digital Advertising Manager

Full-time

Fire Department Coffee

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4260835294984473152?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6711033315537209493&crId=US_0US_0)

**About the Role**
**The Senior Digital Advertising Manager will lead Fire Department Coffee’s retail media strategy and execution, with a primary focus on Walmart Connect and a secondary focus on advertising for our Amazon 1P business. This is a hands-on role responsible for planning and managing campaigns, budgets, and testing across key retail media platforms. The manager will use performance data to improve campaign efficiency, grow sales, and identify new opportunities. Must have Walmart Connect experience to be considered.**
**Responsibilities**

**- Develop retail media plans and budget recommendations based on business goals, retailer priorities, product performance, and promotional calendars.**
**- Lead day-to-day strategy and execution in Walmart Connect, our primary retail media channel, whilst aligning with the JBP.**
**- Manage Amazon Ads for the Amazon 1P Vendor Central business as a secondary area of responsibility.**
**- Build, launch, monitor, and optimize sponsored search, display, and DSP campaigns, with a focus on Walmart Connect and Amazon.**
**- Manage supporting retail media activity across Meijer, H-E-B, Criteo, and other relevant channels.**
**- Monitor campaign pacing, bids, budgets, sales, ROAS, ACOS, TACoS, new-to-brand performance, and other relevant KPIs.**
**- Make timely in-platform adjustments to budgets, bids, keywords, audiences, targeting, and campaign structure.**
**- Create regular performance reports that communicate findings, actions taken, and recommendations.**
**- Develop and run a test-and-learn plan covering campaign structure, bidding, targeting, audiences, and creative where platform tools allow.**
**- Apply test results and performance trends to improve campaign efficiency and sales over time.**
**- Coordinate media support for promotions, new product launches, seasonal events, and key retailer programs.**
**- Work with marketing and creative teams to provide clear briefs and improve assets used in retail media campaigns.**

**Qualifications**

**- 8+ years of hands-on retail media or performance marketing experience, preferably with a CPG, food, beverage, or consumer brand.**
**- Direct Walmart Connect experience is required, including hands-on campaign management and optimization.**
**- Experience managing advertising for an Amazon 1P Vendor Central business is required; this is a secondary focus of the role.**
**- Experience building and optimizing sponsored search and display campaigns.**
**- Experience with DSP or programmatic campaigns.**
**- Experience managing substantial advertising budgets and making decisions based on performance data.**
**- Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of ROAS, ACOS, TACoS, incrementality, and retail media measurement.**
**- Experience with Criteo and other retail media networks is preferred.**
**- Experience with Meijer and/or H-E-B media platforms is a plus.**
**- CTV experience is a plus, but not required.**

**What success looks like**

**- Walmart Connect campaigns are built, managed, and optimized directly in-platform, with Amazon 1P campaigns managed as a secondary focus.**
**- Retail media budgets are created, monitored, and updated to support business goals and retailer priorities.**
**- Campaigns meet agreed ROAS targets, with performance reviewed regularly and adjustments made when results fall short.**
**- Successful campaigns are scaled thoughtfully to grow sales while maintaining efficient returns.**
**- Walmart Connect performance improves over time, Amazon 1P performance is managed effectively, and additional retail media channels are supported.**
**- A practical test-and-learn plan is active, with results guiding ongoing optimization.**
**- Campaign plans account for promotions, product content, and inventory availability, in coordination with the relevant teams.**
**- Leadership receives clear, regular updates on budget pacing, performance, risks, and opportunities.**

- Plan, launch, and optimize **direct response campaigns** across platforms (Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, Native, etc.)

- Analyze performance data daily and make rapid optimization decisions

 - Home services

 - CPL optimization
 - Funnel metrics (CTR, CVR, CPA, LTV)
 - A/B testing frameworks
- Ability to **work cross-functionally with creative teams** to consistently develop and launch **high-performing ad concepts**
- Strong creative intuition backed by data (you know why ads win, not just that they win)
- Hands-on experience with platforms like:
 - Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram)
 - Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube)
 - Native (Taboola/Outbrain) is a plus
- Experience working with **lead gen funnels + CRM systems**
- Data-driven mindset with the ability to make decisions fast

### **What Success Looks Like**

- You can **take a campaign from testing to scale quickly**
- You consistently hit or beat **target CPLs**
- You proactively generate and test **new creative angles that drive performance**
- You bring structure and predictability to lead generation at scale

 - Lead volume

# Senior Paid Media Manager

Full-time

TruVolt Brands

[Jersey City, NJ](https://jooble.org/jobs/Jersey-City%2C-NJ)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6416493519933281371?p=1&pos=0&rgn=30392&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8723507296438415658&crId=US_0US_0)

We're a consumer products company that owns and manages a portfolio of nationally recognized brands, and we're aiming to reach $500 million in revenue this year. Our products cover e-mobility, consumer electronics, outdoor power equipment, lawn and garden, cleaning and more, with global operations.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Paid Media Manager to run and scale our paid advertising for our Joe brands: Snow Joe®, Sun Joe®, Aqua Joe® and Auto Joe®. You know paid media inside and out! Campaign setup, tracking, testing and optimization across Google, Meta and TikTok. You build and run campaigns yourself, not through an agency, and you can explain exactly what you did and why it worked.

You'll own paid media performance across our DTC site, ShopJoe.com, and our social channels. That means planning budgets, launching and optimizing campaigns, making sure tracking is accurate, and turning data into clear decisions. You'll work closely with our Digital Marketing, Creative and Sales/Data teams, and you understand how paid media connects to inventory, promotions and the rest of the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Plan, build and manage paid campaigns across Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube), Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok.

- Own paid media budgets, pacing and forecasting to hit revenue and ROAS goals.

- Set up and maintain conversion tracking, pixels, server-side tracking, UTMs and attribution so results are accurate.

- Analyze performance daily and weekly, and optimize bids, budgets, audiences and creative based on the data.

- Run structured creative and audience tests, and share what's working with the creative team.

- Write clear creative briefs and give practical feedback on ad creative and landing pages.

- Align campaigns with product launches, seasonal demand, promotions and inventory levels.

- Build weekly and monthly reports with clear insights, actions and expected impact.

- Use AI tools and platform automation to work faster and improve results.

- Partner with the Digital Marketing, Creative, E-commerce and Sales/Data teams on full-funnel strategy.

- Stay current on platform changes, new ad products and best practices.

**Qualifications**

- 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience managing Google, Meta and TikTok campaigns directly, not only through agencies.

- A track record of growing revenue and improving ROAS for an e-commerce or DTC brand.

- Strong knowledge of conversion tracking, pixels, server-side tracking, UTMs and attribution.

- Strong analytical skills with Google Analytics (GA4), platform dashboards and Excel/Google Sheets.

- Experience running structured creative and audience tests.

- Able to explain campaign setup, decisions and results clearly and simply.

- Experience managing significant monthly ad budgets.

- Experience with Shopify and DTC consumer products is a strong plus.

- Experience with Amazon Ads or TikTok Shop GMV Max is a plus.

- Experience with outdoor tools or home and garden products is a plus.

# Senior Paid Media Manager

Optimal CAE

[Austin, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Austin%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7126943736434095834?p=1&pos=0&rgn=47831&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4849484123495390779&crId=US_0US_0)

**About The Role**

Optimal is looking for an ambitious and experienced digital marketing professional to join our team! The Senior Paid Media Manager will drive new strategies and improve performance across paid channels. They'll own the client relationship for some of our largest accounts and work closely with our Paid Media Director and other senior leadership to create and deliver client strategy presentations.

A high level of expertise in digital advertising is expected, along with a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate performance towards key KPIs and produce impactful insights from data. The ideal candidate is always looking to adopt new techniques and test new media channels to ensure maximum ROI for our clients. This candidate will help grow our clients' businesses while also acting as a trusted internal resource on paid media strategy.

**Who Are We?**

Optimal is a performance marketing agency on a mission, bringing together the best data, technology, and people to achieve our clients' marketing goals. Brand, campaign, or cause: we maximize performance at every moment.

We are not only digital media strategists - we're award-winning industry leaders, with deep knowledge spanning all things digital: from advertising and paid media, to marketing and communications, to audience data and analytics, we deliver for our clients.

Everyone at Optimal has the opportunity to learn, grow, and progress. Through our proprietary training programs, we provide our team members with the personal and professional development they need to achieve advancement at any stage in their careers.

We're always looking for exceptional people to join our team. If this sounds like you, please apply!

**Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities:**

- **Account Ownership and Client Relationship Management** \- Own and build client relationships with top-tier accounts. Opportunity to travel to clients for QBRs.
- **Reporting** \- Work with the internal analytics team to develop reports that clearly communicate performance to suggest insights and identify opportunities.
- **Analysis** \- Dive deep into account KPIs and trends to identify shifts, areas of opportunity, and potential optimizations.
- **Collaboration** **and Team Management** \- Work closely with the Paid Media Director and leadership team to develop new and ongoing account strategies. Oversee the development of paid media specialists and interface with various internal teams such as our business intelligence, business development, PPC, SEO, and creative teams.
- **Creative Ideation** \- Guide the creative team and test variations of creative assets needed to determine highest-performing creative and ad copy.
- **Strategy** \- Work with clients to plan and allocate budgets across top performing channels. Identify opportunities to test new channels, ad types, & audiences.
- **Work with industry experts and vendors** \- Enhance agency relationships with vendors to fully use their capabilities and recommend strategies and solutions that best meet our business needs.

**Minimum Qualifications & Skill Requirements:**

- 5+ years of full-time, professional PPC experience, including 2+ years of hands-on campaign buildout & optimization
- Consistent track record and hands-on experience handling high campaign volume, large budgets, complex strategies across multiple Paid Search and Paid Social channels and driving quantifiable results.
- Superior ability to analyze data in Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads or other analytics platforms.
- Experience with Display or Programmatic advertising is also a plus.
- Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint.
- Best-in-class communication skills, both written and verbal.
- 4-year Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, advertising, statistics, analytics, or a related field is a plus.

**Optimal is proud to offer the following:**

- Flexible Time Off
- Paid Leave for New Parents
- Health insurance (including dental and vision)
- Flex Spending Plan
- Employee Assistance Program
- 401K with company matching
- Tuition Reimbursement
- Professional development opportunities
- Rewards and recognition programs
- And so much more!

**Office Hours**

This role is based out of our Austin office. Our Austin team works on a hybrid basis, with three days per week working in the office and two days per week working from home. Work hours are consistently 9:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M., Monday - Friday, with the expectation that evening and weekend work will be required as necessary.

# Senior Paid Media Manager

$80k - $87k

Workshop Digital

[Richmond, VA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Richmond%2C-VA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-276660333930918513?p=1&pos=0&rgn=2986&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2018030963222874442&crId=US_0US_0)

We are looking for 1 remote employee in one of 7 states (CA, TX, VA, NY, IL, CO, NC), or 1 hybrid employee located in Richmond, VA.

Workshop Digital is a results-oriented digital marketing agency based in Richmond, Virginia, committed to building strong, lasting partnerships with our clients. For over a decade, we’ve championed transparency and collaboration to deliver measurable results that help businesses grow.

We act as an extension of our clients’ marketing teams, developing customized digital marketing strategies aligned with their unique goals and services.

Our team of experienced digital marketing analysts works side-by-side with clients to gain a deeper understanding of their business, industry, and competitors. By identifying ideal target audiences and uncovering what sets our clients apart, we help their brands stand out and achieve meaningful, measurable impact.

The Senior Paid Media Manager, reporting to the Director of Paid Media, works on medium‑enterprise level clients. They will:

Develop strategies and tactics that support client goals and drive strong paid digital marketing performance

Build and maintain stronger, deeper client relationships with day‑to‑day contacts to ensure high client retention and growth

Troubleshoot minor to complicated client issues

Implement and test new capabilities to enable client growth

In addition, a Senior Paid Media Manager may be asked to train new hires on basic concepts and lead internal account teams.

Responsibilities
Overview

Develop, execute, manage and report on paid media strategies that support client goals and drive strong paid media marketing performance

Build and maintain strong, deep client relationships with day‑to‑day contacts and senior stakeholders to ensure high client retention and growth

Strategically build, manage, and optimize client paid digital marketing accounts across Google Ads, Google Display Network, YouTube, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Programmatic, and other paid digital marketing channels

Actively manage and seek ways to improve account performance

Generate new quarterly content encompassing blog posts, webinars, internal presentations, or other multimedia formats

Enhance client relationships through a comprehensive understanding of their strategic growth objectives, ensuring long‑term client retention

Create a test hypothesis and implement landing page optimization tests to improve conversion rates

Lead junior analysts on joint accounts

Help create and execute educational initiatives for the paid media team, such as developing internal resources and training sessions

Provide support for client services deliverables during the sales process for upsells and new business

Client Communication and Relationships

Develop strong relationships with clients and identify senior stakeholders

Attend and participate in all meetings and calls with clients

Communicate effectively with various audiences, with support for some clients

Create and present insightful, meaningful, accurate reports and analyses with minimal support

Execute the Workshop Digital client flag process and proactively identify resolutions

Go the extra mile for assigned clients within the scope of the SOW

Internal Communication and Relationships

Proactively seek and gracefully accept feedback

Tactfully share feedback with colleagues

Immediately inform the Director of Paid Media of any concerns or issues from clients when appropriate

Inform the Director of Paid Media of any updates, concerns, or potential points of interest from within the digital marketing community

May participate in the interview process

Support special projects

Business Development

Identify new opportunities for clients to meet their business goals

Identify opportunities for potential case studies and coordinate with marketing for case study development, with some management support

Manage beta tests of new services for the client set

Elevate client requests for SOW changes with some support

Training

Provide feedback on training content

Develop basic training content with QA

Occasionally conduct basic team trainings to help develop team expertise

Read industry blogs, books, whitepapers, and articles to stay current on relevant tactics, updates, and best practices

Occasionally contribute thought leadership content to the Workshop Digital blog and the industry

Channel Management

Manage paid digital marketing accounts across Google Ads, Google Display Network, YouTube, and other paid digital marketing channels with minimal support

Strategically build, manage, and optimize client‑paid digital marketing accounts with minimal support

Perform keyword and audience research to optimize accounts and influence creative decisions with minimal support

Actively manage and seek ways to improve account performance and diversify client budgets to maximize results with minimal support

Create and prioritize strategies and supporting tactics that embody clients’ business goals with minimal support

Meet and exceed client expectations and set KPIs with minimal support

Set up and review Google Analytics (and any other third‑party tracking software) with minimal support

Identify potential threats, changes in landscape, industry updates, and potential opportunities for client accounts, and present these to clients with minimal support

Conduct ongoing tests that drive towards growth and achieving client goals with minimal support

Temporarily take on extra client hours to support the team during times of limited bandwidth

Qualifications

4+ years of demonstrated agency experience with clients, with respect to:

Building strong relationships

Prioritizing workload with some support

Creating insightful, actionable, and accurate insights for client strategies and reports with some support

Presenting data and insights in a way that is logical, clear, and actionable, with some support

Creating effective meeting agendas and leading client meetings with some support

Delivering basic training

Logging assigned client hours worked

Meeting deadlines

Proven track record of managing a full client workload consisting of medium and large clients

Courteous written, verbal, and visual communication skills

Strong analytical capabilities, but may need support for advanced analysis and insights

Occasionally provides basic training to other team members

Proactively expand basic knowledge base by doing solo research/learning, asking peers to shadow, asking for support projects, etc.

Understands and supports leadership vision/decisions

May identify and/or support the implementation of initiatives that push the team forward

Intermediate‑level skills in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, particularly in Excel and Google Sheets

Benefits

Competitive salaries

25 days PTO, 5 days STO, 12 Holidays

Hybrid workspace for Richmonders (only Mondays are required)

3 months fully paid Parental Leave

8 hours of paid volunteer time per quarter

401k with 3% non‑elective contributions

A comprehensive health benefit package, including 2 medical plans, dental, and vision insurance

Life insurance, short‑term, and long‑term disability

Profit sharing

2x a year company‑wide meetup in Richmond, VA

Committee Membership (Community, Culture, Health & Wellness)

Awards

1x US Search Awards – Best Small PPC Agency

8x Outside Best Places to Work

8x Virginia Business Best Places to Work

3x Search Engine Land Finalist

# Senior Paid Media Manager

Element Three

[Carmel, IN](https://jooble.org/jobs/Carmel%2C-IN)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6364402183048097713?p=1&pos=0&rgn=14446&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3826898031940641567&crId=US_0US_0)

WHAT ARE WE ALL ABOUT AT ELEMENT THREE?

Element Three is a full-service agency that bridges the gap for businesses in the dealer distribution model. We go beyond the obvious, bringing campaigns to life with big ideas, building brand strategies, telling stories, and creating meaningful marketing.

Our purpose is to “foster growth in people and business so they can change the world.” The team at Element Three takes this mission seriously, and it is manifest in everything we do. We make good brands great. We are accountable for delivering results on our strategies. Every single time. What does this mean for you? You will join a team of tenacious, hard-working pros who excel in what they do and lift each other along the way.

Role: Senior Paid Media Manager

As a Senior Paid Media Manager, you are a trusted expert in paid media strategy and execution, demand generation, and building brand awareness for our clients. The client and the team look to you to guide the strategy and help PMMs and PMAs develop paid media programs across multiple campaigns, channels, and platforms throughout the purchase funnel to achieve business goals. You operate systematically and use data to guide your decisions. You have the space to be proactive in your approach and seek to identify untapped opportunities for our clients. In essence, you are the force that maximizes media impact and is accountable for media program performance for our clients. Your background includes campaign creation, execution, and optimization, and now you operate at an expert level across digital platforms.

To land this gig, you need:

3-5 years of digital or traditional paid media experience and 2 years of agency experience

Sound business acumen and client presentation skills

A deep understanding of paid digital marketing channels, tactics, and strategies, and how they work together to provide a seamless customer experience

Experience across a diverse and expanding ecosystem of digital advertising platforms, analytics tools, and reporting solutions, including Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing), Meta, LinkedIn Ads, demand-side platforms (DSPs), X (Twitter), Pinterest, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, etc.

A data-first mindset that emphasizes media forecasting and aligning media plans against client business KPIs (leads, traffic, sales, etc.)

Experience in developing success metrics for campaigns and the ability to analyze and report on campaign progress and optimization recommendations

Demonstrate subject matter expertise by understanding key industry trends and emerging technology to provide informed thought leadership POVs from E3

This job might be right for you if:

You are strategic and use data to make decisions. You have integrity and a strong work ethic. You are confident and stand your ground with poise and respect.

You are solutions-oriented and great at solving problems. You are a critical thinker who is focused on results.

You are persuasive and an expert at navigating difficult conversations. You communicate effectively and get buy-in. You can explain almost anything to anyone.

You are curious, and you ask questions. You seek clarity amid ambiguity. You have an unflagging pursuit of excellence with a desire to learn.

You are adaptable and positive in the face of adversity. You love the challenge of an ever-changing environment.

As a Senior Paid Media Manager a typical week might look something like this:

Review recent campaign performance and collaborate with PMMs and PMAs to make optimization recommendations based on trends you’re seeing in the data.

Lead reporting calls with clients about paid media's impact on their business. You are their go-to expert for accountability on ad dollars.

Collaborate with a Senior Digital Marketing Manager on a full-funnel marketing strategy for an existing client. Outline where digital media overlaps and supports traditional media and other channels, and how it helps.

Create a presentation that identifies an opportunity or gap within a current client’s media strategy and provides a comprehensive solution to the problem.

Assist a Consultant with pitching a new project to a client.

Brainstorm ways to gain efficiencies in an active campaign without increasing spend, and work with a Project Manager and your paid media team to kick off your ideas.

Develop a paid media plan for a new client. In collaboration with the PMMs and PMAs, you’ll create a media plan recommending the right channels, platforms, and audiences that will expand brand awareness.

Support campaign builds directly within ad platforms as needed, scaling your hands-on involvement to the size and complexity of the account.

Record a video on behalf of E3 that clarifies our POV on an industry topic.

Full-time

Cantrell Schuette, Employment, Franchise & Injury Lawyers

[Tampa, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Tampa%2C-FL)

**Company Description** Cantrell Schuette is a Tampa-based law firm dedicated to correcting injustice. Our niches inclide protecting franchisee rights, employee rights, and personal injury. The firm offers a supportive environment for legal and non-legal professionals who want to contribute to meaningful, impact-driven work.

**Role Description** The Senior SEO Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role based in Tampa, FL. This role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive SEO strategies to increase organic visibility, qualified traffic, and lead generation for the firm’s practice areas.

Day-to-day responsibilities include performing keyword research, optimizing on-page content and metadata, managing technical SEO initiatives, and improving site architecture and internal linking. The Senior SEO Specialist will monitor rankings and performance metrics, analyze data, and prepare reports with actionable insights for leadership and marketing teams. The role also involves collaborating on content planning, coordinating with external vendors when needed, and staying current with search engine algorithm updates and best practices in legal industry SEO. Preference for experience eith digital ads too, including Google, Facebook, Instagram, and AI.

**Qualifications**

- Candidates should possess strong skills in keyword research, on-page optimization, and content optimization.
- Candidates should possess skills in technical SEO, including site audits, crawl and index management, page speed optimization, and structured data implementation.
- Candidates should possess skills in analytics and reporting, including use of tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms (e.g., SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz).
- Candidates should possess skills in link-building strategy, competitive analysis, and organic traffic growth initiatives.
- Candidates should possess skills in cross-functional collaboration, communicating SEO recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders, and aligning SEO with broader marketing goals.
- Relevant experience in SEO within professional services, legal, or similar regulated industries is beneficial.
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and thrive in a hybrid work environment is expected.

# Senior Ad Operations Specialist, B2B Paid Media (Contract, US or Canada) \| $70K-$85K

$70k - $85k

Speedwork Social

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8944791194787421004?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-746114727983329653&crId=US_0US_0)

US or Canada · 1099 contract, ~40 hrs/week · $5,800 to $7,100/month retainer ($70K to $85K/year)

Speedwork Social is a specialist B2B paid media agency. We run LinkedIn, Google and Meta ads for B2B software and technology companies, and we take LinkedIn Ads more seriously than anyone else. Our founder, Anthony Blatner, is a Top 50 LinkedIn Certified Marketing Expert, a LinkedIn Learning instructor, and host of LinkedIn Ads Radio.

We’re hiring a Senior Ad Operations Specialist to build, launch and report on campaigns across our client accounts. You make sure every campaign goes live right, on time, and stays clean, so our account leads can focus on clients and strategy.

What the work actually looks like

Building and launching campaigns in LinkedIn, Google and Meta from the account plan.

Uploading audiences and lists, adjusting bids and budgets, and resetting budgets each month.

Setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking: LinkedIn Insight Tag, Google Tag Manager, Zapier.

Pulling weekly performance into our reports and Looker Studio dashboards, and flagging what changed.

Digging into spreadsheets and client CRM data to find the trends that improve performance.

Using AI to run bulk operations and bulk analysis: building and editing campaigns at scale, and working through large exports across accounts.

Writing first-draft ad copy variations from a brief.

QA-ing every build against our launch checklist before it goes live.

This is an in-the-platform role. You’ll join some client calls to listen and learn, but our account leads run them.

The three things you must be excellent at

Accuracy. You build to spec: naming conventions, UTMs, exclusions, conversion events, budgets. You catch the error before it goes live. A wrong exclusion or an untracked conversion costs a client real money.

Speed and reliability. You turn tasks around quickly, hit deadlines, and nobody has to chase you.

Clear reporting. You pull the numbers, notice what moved, and tell the account lead in plain language.

You’re probably a fit if

You have 3-5 years hands-on in paid social and paid search, and you’re an expert in LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads and Meta Ads. Hands-on means you were the one in the account.

You really enjoy digging into spreadsheets and CRMs, and finding the trends that improve performance.

You use AI tools every day to work faster, especially for bulk edits and analysis.

You’re comfortable in reporting tools like Looker Studio.

You write clean, clear ad copy.

You follow paid media closely and you’re active on LinkedIn.

You’re responsive on Slack and you don’t go quiet when things get busy.

You’re based in the United States or Canada.

You’re probably not a fit if

You want to lead client meetings and set strategy from day one. There’s room to grow into that here, but this role starts in the accounts.

Speed matters more to you than getting the details right.

You don’t enjoy being heads down and digging through spreadsheets.

How success is measured

Campaigns launch on time and error-free against the launch checklist.

Weekly reports are accurate, on time, and call out what changed.

Tasks are turned around within agreed deadlines, without follow-up.

Compensation and details

$5,800 to $7,100/month retainer (about $70,000 to $85,000/year), based on experience. Paid in USD.

1099 contract, about 40 hours/week, remote.

You’ll work within our established process using ClickUp, Slack, Looker Studio, Zapier and Claude.

How we hire
An online application with a short skills check, an intro call, then a live working session where you build and QA a campaign with us. Then a walk through your work history and reference calls with former managers.

# Senior Media Buyer

Full-time

Marshall Advertising

[Tampa, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Tampa%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/60845018433504349?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9438&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8793122379511588746&crId=US_0US_0)

Marshall Advertising, one of Florida’s largest independent media buying agencies, is seeking an experienced Senior Media Buyer to join our team in Tampa.

Our nationally recognized agency works with clients across diverse industries, including Fortune 500 companies, in more than 50 markets nationwide. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of complex campaigns, contribute to media strategy, and work alongside experienced media professionals.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of media buying and planning experience, preferably across a broad range of markets and market sizes. You’ll manage multiple stages of the media buying process—from strategy, planning, and negotiation to trafficking, performance monitoring, reporting, reconciliation, and billing. You should be comfortable managing a high volume of campaigns and significant client budgets while balancing deadlines, maintaining accuracy, and providing thoughtful recommendations.

AI, automation, and modern tools are part of how we work. We’re looking for buyers who are curious about new technology and comfortable using AI tools and large language models (LLMs) to support research, analysis, reporting, and everyday workflows. You don’t need to be a developer, but you should be willing to experiment, check outputs for accuracy, and use sound judgment when handling client information.

What You’ll Do

- Lead the planning and execution of traditional media buys across TV, cable, radio, print, and out-of-home (OOH).
- Partner with account management to translate client objectives into media recommendations, including market priorities, channel mix, budgets, and schedules.
- Evaluate audience research, ratings, market conditions, pricing, and available inventory to guide planning and buying decisions.
- Lead negotiations with media representatives and vendors to secure competitive rates, effective placements, and added value opportunities.
- Manage campaigns from start to finish, coordinating with account teams, media vendors, and other internal teams to keep deliverables and deadlines on track.
- Create and maintain campaign budgets, flowcharts, schedules, authorizations, and related documentation.
- Oversee trafficking and confirm that creative materials, instructions, and placements align with approved plans.
- Monitor campaign delivery, spending, and performance against approved budgets and goals; recommend and implement adjustments as needed.
- Complete post-buy analyses, identify delivery shortfalls or placement discrepancies, and negotiate makegoods or credits when appropriate.
- Oversee invoice review, resolve billing discrepancies, and complete campaign reconciliation in coordination with the billing team.
- Prepare campaign performance reviews and present results, insights, and recommendations to internal teams and clients as needed.
- Build and maintain vendor relationships, evaluate new opportunities, and bring relevant market insights to strategy discussions.
- Mentor less experienced buyers, provide guidance on complex buys, and help maintain accuracy and consistency across the team’s work.
- Stay current on audience measurement, industry trends, emerging technologies, and media buying best practices.
- Use AI tools and LLMs to support research, analysis, and reporting, and help the team evaluate and adopt useful workflow automations while checking outputs for accuracy and protecting client information.

What We’re Looking For

- At least 5 years of traditional media buying and planning experience, preferably across a broad range of markets and market sizes.
- Strong working knowledge of TV, cable, radio, print, and OOH planning and buying. Digital media buying and planning experience is a plus.
- Experience independently managing multiple clients, complex campaigns, and significant media budgets.
- Strong negotiation skills and experience evaluating rates, inventory, added value, makegoods, and vendor proposals.
- Experience with the Strata Media Buying Platform, including View, SBMS, and Eleven.
- Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive) and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Working knowledge of Nielsen and Comscore audience measurement, including the ability to interpret ratings and apply relevant media metrics to planning, buying, and post-buy analysis.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear recommendations.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain media recommendations and campaign results to clients and colleagues.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and meet tight deadlines.
- Sound judgment, accountability, and the ability to resolve campaign and vendor issues independently while recognizing when to involve others.
- A collaborative approach and a willingness to share knowledge and mentor less experienced team members.
- Hands-on experience with AI tools and LLMs, such as Gemini, Claude, or ChatGPT, with the judgment to evaluate outputs and guide practical use across the media buying team.

Benefits

- 401(k) with company matching
- Generous vacation and days off, including summer hours and your birthday
- 100% paid short- and long-term disability insurance
- Maternity/family leave
- Health insurance eligibility and contribution

Job Details

**Type:** Full-time

**Location:** Tampa, FL

**Work arrangement:** Hybrid; currently 3 days per week in-office, subject to change

**Compensation:** Based on experience and qualifications. Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

# Sr. Meta Media Buyer

$80k - $105k

Strikepoint Media

[Laguna Beach, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Laguna-Beach%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3577017512140833639?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6980&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7393152530424078057&crId=US_0US_0)

Strikepoint is an ROI-focused digital marketing agency dedicated to helping businesses scale through results-driven strategies. Founded in 2013, we've built our reputation on delivering measurable growth for our clients across funnels, paid media, and creative.
As a recognized industry leader, we've earned a spot on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies twice (2020 and 2022). Our team of digital marketers, media buyers, and creatives works with brands across diverse industries, including financial publishing, e-commerce, technology, health and wellness, online education, and more.
About This Role
As a Senior Meta Media Buyer at Strikepoint, you’ll own paid media strategy and execution with a primary focus on Meta, while managing performance across Google, TikTok, and other relevant platforms. You’ll lead channel-level planning, develop and run creative testing frameworks, and serve as a strategic voice on client calls. This role is for someone who thinks in systems, not just tactics, and who holds themselves accountable to performance outcomes.
**Responsibilities:**

Own and lead campaign strategy, structure, and optimization across Meta as your primary platform, with active management across Google, TikTok, and other relevant channels
Develop advanced scaling strategies, audience expansion frameworks, and budget reallocation decisions grounded in performance data
Build and manage creative testing frameworks in partnership with the Creative team, providing platform-specific direction based on results
Lead client-facing performance discussions, presenting insights, testing outcomes, and strategic recommendations clearly and confidently
Produce deeper channel-level analysis that goes beyond reporting, connecting data to business outcomes and informing next steps
Troubleshot complex tracking issues, attribution discrepancies, and cross-platform performance problems, including GTM and pixel-level diagnosis
Mentor junior media buyers through training, feedback, and day-to-day coaching
Maintain and improve campaign documentation, QA standards, and onboarding resources for the media buying team
Partner with the Funnel team to align paid media strategy with landing page performance and offer testing
Contribute to standardizing planning frameworks, reporting standards, and team processes

Experience: 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience with a proven track record in an in-house or agency environment
Education: BA/BS degree in marketing or business preferred, or equivalent work experience

**Skills and Expertise:**

Deep, proven expertise in Meta Ads Manager, including complex campaign structures, audience strategy, and algorithm-informed optimization
Demonstrated ability to scale paid media budgets while maintaining or improving performance efficiency
Experience managing campaigns across two or more platforms (Google Ads, TikTok Ads, programmatic, or CTV preferred)
Strong command of performance metrics and funnel analysis: CTR, CVR, ROAS, CPA, AOV, and LTV
Ability to build structured media plans with targeting strategy, campaign architecture, and budget allocation
Experience developing and running creative testing frameworks with clear hypotheses and performance-based iteration
Comfort troubleshooting tracking issues at the pixel, UTM, and attribution level; GTM experience is a strong plus
Proficiency with analytics tools such as GA4, Looker Studio, or equivalent reporting platforms
Strong communicator with experience leading client calls and presenting performance insights to stakeholders
Active, working proficiency with AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow; this means using AI to improve efficiency, analysis, creative iteration, or reporting, not familiarity with it in theory

Compensation

$80,000-$105,000

Benefits

Robust Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans with a generous employer contribution towards monthly premium costs
Customizable 401(k) plan with employer match after 90 days
Company-paid Life Insurance Policy
Flexible PTO
Company-provided Macbook
Hybrid/Remote work policy

Location

Our office is in Laguna Beach, CA. While candidates within a nearby radius are preferred, we are open to remote applicants with the right experience.

We’re looking for a motivated and collaborative professional to help bring our agency’s vision to life through impactful marketing initiatives. If you’re passionate about marketing, adept at managing complex projects, and thrive in a fast-paced agency environment, we’d love to hear from you!
Strikepoint is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.
Please note that in order to be considered for this role, candidates must currently reside within the United States. We are unable to offer international employment opportunities at this time.

Newcode.ai
