**About Newcode.ai**

Newcode.ai is a fast-growing legal tech and agentic AI company transforming how legal work is done. With teams across Oslo, Stockholm, US and beyond, we work at the intersection of law, technology, and intelligence. We move fast, think big, and take pride in doing things the right way.

**Note:** We believe in being transparent about what it's like to work at Newcode. As a fast-growing startup, we're building and evolving every day. That means not every process, playbook, or framework is already in place, and priorities can shift quickly.

The people who thrive here are comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership, and don't wait for perfect direction. They are resourceful, proactive, and able to "figure it out"—solving problems, creating structure where needed, and helping build the company as they go. If you are good with this then, great! Keep reading to learn more.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a highly proactive, strategic, and hands-on **Senior Growth Marketing Manager** who loves building from the ground up. This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping and scaling Newcode’s marketing function in a fast-paced startup environment. This role will position Newcode against the other competitors to win in the legal market.

You won’t wait for direction or rely on an established playbook. You’ll identify opportunities, develop ideas, make recommendations, and take ownership of execution. You should be equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting into the details—from developing a campaign strategy to writing the copy, launching the campaign, and analyzing the results.

A key part of this role is helping position Newcode clearly and competitively in the legal technology market. You will build a deep understanding of our customers, market and competitors, and turn those insights into compelling messaging and marketing initiatives that help Newcode win. To do this well, you’ll spend time where the market is: the role includes regular travel to industry conferences, client meetings and team onsites.

### Marketing Strategy & Execution

- Develop and execute marketing initiatives that support Newcode’s growth, pipeline, brand, and commercial objectives.
- Identify growth opportunities and proactively bring forward strategic, creative, and data-driven ideas.
- Translate business priorities into clear marketing plans with measurable goals and outcomes.
- Manage campaigns from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization.
- Continuously evaluate performance and use data and customer insights to improve results.
- Drive performance across Newcode’s website, email marketing, social media, paid media, and other relevant marketing channels.

### Lead & Demand Generation

- Own and develop Newcode’s demand generation strategy to build and convert qualified leads and support top-of-funnel growth.
- Design and execute campaigns that generate awareness, engagement, and Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs).
- Partner closely with Sales and Legal Engineering to align marketing activity with pipeline and revenue goals.
- Continuously test and optimize messaging, channels, audiences, and campaigns to improve conversion and pipeline performance.

### Content & Copywriting

- Own the development of high-quality, compelling, and on-brand content across key marketing channels.
- Write and edit copy for the website, blogs, email campaigns, social media, advertisements, sales collateral, and other customer-facing materials.
- Develop content that educates the market, builds trust, strengthens Newcode’s point of view, and supports demand generation.
- Translate complex product, AI, and legal technology concepts into clear and compelling messaging for law firm audiences.
- Partner with internal subject matter experts to identify and develop high-value content and thought leadership opportunities.

### Brand & Positioning

- Help shape and strengthen Newcode’s market positioning and messaging.
- Develop a deep understanding of Newcode’s customers, competitors, and the legal technology landscape.
- Identify opportunities to differentiate Newcode and clearly articulate why customers should choose us.
- Ensure all marketing materials consistently reflect Newcode’s premium brand positioning, voice, and visual identity.
- Maintain brand consistency across every customer and prospect touchpoint.

### Website & Digital Marketing

- Own and continuously improve website content, messaging, and landing pages to support brand, conversion, and pipeline goals.
- Identify and implement opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion across digital touchpoints.
- Lead SEO initiatives and optimize website content for search performance.
- Own or oversee email marketing campaigns, automation, segmentation, and lead nurturing.
- Use testing, data, and customer insights to continuously improve digital marketing performance.

### Events & Conferences

- Own the marketing strategy and execution for Newcode’s presence at key industry conferences, trade shows, customer events, webinars, and other field marketing initiatives.
- Develop and execute pre-event, onsite, and post-event marketing campaigns to drive awareness, generate meetings and leads, and support pipeline creation.
- Partner closely with Sales, Legal Engineering, and other internal teams to ensure clear objectives, messaging, and follow-up plans are in place for each event.
- Lead the development of event messaging, promotional materials, content, campaigns, and customer communications.
- Track event performance and ROI, using insights to improve future event strategy and investment.

### Analytics & Reporting

- Define, monitor, and report on key marketing KPIs tied to awareness, engagement, lead generation, pipeline, and campaign performance.
- Use data to identify opportunities, evaluate marketing effectiveness, and make recommendations for improvement.
- Provide clear, actionable insights to leadership on marketing performance and the impact of key initiatives.
- Establish a culture of testing, learning, and continuous optimization across the marketing function.

**Requirements**

- 5+ years experience in marketing, preferably in a AI / tech start up

- 5+ years experience in AI / legal tech

- Experience with marketing tools such as HubSpot is a plus.

Stage 2: Take Home Assessment

Stage 3: Presentation of Take Home Assessment

Stage 4: CEO Interview

- **Culture of trust and excellence:** Be part of a team that values reliability, respect, and initiative, where everyone’s contribution matters and diversity drives creativity.
- **Collaborative environment:** Work with talented, driven peers on bleeding-edge legal engineering solutions with real-world impact.
- **Growth and ownership:** Shape your role as we grow. Take ownership and drive outcomes from the start of your journey.

# Senior Growth Marketing Manager

$148.5k - $239.2k

Luminik

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8904999241374632910?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1929050447323349791&crId=US_0US_0)

Squarespace is looking for an experienced and strategic Group Growth Marketer to lead our customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth initiatives across digital and lifecycle channels. This role will be responsible for building and scaling data-driven marketing strategies that accelerate growth, optimize funnel performance, and maximize customer lifetime value. They will own web, lifecycle marketing and funnel conversion.

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision, analytical rigor, and team leadership, with a proven track record of driving measurable business results in high-growth environments. This role will partner cross-functionally with Product, Media, Affiliate, CRM, and Content teams to deliver integrated growth programs aligned with company goals.

You’ll Get To…

Partner closely with the Growth Product leader to jointly define and drive unified company wide growth strategy, aligning product led and marketing led initiatives across the full customer lifecycle.

Develop and execute the company’s comprehensive growth marketing strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and re-engagement.

Analyze customer behavior across the entire lifecycle, including acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, reactivation, and churn prevention

Own growth KPIs including customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, customer lifetime value (LTV), retention, and revenue contribution.

Identify and prioritize new growth opportunities through testing, experimentation, and channel expansion.

Lead annual and quarterly growth planning, forecasting, and budget allocation.

Build lifecycle marketing strategies that improve onboarding, engagement, retention, and customer advocacy.

Partner with CRM, PMM, and product teams to develop personalized customer journeys across email, SMS, in-app, and push channels.

Improve customer lifetime value through segmentation, automation, and upsell/cross-sell initiatives.

Ensure the website is a highly optimized revenue driver but also an incredible experience as the front door to our brand.

Optimize multi-channel campaigns to improve lead generation, customer acquisition, and ROI.

Establish a culture of experimentation through A/B testing and performance optimization.

Analyze funnel performance, attribution, and cohort behavior to identify growth opportunities.

Who We’re Looking For

10+ years of progressive experience in growth product, growth marketing, growth analytics, demand generation, lifecycle marketing, CRO, or performance marketing.

Proven success scaling customer acquisition and retention programs in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

Previous experience analyzing CRM, performance marketing, churn, and product and feature adoption for growth opportunities

Deep expertise in paid media, lifecycle marketing, funnel optimization, and attribution.

Strong analytical skills with experience using tools such as Amplitude, BI tools, Iterable, Contentful, Statsig, or similar platforms.

Experience managing growth tool stack and delivering measurable ROI.

Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Benefits & Perks

A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums

Fertility and adoption benefits

Access to supplemental insurance plans for additional coverage

Headspace mindfulness app subscription

Global Employee Assistance Program

Retirement benefits with employer match

Flexible paid time off

12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave

Pretax commuter benefit

Education reimbursement

Employee donation match to community organizations

7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

Dog-friendly workplace

Free lunch and snacks

Private rooftop

Hack week twice per year

Cash Compensation Range: $148,500 - $239,200 USD
The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.

In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.

About Squarespace
Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit

Our Commitment
Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customer base, but we also strive for the same in our employees. OpenGov, Inc.

OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

Role Overview
As a Senior Growth Marketing Specialist at OpenGov, you're a full-stack marketer—owning the complete go-to-market lifecycle for products, features, and campaigns. You'll develop positioning and messaging, craft integrated demand gen programs, build enablement collateral, execute launches, and measure impact. From strategy through execution, you'll combine storytelling and data to drive pipeline and establish OpenGov as the AI and ERP leader for state and local governments.

You'll partner across the marketing team, working with design, brand, and ops colleagues while owning outcomes end-to-end. This is a hands‑on role where you shape GTM strategy, create compelling content, launch campaigns, and continuously optimize for results. You bring both strategic vision and tactical execution chops.

What You'll Do
Campaign Strategy & Execution

Build and launch integrated multi-channel campaigns (email, paid, webinars, social, events, content syndication) to drive qualified pipeline for targeted personas and accounts. Own performance tracking, reporting, and optimization based on results.

Create compelling marketing content—emails, landing pages, ads, ebooks, customer stories, blogs—leveraging AI tools daily to scale production and test variations at speed.

Develop GTM messaging and positioning informed by customer insights, Gong calls, sales feedback, and competitive intelligence. Create talk tracks, enablement decks, and messaging guides that translate complex capabilities into clear value statements.

Define market segmentation, personas, and ICP insights that inform campaign targeting and messaging across all programs.

Support ABM campaigns and nurture strategies using Marketo and Salesforce to engage prospects across the funnel.

Stay plugged into government, market, and competitive trends to identify campaign opportunities and inform GTM strategy and decision‑making.

Product Launches & Enablement

Lead end-to-end launch plans for new products and features—defining objectives, audience, messaging, tactics, timeline, and success metrics.

Develop comprehensive enablement materials (pitch decks, one‑pagers, battlecards, FAQs) to equip sales, customer success, and support teams on new capabilities.

Coordinate internal comms, customer announcements, and field readiness to drive product adoption.

Performance & Optimization

Own campaign measurement and reporting—tracking pipeline contribution, engagement rates, conversion metrics, and ROI.

Analyze campaign performance, identify learnings, and translate insights into optimization recommendations.

Stay plugged into competitive, industry, and government trends; use insights to shape timely, relevant campaigns.

What We're Looking For
Core Experience

5+ years of B2B or B2G marketing experience, ideally in SaaS or high‑growth environments.

Proven track record developing and executing multi-channel campaigns that drove measurable pipeline results.

Strong writing and editing skills; provide examples of campaign copy, content, or messaging that moved the needle.

Experience with or demonstrated ability to own product positioning, GTM strategy, launches, or messaging development.

Hands‑on proficiency with Marketo, Salesforce, and marketing automation; comfort with analytics and translating data into insights.

Mindset & Attributes

AI-forward thinker: Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, etc.) daily to augment your work—scaling content creation, analysis, and decision‑making.

Analytical and strategic; able to synthesize customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market trends into clear, compelling narratives.

Roll‑up‑your‑sleeves operator; comfortable owning everything from strategy to execution across campaigns, content, and launches.

Collaborative and adaptable; energized by cross‑functional work, fast iteration, and ambiguity.

Data‑driven; demonstrate ability to measure, learn, and optimize based on results.

Nice-to-Haves

Experience in or passion for public sector, government, or B2G marketing.

Hands‑on experience with ABM tools, Guru, Aha, or Pendo.

Background with win/loss analysis, competitive intelligence, or voice‑of‑customer research.

Experience launching products or features end‑to‑end.

Compensation
Chicago, IL: $80,000 - $110,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

Why OpenGov?
A Mission That Matters.
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

Opportunity to Innovate
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

A Team of Passionate, Driven People
This isn’t your typical 9-to‑5 job; we operate in a fast‑paced, results‑driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

A Place to Make Your Mark
We pride ourselves on our performance‑based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head‑first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

Benefits That Work for You
Enjoy an award‑winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

401(k) with company match

Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

Professional development and growth opportunities

A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

##### Senior Event Marketing Manager

Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

Material Bank is hiring a Senior Event Marketing Manager to own our presence and performance across the major trade shows and industry events that drive new member acquisition and firm penetration across Architecture & Design (A&D), Facilities Management (FM), Property Management, Real Estate Development, and Corporate Workplace audiences.

This is a senior, individually-accountable role: you will set the event strategy (which events we invest in and why), and drive it through to execution, including on-site presence, team staffing, and vendor management. You will be measured on registration, order, and firm-penetration outcomes, not just activity or attendance.

**What You'll Do**

- Build and maintain a decision framework for which events Material Bank pursues, sponsors, or exhibits at, balancing audience fit, historical/projected ROI, and strategic firm presence (e.g., NeoCon, AIA Conference on Architecture, Clerkenwell Design Week, Paris Design Week, plus FM/property/CRE/corporate workplace events).
- Set annual and quarterly event calendars and budgets in partnership with Marketing leadership.
- Define target-firm lists per event in coordination with Performance Marketing and Lifecycle Marketing.
- Lead end-to-end event execution: booth/experience design, staffing plans, logistics, travel, and on-site presence at major shows.
- Assemble and lead cross-functional teams pulled from the broader marketing org (Field, Lifecycle, Performance, Integrated Marketing) plus external contractors/agencies as needed.
- Design branded, differentiated on-site experiences (activations, giveaways, incentive structures) that drive registration and engagement, not just booth traffic.
- Manage relationships with show organizers, industry associations (e.g., IFMA, AIA, IIDA), and vendors; negotiate sponsorship and exhibitor terms.
- Own event-level and program-level reporting against KPIs (below).
- Partner with Analytics/Data teams to track attendee-to-member-to-order conversion by event and by firm.
- Report results and recommendations to Marketing leadership on a regular cadence, with a clear read on what's working and what to cut.

**What You'll Bring**

- 10+ years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, or trade show/conference management.

##### Senior Marketing Operations Manager

We're hiring a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to build the attribution and tracking foundation that gives us a true, trusted picture of marketing's influence across the customer journey, and to lead the shift from manual campaign and event work into automation. I'm Karla Anderson, EVP, Marketing at Teamworks.

Marketing operations at Teamworks has lived in different places over the past few years, and it's time for it to have one clear owner inside marketing again. With 25 products across multiple markets, connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue is genuinely complex, and getting it right takes someone who understands both the mechanics of marketing operations and the nuance of enterprise B2B attribution. This role will map our journey end to end, from campaigns and events to website engagement and in-app messaging, and build the tracking infrastructure that lets us trust the numbers behind the funnel.

This is also a chance to help shape what an AI native marketing function looks like at Teamworks. We want a team that builds automation and agents into how we work, not as a side experiment, but as core infrastructure that scales campaign execution, list building, and reporting across demand gen and product marketing. You'll have real ownership here and the freedom to build this function largely from scratch.

##### The Role

- Map end-to-end marketing attribution and build the tracking that shows how demand gen and product marketing campaigns influence pipeline and revenue
- Own the systems and setup behind every campaign, event, and in-app message, including list building and lifecycle triggers, so tracking works correctly from day one
- Lead the shift from manual campaign and project work into automated workflows, freeing our team to focus on strategy instead of setup
- Partner with Tech Ops and RevOps to keep marketing data clean and aligned across the stack, without duplicating work already happening elsewhere
- Build our AI native marketing function, designing and shipping the automations and agents that scale work across demand gen and product marketing

##### What I'm Looking For

##### What You Must Bring

- 4-5 years running marketing operations in a complex, enterprise B2B environment, not a startup or single-product business, because Teamworks' multi-product, multi-market structure makes attribution genuinely harder to map
- A track record of building marketing attribution and campaign tracking from scratch, not just maintaining systems someone else designed
- Direct experience shifting marketing work from manual to automated, including AI-built automations or agents, not just using AI tools day to day
- Working knowledge of the marketing tech stack, including how campaign, CRM, and in-app messaging systems connect and where data breaks down
- Comfort operating as a team of one, owning strategy and execution without a team to delegate to, at least initially

##### Even Better If

- Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or customer.io or an equivalent in-app messaging platform
- Familiarity with website analytics tools like Google Analytics and how to tie web behavior into the broader attribution picture
- Background in sports, media, or another complex vertical

This function doesn't exist yet in its current form, which means you get to define it. You'll set the standard for how marketing operations runs at Teamworks, build the attribution model the business will use to judge marketing's contribution to revenue, and help lead the shift into an AI native way of working, all while operating across a genuinely complex, global, multi-product business.

# Senior Marketing Operations Manager

Full-time

Horizon3

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5031213580603459197?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4075476746730907474&crId=US_0US_0)

**Get to Know Us**

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

**What You’ll Do**

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to own and scale the systems, processes, and data foundation that power Horizon3's go-to-market engine. This role sits at the center of Marketing, Sales, and RevOps, turning strategy into measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

You'll be a strategic operator and a hands-on builder. You will own the architecture and roadmap for our marketing tech stack, lead complex cross-functional projects from problem definition through rollout, and set the standards for how campaigns are built, tracked, and measured. You will work with a high degree of independence and be the person the team brings the hard problems to.

**Marketing Systems & Technology**

- Maintain and support the day-to-day operations and functional health of the marketing automation platform and its Salesforce integration, assisting with updates to segmentation, scoring, routing, nurturing, lifecycle workflows, and compliance tasks (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).

- Assist in the evaluation, research, and rollout of new GTM tech stack tools, including supporting business case development, coordinating vendor logistics, and facilitating implementation steps for the team.

- Conduct routine audits, testing, and troubleshooting across the marketing tech stack to identify inefficiencies and help implement technical fixes designed by cross-functional leads.

- Execute data governance protocols to ensure data accuracy and consistency remain aligned across all integrated systems.

- Flag funnel conversion and handoff problems and drive the fixes across teams.


**Campaign Operations**

- Support campaign managers with program setup, pre-launch QA, and tracking validation to help ensure timely multi-channel launches.

- Help facilitate the day-to-day execution of ABM programs, assisting with account list uploads, segmentation updates, tool configuration, and reporting pulls.

- Monitor operational workflows for bottlenecks and assist the Senior Strategic Program Manager in deploying process tweaks that improve efficiency and accuracy.


**Process, Automation & AI**

- Support the maintenance and optimization of systems and automations that reduce manual work and help keep marketing data clean and actionable.

- Assist in researching and implementing AI agents or automated workflows identified by team leads to replace manual processes.

- Track emerging marketing technologies and AI tooling, sharing relevant insights and research with leadership to inform future recommendations.

- Maintain comprehensive documentation for workflows, SOPs, and system configurations, and support end-user training and enablement for the marketing team.

- Provide peer guidance and onboarding support to analysts and marketing operations teammates as needed.


**Analytics & Reporting**

- Partner with the Senior Marketing Analytics Manager on attribution, dashboards, and metric definitions, and make sure the systems capture what reporting needs.

- Monitor marketing data quality and troubleshoot issues across the GTM stack (Pardot, Salesforce, Chili Piper, etc.).

- Support attribution modeling and lead scoring initiatives.


**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Serve as an operations partner to Demand Generation, Sales, Finance, RevOps, and IT.

- Align cross-functionally on goals, definitions, and processes across the funnel.


**What You’ll Bring**

- 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or a related role in B2B SaaS or technology.

- Expert, hands-on experience with marketing automation and Salesforce, including administering integrations between them.

- Track record of leading complex, cross-functional systems projects end to end, such as a lifecycle redesign, a scoring and routing overhaul, a platform migration, or an attribution rollout.

- Deep understanding of lead lifecycle management, scoring, routing, segmentation, and campaign tracking.

- Strong background in data management, analytics, and performance reporting.

- Experience operationalizing account-based marketing programs.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate workflows, solve problems, and improve team efficiency.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building processes where none exist.

- Able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and get to a decision.

- Detail-oriented with a bias for action. You deliver accurate work quickly and own QA.


**What Sets You Apart?**

- Experience with the wider GTM stack, such as Chili Piper, Zuddl, RevSure, Nooks, Peerbound, Gainsight, Clay, Influ2, or Reachdesk.

- Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) or working SQL.

- Experience in cybersecurity, highly technical B2B markets, or enterprise go-to-market motions.


**What Success Looks Like**

- Marketing data is accurate, trusted, and consistently used in decision-making.

- Systems and processes scale as the business grows, with a roadmap the team can see.

- Day-to-day marketing workflows run smoothly, and campaign owners launch faster with fewer errors.

- Campaign and funnel performance is transparent, measurable, and clearly tied to revenue outcomes.


**Travel Required**

This role may require minimal travel for internal offsites. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

**Perks of Horizon3**

- Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

- Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

- Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

- Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

- Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.


**Compensation and Values**

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

- Base salary range: $145,000 - $185,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

- Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.


**You Belong Here**

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

**Other Duties**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**Application Note**

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role
JoVE is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Marketing Operations Specialist with advanced, hands-on HubSpot expertise to own and improve our marketing operations. This role combines email marketing, marketing automation, CRM/database management, and marketing analytics to ensure our campaigns are delivered efficiently, reach the right audiences, and generate measurable business results.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Google Analytics and can translate marketing objectives into reliable segmentation, automated journeys, and actionable reporting. They independently identify root causes, recommend practical solutions, and implement improvements that deliver measurable results.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain automated lifecycle journeys, including entry and exit criteria, behavioral triggers, sales handoffs and return-to-nurture rules. Support campaign execution through reusable workflows and templates.

Perform quality assurance (QA) to ensure campaigns are error-free and delivered successfully.

Diagnose and improve email delivery, inbox placement and engagement. Monitor sender reputation, bounces, complaints and audience health, coordinating technical fixes with RevOps.

Design and evaluate campaign A/B tests using clear hypotheses and success metrics, including downstream conversion.

Maintain and improve the marketing database through enrichment, validation, duplicate controls and documented data-quality checks.

Own marketing data-quality monitoring and audience usability. Partner with RevOps, Sales, and Product on shared CRM definitions, field mappings, and data integrity.

Build and maintain dashboards across Salesforce, HubSpot, and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

Track marketing KPIs, campaign performance, lead generation, funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, and ROI.

Analyze marketing performance and provide actionable insights to optimize campaigns and support strategic decision-making.

Develop and validate lead and account scoring using profile and behavioral signals. Agree handoff thresholds with Sales and refine scoring based on progression and feedback.

Evaluate and introduce tools, including AI, that expand marketing capabilities, and enable the team to use them effectively through enablement and practical guidance.

5+ years of relevant experience, including independent ownership of Marketing Operations improvements beyond campaign execution.

Advanced HubSpot experience in workflows, dynamic segmentation and data management.

Ability to evaluate behavioral signals, explain performance and deliver measurable improvements.

Knowledge of email deliverability best practices and marketing automation.

Experience with marketing attribution and funnel analysis.

Experience with Salesforce reporting, CRM management and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

Experience managing marketing databases, segmentation, and data hygiene.

Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.

Success Measures

Accurate and timely execution of global email campaigns, with reduced turnaround time and manual effort.

A reliable marketing database with effective audience segmentation and fewer recurring data errors.

Reliable dashboards and reporting that support business decisions.

Improved lead qualification, funnel progression and Sales handoff quality.

Adoption of reusable processes, automation and tools that improve team productivity and reduce workflow errors.

Measurable improvements in campaign performance and contribution to pipeline generation.

A competitive compensation package

You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.

Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.

Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Corporate Recruiter at Gamma Technologies Who We Are
GT, a leading multi-physics CAE simulation software provider, develops a suite of integrated solutions that guides and accelerates the engineering transformation of today’s products in the transportation, power generation, and industrial equipment industries.
At Gamma Technologies, our people are the driving force behind our success. We are looking for Sr. Marketing Specialist who shares our passion for authentic innovation, trusted partnerships, bold decisions and a relentless focus on customer success. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on executor who excels in content creation, event planning, campaign management, and marketing automation. The successful candidate will play a key role in driving brand awareness, engagement, and lead generation through innovative and data-driven marketing initiatives.
What You Will Do
Develop and execute content strategies that align with business objectives
Manage blog posts, email communication, assist with campaigns, and social media content
Optimize content for SEO and audience engagement
Plan, coordinate, and execute in-person and virtual events (Zoom/HubSpot), webinars, and trade shows
Collaborate with internal global teams and external partners to ensure event success
Track and analyze event performance to optimize future efforts
Develop and manage multi-channel marketing campaigns to drive customer acquisition and retention
Align messaging across digital, social, email, and paid media channels
Monitor campaign performance and adjust strategies based on data insights
Manage and optimize marketing automation tools (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot)
Use reports and dashboards to track campaign success and attribution
Set up email nurture campaigns, lead scoring, and audience segmentation
Work with sales teams to ensure smooth lead handoff and conversion tracking
Identify new marketing opportunities and trends to enhance brand visibility
Work cross-functionally with sales, product, and applications engineering teams
Measure and report on KPIs to ensure ROI-driven marketing strategies
What You Will Bring
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field is required
5+ years of experience in a marketing role with a strong focus on content, events, campaigns, and automation
Proficiency in marketing automation (e.g. HubSpot, Pardot) and Salesforce platforms
Strong writing and editing skills.
Experience managing B2B campaigns across multiple channels
Ability to work independently and drive initiatives with minimal supervision
Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret marketing data
Ability to lift 50+ lbs. for show packing/shipments
Excellent project management skills and attention to detail
What We Can Offer You
Competitive total rewards program with health and financial benefits (401K and profit sharing).
Flexible work options. This role will require you to be in the office 60% of the time.
Generous vacation, sick days, holidays and including parental leave.
Onsite fitness center.
Growth and development opportunities.

# Senior Marketing Analytics Manager

Auctane

[Austin, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Austin%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7220037488599298556?p=1&pos=0&rgn=47831&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=40541951307399636&crId=US_0US_0)

About Us
At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever‑changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Marketing Analytics Manager to join our team, reporting to the Director of Marketing Analytics. In this highly visible role, you'll be a key partner to marketing stakeholders, data engineering, and other cross‑functional teams.

You're a hands‑on expert who will own critical measurement frameworks, build and maintain insightful dashboards, and develop sophisticated attribution models. You won't just report the numbers; you'll be expected to uncover deep insights, make strategic recommendations, and drive the business forward through data‑driven storytelling.

This position is hybrid (3 days per week in office) and is located in Austin, TX .

About The Team
Our Marketing Analytics team is the strategic data hub within the Marketing organization. Our mission is to empower marketers with a strong data foundation, accessible insights, and strategic guidance. We strive to optimise every marketing dollar for maximum efficiency and impact, ensuring that data is at the heart of every decision we make.

What will you be doing?
You will serve as a strategic marketing analytics partner, leveraging deep data analysis, advanced measurement models and experimentation to provide actionable insights. Your core mission is to empower the marketing team with data‑driven strategies, optimise campaign performance, and champion a culture of data‑centric decision‑making across the organisation to drive business growth and maximise ROI.

Lead Deep‑Dive Analysis: Perform sophisticated analyses using advanced SQL, data modelling and statistical techniques to uncover actionable insights that drive marketing strategy and execution.

Own the Measurement Framework: Design, build and maintain robust marketing measurement models, including but not limited to Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), Multi‑Touch Attribution (MTA) and customer lifetime value (LTV) to assess marketing efficiency and ROI.

Drive Experimentation: Own the end‑to‑end process for A/B and incrementality testing, from hypothesis generation and experimental design to analysis and strategic recommendations.

Be a Strategic Partner: Serve as a key analytics partner to Marketing stakeholders. Translate complex data findings into clear, concise narratives and actionable strategies to grow the business.

Enhance Data Infrastructure: Collaborate with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to develop and automate robust reporting, dashboards and underlying data pipelines, ensuring data integrity and accuracy.

Champion a Data‑Driven Culture: Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert. Elevate the team’s collective knowledge by sharing your experience, and evangelise an analytics mindset across the entire marketing organisation to help shape a more data‑centric culture.

What are we looking for?

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field like Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline.

5+ years of experience in an analytics role, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on marketing analytics.

Expert proficiency in SQL for complex data extraction in a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery is a plus), combined with strong proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis and modelling (e.g., Pandas, scikit‑learn, statsmodels).

Deep, hands‑on experience in marketing measurement, including attribution modelling (MTA, MMM), incrementality analysis and experimental design (A/B testing), with a strong understanding of the underlying statistical principles.

Proven experience building insightful and user‑friendly dashboards using BI tools like Tableau, Looker or Power BI.

A strategic mindset with the ability to connect complex data directly to business goals and influence decision‑making at all levels of the organisation.

Exceptional organisational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple projects in a fast‑paced environment.

What will make you stand out?

Hands‑on experience building a Marketing Mix Model (MMM) from the ground up.

Master’s degree in a highly quantitative field.

The Tech

Data Warehouse: Google BigQuery

BI & Visualization: Tableau, Looker

Programming & Statistical Analysis: SQL, Python, R

Project Management & Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, Google Suite

What do we offer?

We are a hybrid company. All team members at Auctane in Austin come into the office Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

Take the reins of your time off with our Flex Time Off policy – because work‑life balance should always be in your hands!

We offer 12 paid holidays for all of our US employees!

401k employer matching programme – because your future deserves a friendly boost!

⭐️ We conduct annual merit reviews to recognise and reward your hard work and achievements.

️ Company events – we work hard, play hard! We do our best every day, even at our regular team‑building events.

Attractive office space in the heart of central Austin, Texas (free drinks, snacks…).

Indulge in weekly catered lunches at our office – a delicious perk to fuel your work.

Health and Wellness: The well‑being of our team is super important to us. Choose from different options that include medical, dental and vision plans.

️ Fitness centre in the office with Tonal Mirrors, Pelotons, free weights, etc.

Employee Assistance Programme. We offer up to 8 free mental‑health sessions.

We offer gym discounts to help you stay fit and healthy!

We offer education reimbursement to all employees, ensuring that you can pursue your educational goals while excelling in your career with us. Invest in your future and let us support your growth every step of the way.

Employee Referral Programme! We reward employees helping us find top talent!

An inclusive, casual and upbeat work environment. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid; we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.

Additional Position Duties

Sit for prolonged periods of time

Utilise wrist and hands for a prolonged period of time

Walk short distances

Stand for short periods

Speak and converse with others

Lift up to 25lbs without assistance up to chest height

Equal Opportunity Employer, Veterans, Disabled

About Right Side Up
Right Side Up is a collective of premium marketing talent – with all the marketing chops and none of the agency fluff. We’re trusted by the most buzzed-about early-stage ventures, the fastest growing tech companies, and well-established Fortune 500 teams to do one thing better: GROWTH. Some of our clients include Soludos, Thigh Society, Daily Harvest, Mill, The INKEY List, Live It Up, Humble Bundle, and many others.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for influencer marketing consultants who are passionate about the industry and want to demonstrate their expertise through contract work. Our clients typically seek consultant opportunities with availability ranging from 10 to 40 hours per week.

What You’ll Do

Own the day-to-day management of client relationships, providing proactive communication, documentation, guidance, and expertise to client stakeholders.

Develop and execute full-funnel influencer strategies that align with client goals, whether driving awareness or conversions.

Provide full-service, end-to-end creator program management, including recruitment, gifting, contract development, negotiation, activation, and performance optimization.

Source, vet, and activate creators across various platforms, including TikTok, Meta, YouTube, Substack, etc., that align with the brand’s voice and target audiences.

Negotiate deliverables, usage rights, and compensation models with creators, striking a balance between performance goals and budget efficiency.

Partner with clients and creators on whitelisting and paid amplification campaigns, ensuring creative assets and targeting strategies maximize performance.

Build and execute compensation strategies using flat fee, CPA, or hybrid models, optimizing for performance while aligning with creator expectations and client ROI goals.

Collaborate with creators on content planning, briefs, and approvals to ensure brand consistency while maintaining creator authenticity.

Manage client budgets across campaigns, with a focus on ROI, CAC, and LTV contribution.

Provide ongoing campaign reporting and insights, highlighting creative performance, content engagement, conversion trends, and new opportunities.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of hands‑on experience managing influencer programs with proven success in driving measurable business outcomes.

Strong understanding of influencer platforms, content formats, and creator compensation models (flat fee, affiliate commission, gifting, hybrid).

Excellent communication skills; comfortable building relationships with creators, presenting to clients, and translating campaign results into actionable insights.

An analytical mindset and ability to use data to optimize creator selection, content formats, and campaign performance.

Ability to balance strategy and execution, moving fluidly from sourcing and negotiating with creators to reporting and scaling campaigns.

A natural relationship‑builder with a network of creators, agencies, and platform contacts.

Experience in some of our core verticals, such as Retail, Health & Wellness, CPG, B2B/Prosumer, FinTech, Subscription & Services.

Bonus Experience

Experience running campaigns on TikTok Shop, Amazon Associates/Creator Connections, LTK, and ShopMy.

Background in affiliate marketing and/or solid understanding of how other marketing channels can work together to fuel growth.

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

##### Senior Partner Marketing Manager

Hatch is an AI agent lead management platform that helps services businesses turn every customer interaction into revenue growth. Our AI agents handle conversations over SMS, email, and voice—24/7—enabling businesses to scale 1:1 communication without scaling headcount.

Recently acquired by Yelp, Hatch operates as a standalone product and is expanding our reach to help thousands more businesses unlock the revenue sitting in their lead pipeline. We've driven $5.1B in revenue for our customers—and we're just getting started.

We're hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager to run our partner program—one of Hatch's highest-leverage growth channels. Rather than a channel support role, this is a co-marketing, co-sell, and relationship-driven one—and you'll own it end to end.

You'll be the main point of contact and connective tissue between Hatch and our partners the person they come to for events, campaigns, and co-created content—and you'll pull in the right people across marketing (product marketing, enablement, content, field marketing) to make it happen.

This is high-impact work. Strong partnerships drive pipeline, expand our reach, and build Hatch's credibility across the industry—and you'll be in charge of scaling that program.

##### What You'll Do:

- Help land new partners: partner with product marketing and enablement to produce the collateral BD uses to pitch and land new partners.

- New strategic partner and integration launches: Onboard and announce new partners and product integrations across email, blog, website, and social—working with product marketing on the integration's value prop.

- Co-marketing campaigns: Plan and execute co-branded campaigns—launches, webinars, ebooks, seasonal offers—tapping partners as a distribution channel to get Hatch's content in front of their audiences. You'll own the partner relationship and the plan, and partner with content and product marketing on assets, talk tracks, and speakers.

- Partner program management: For partners with year-round programs (newsletter placements, blog posts, committed content), own the fulfillment—producing some content yourself and pulling in content, PMM, and enablement for the rest. You'll also help keep Hatch's listings and profiles on partner sites accurate and up to date.

- Partner enablement: Scope the collateral partners need to speak fluently about Hatch to their audiences, and partner with product marketing and enablement to produce it. As Hatch evolves, keep partners in the loop and their materials current—so their knowledge of Hatch stays fresh.

- Partner events: Work with field marketing on partner events and VIP experiences, contributing partner context, messaging, and coordination.

- Repeatable playbooks & scaling: Turn one-off partner activations into repeatable playbooks, so the program scales efficiently as we add partners and move into new verticals.

- Partner relationships: Maintain ongoing relationships with partner contacts—regular syncs, staying current on their updates, and keeping communication flowing—and proactively bring partners ideas for campaigns and content.

- Tracking & optimization: Measure and optimize partner ROI, track referral handoffs, and improve lead quality from partner activity.


##### What It Takes To Succeed:

- Relevant background: 4–7 years in partner marketing, co-marketing, or related B2B SaaS marketing (product or content)

- Natural relationship-builder: comfortable being the face of Hatch to partners, building trust, and managing external stakeholders

- Strong project management: you can juggle multiple partners and orchestrate deliverables across internal teams you don't manage—knowing when to set direction and when to step back—and keep a dozen moving parts on track and shipping on time

- Solid content and campaign instincts: you can develop narratives, campaign angles, and webinar topics, and produce or shape content across formats

- Multi-partner-type experience: you've worked across associations, tech platforms, and agencies—not just one vertical

- Fluent in pipeline language: SQOs, referral attribution, and co-marketing ROI

- Thrives in a build-stage environment: comfortable with ambiguity and a fast pace, and energized by shaping a program rather than inheriting a finished one


##### What You'll Get:

- Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental

- 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday

- Up to 14 weeks of parental leave

- Monthly wellness subsidy

- Work from home reimbursement

- Flexible spending account

- 401(k) retirement savings plan

- Employee stock purchase plan

- Compensation range for this position is $106,000 - $198,000 annually. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

# Senior GTM Enablement, Customer & Partner Marketing Manager

$137k - $205k

Full-time

Ditto

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8503347010726036422?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=210&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3847317408530072120&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Ditto:**

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

## **About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Marketer to own the path from first touch to closed-won across two sales organizations.

Commercial and Public Sector sellers carry the assets you build. The events you run put them in front of buyers. The customer proof you publish is what makes the pitch credible. And the partner motions you market, including sell-with, sell-through, and co-sell, are how all of it scales.

Why this role, and why now: Ditto has already won marquee commercial brands like Chick-fil-A and Delta Air Lines, along with defense mission owners including SOCOM. This is still Day 1 for us. The opportunity now is to grow across every distribution path, B2C, B2B, and B2G, and this role is where that gets built.

This is a senior individual contributor role and the bridge between Marketing and Growth. You report to the Head of Marketing and work daily with Commercial sales, Public Sector sales, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success. Some travel for field events in both markets is expected.

## **Key Responsibilities**

**Go-to-market enablement, Commercial and Public Sector**

- Build the enablement system both sales teams run on: standard pitch decks, product data sheets, battlecards, competitive positioning, and a message library sellers can customize themselves without drifting off brand

- Ship a launch kit for every product release, covering the positioning one-pager, FAQ, customer-facing email, and sales briefing

- Support the field calendar across both markets, from customer dinners and regional roadshows to webinars, speaking slots, and curated meetings, and tie each one to pipeline you can point to

- Run the account-based plays that move deals: named-account landing pages, content sequences for target accounts, and direct outreach support, working with RevOps on the funnel data that shows what to fix


**Customer marketing and proof**

- Build the customer evidence engine: case studies, white papers, video and long-form features, and a customer section on the website that does them justice

- Run the reference program end to end, including the approval path through customer legal, our legal, and public affairs

- Extend that proof into markets we have not sold to yet, with a use-case library and forward-looking narratives that open new sectors


**Partner marketing**

- Turn partner motions into pipeline across sell-with, sell-through, co-sell, and OEM, with marketplace listings and partner kits for hardware, software, cloud, and G/SI partners

- Work closely with marketing counterparts at partner organizations to build and run joint campaigns


## **What You'll Need**

- A portfolio of enablement assets and customer stories you personally wrote and shipped, with the funnel data to show what each one moved

- Strong writing, plus enough technical depth to explain how a developer platform works without a solutions engineer in the room

- Experience running customer stories end to end, including the unglamorous parts: sourcing, interviewing, legal review, and approvals

- Events that produced tracked pipeline, not just attendance numbers

- Working fluency in a CRM and a marketing automation platform, enough to read funnel data yourself and say what should change

- Comfort serving two sales organizations with different buyers, cycles, and constraints, without favoring either

- Grit in ambiguity. You build the process when there isn't one, and unstructured problems energize you

- A proactive and curious attitude about how you can leverage AI to support your role through automation, ideation, asset creation, or more thoughtful decision-making


## **Nice to Haves**

- Experience in developer tools, data infrastructure, edge computing, IoT, or mobile platforms

- An account-based marketing program you built rather than inherited

- A track record managing freelance writers, video producers, or event partners to a deadline

- Marketing to defense or federal buyers, with comfort around public affairs and operational security review cycles

- A military or defense-technology background of any kind

- Time at a company moving from founder-led selling to a repeatable GTM motion


### **The Benefits of Building with Us**

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

### **Apply Anyway**

At Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

$75k - $85k

Full-time

EverService Holdings, LLC

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3869269798589021420?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=378&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4363330006593202457&crId=US_0US_0)

**Who We Are**

RYNO Strategic Solutions is an innovative, full-service digital marketing company with 200+ RYNOs offering exceptional internet marketing services since 2008. We stay ahead of our competition with top-notch proprietary strategies, tracking, and reporting. Due to our total transparency, our customers always know exactly what they receive through their marketing efforts with us. We are dedicated to helping Home Service companies find their customers online by utilizing the most cost-effective desktop and mobile strategies.

**Our Mission**

We Exist to Grow Your Business...PERIOD.

**Our Values**

- We prioritize **INTEGRITY** and transparency in every interaction, building trust and delivering lasting value.
- We aim for **EXCELLENCE** in everything we do, ensuring exceptional outcomes for clients and continuous growth for our team.
- We take **ACCOUNTABILIT** Y for our successes and failures, fostering a culture of trust and collaboration to deliver impactful results.
- We think differently, pursue **INNOVATION** relentlessly, and embrace every challenge as an opportunity for growth.
- **OBJECTIVITY** drives our decision-making because data-backed solutions plus industry expertise wins every time.

\\n

#### **Summary of Position:**

The Senior Paid Media Strategist will strategize, implement, optimize, and monitor effective paid media campaigns to ensure we're exceeding our clients' goals and expectations. In this role, you will meet directly with large or enterprise clients to discuss strategy, review paid performance, and realign on growth objectives. You'll bring the passion and drive to analyze data and develop actionable solutions to continuously improve campaign results. As a subject matter expert, you will be strategic, detail-oriented, client-facing, and data-driven.

#### **Position Responsibilities:**

- Create, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns for clients across a variety of industries on Google, Bing, Meta, and other ad networks aligned with their established paid media goals
- Monitor the pacing of paid media campaigns to ensure no under or over-delivery
- Analyze paid campaign performance to develop and implement strategies to continually improve performance
- Track and report performance metrics of paid marketing campaigns
- Effectively communicate campaign results and any strategy changes to stakeholders
- Conduct and communicate competitive client research, develop and implement strategies to position clients in front of their competitors
- Provide recommendations on landing page optimizations and strategies to improve paid media performance
- Mentor junior members of the team
- Share expertise in all utilized ad-serving platforms and share that knowledge with the rest of the Paid Media team
- Collaborate with the Paid Media Manager to identify areas of inefficiency within the processes and strategy of the Paid Media team
- Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert to internal and external stakeholders
- Build and lead Paid Media team trainings and host office hours
- Train new hires to ensure they can successfully fill their role and responsibilities
- Additional job duties as assigned by management

#### **Position Requirements:**

- 3+ years of experience in Paid Media, preferrable within a fast-paced marketing agency setting
- Expertise in Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta Ads
- Experience with AdPulse and Optmyzer experience preferred
- Hands-on experience in ad management tools and performance-driven campaigns required
- Experience in developing performance presentations, A/B and multivariate testing, and data analysis to drive measurable results
- Strong attention to detail, organizational and time management abilities
- Adept at managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced and high-volume environment with conflicting priorities
- Excellent communication skills, both internally and externally
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively

\\n

$75,000 - $85,000 a year

- This target compensation range is subject to multiple factors, including role, level, experience, and location. As you go through the interview process, your recruiter will work with you to identify a competitive base salary within the proposed target compensation range that will get your excited about your future with us.

\\n

#### **Benefits:**

We've Got You Covered! RYNO is proud to offer a variety of benefits to support employees and their families, including:

- **Performance-based bonuses** to reward excellence
- **Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance**
- **401(k) matching** to help you plan for your future
- **6 weeks of paid parental leave** for new parents
- **$2000 annual tuition reimbursement** for continued education
- **Monthly data stipend** to support your remote work environment
- **Paid Vacation and sick time off** for work-life balance
- **11 paid holidays** to enjoy throughout the year
- **Paid Days for You** to reset and recharge
- **Paid birthday holiday** to celebrate your special day
- **Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program** for personal support
- **Leadership and career advancement** opportunities
- **Anniversary rewards** to celebrate milestones

#### **About RYNO Strategic Solutions:**

RYNO Strategic Solutions (RYNO) and Blue Corona, two leading digital marketing agencies specializing in the home services industry, merged into one company in September 2024. This strategic union combines nearly 30 years of expertise from both companies, unified under the RYNO Strategic Solutions brand creating an unrivaled market leader. With nearly 30 years of combined experience and data-driven insights in home services marketing, the newly unified RYNO Strategic Solutions offers unmatched expertise, and a robust portfolio of services designed to help home service contractors create, capture, and convert more leads from their digital marketing investments.

# Senior Paid Media Strategist

$103.33k

Common Thread Collective

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5392789095253275295?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8074947669880223613&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Paid Media Strategist

Remote California

##### Senior Paid Media Strategist

A Senior Paid Media Strategist at CTC is a full-funnel expert across both paid search and paid social. You operate as the lead media strategist for your client portfolio, combining deep Paid Media mastery to drive outcomes across the entire paid media ecosystem. You analyze data, develop strategy, execute with precision, and communicate results with clarity. You elevate everyone around you.

##### What We Look For

This place isn't for everyone, but it might be for you if…

##### You Set the Standard

- Your decisions are research-backed, every time
- Your client service is the bar others aspire to
- You arrive at meetings prepared, with data, insight, and a point of view
- You organize your time and say "no" so you can protect what's most critical
- You approach failure with curiosity, not defensiveness
- Your word is trustworthy, and you do what you say you will

##### You Are Driven To Increase Value

- You're passionate about building brands for the next generation
- You articulate your expertise so clearly that even a beginner follows along
- You document and report your work habitually
- You gather context before meetings, so you arrive ready to contribute

##### You Create an Environment of Excellence

- You seek opportunities to sharpen your skills without being prompted
- You resist the temptation to play victim; you own outcomes 100%
- You're willing to put in the reps to be a domain expert
- You inspire others through the standard you hold for yourself

##### What You'll Do

**Innovate**

You stay on the frontier of paid media strategy and technology across both search and social. You combine data analysis and client feedback to develop strategic plans spanning Google Ads and Meta. You make tactical recommendations for targeting, messaging, and campaign optimization across platforms. You test constantly, investigate relentlessly, and adapt strategy based on statistical outcomes. When it's time to pivot, you're among the first. You bring early insights to the team and lead the way.

**Create**

Creative problems take creative solutions. You write compelling direct-response copy for both search and social, build out campaigns in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, and ensure every initiative is launched on time, on budget, and built to win. You use historical data to guide decisions and find the hidden solution others miss. Attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making are non-negotiables.

**Own**

KPIs are your bread and butter. Google Sheets is your jam. "Count on Me" is your mantra. You see things through to the end. You project monthly budgets for each account, back every recommendation with data, and communicate results clearly to clients and teammates. You hold yourself to a high standard and share your learnings to elevate the buyers around you. People know: if you're involved, it gets done.

##### What Success Looks Like

**Success in Your Day-to-Day**

- Optimize ad accounts across Google and Meta, building, testing, and iterating on campaign types, ad copy, creative, budgets, and bids to hit spend and ROAS targets
- Monitor active campaigns and adjust budgets and strategy in real time for the best results
- Forecast future budgets and performance using historical data and industry trends
- Run multivariate tests to determine the best-performing creative, copy, and audiences
- Pull and sort data tables to guide creative teams on top-performing elements
- Troubleshoot accounts for errors and warnings across Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, and Meta Ads Manager
- Communicate meaningful results to clients in weekly meetings, reports, and team debriefs
- Coach and assist junior buyers, sharing knowledge to uplift the full team

**Success in Your First Three to Six Months**

**Ownership of Ad Accounts**

Actively running client accounts across paid search and paid social without regular assistance from other buyers.

**Accurate Reporting and Projecting**

You've learned the ropes, you can accurately project a client's spend and ROAS across both Google and Meta.

**Assisting Wherever Possible**

You share your knowledge freely, assist accounts owned by non-Sr. buyers, and operate palms-down to help wherever you can.

##### What You'll Bring to the Table

- Significant experience creating and optimizing Google Ads accounts at scale. This is a top requirement; if you haven't done this, this role isn't for you
- 2–4+ years of paid media experience managing budgets of $350,000+ across search and/or social
- Expert-level knowledge of: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Merchant Center, Google Analytics, Shopify, and copywriting
- Experience building, connecting, optimizing, and troubleshooting data feeds in Google Merchant Center
- Experience integrating Product Ratings from various aggregators into Google Merchant Center
- Ability to forecast budgets across channels based on historical data and client goals
- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills. You analyze data, make decisions, and build recs from it
- Familiarity with Google Ads Desktop Editor
- Ability to think about a brand's 360° digital approach from acquisition through retention
- Confident interpersonal communicator. You can hold people accountable and lead difficult conversations
- Insatiable curiosity. You can't leave a problem alone until you've found a solution
- A desire to take calculated risks after carefully examining the calculus
- A unique combination of humility (willing to do the dirty work) and ambition (vision for what's ahead)
- Skilled in Asana or relevant project management software, preferred
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail
- Ability to adapt to new processes, strategies, and goals

##### Compensation

- Base Salary: $103,333 annually
- Bonus Structure: 10% of base salary

##### About Us

At CTC, we are fixated on building the next generation of legendary brands and the people who will lead them.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing this mission, we organize all of our decisions — from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money — in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone. They're challenging.

In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

For those who resonate with the following values, CTC has proven itself to be a remarkable place to grow and thrive.

1. **We Set the Standard**
2. **We Are Driven To Increase Value**
3. **We Create an Environment of Excellence**

We'll come alongside you and care for you in your pursuits by offering full-time permanent CTC employees:

- **401K** \| program with a 3% company match (post 90 days employment) to bring out the investor inside you
- **TIME OFF** \| When you're at CTC, you're firing on all cylinders. To make that possible, we offer a Flexible Time Off policy where you will coordinate with supervisor to take time away from the office for rest, travel, and variety of others things that are important to you!
