We are seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager with deep client-facing and local marketing experience to join our expanding team. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. You will also support the team with Meta Ads campaigns. Your complex and diverse portfolio of clients will be a mix of local and SMBs that constantly challenge you with goals to maximize performance, reach, and customer acquisition across these channels. In addition to managing paid media execution, this role partners with our local marketing teams to oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile, Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs — and serves as the client’s voice for those channels on monthly performance calls.

The Senior Paid Media Manager will report to the Director, Franchise Partnerships. The position will also work with our global support teams within AdMax Local. You should be able to work well as part of a distributed team and provide innovative solutions to the new problems and opportunities that arise every week. In addition, you should have the ability to function equally well independently and as part of a team, as well as the ability to adapt to the changing digital marketing landscape and the use of AI.

This remote role may require one in-person client event per year.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Plan, develop, and execute comprehensive paid media strategies to drive revenue, direct response, qualified leads, and new user acquisition for your book of clients
- Utilize business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow relationships and client investments
- Manage Search, Performance Max, Display, Social, Remarketing, and Video advertising campaigns within the native Google, Meta, and Microsoft platforms and the proprietary AdMax Local platform
- Oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile/Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs executed by specialized internal teams, ensuring on-time, on-brand, and on-strategy execution for every client (this role manages and quality-checks the work)
- Confidently communicate strategy and campaign progress to clients through weekly calls and emails; Present and discuss organic/local SEO and AI Visibility performance on monthly client performance calls, translating concepts, deliverables, and results into clear business impact
- Provide recommendations and execute strategies for ad copy, keyword opportunities, campaign structuring, targeting, creative, display network, and other facets of Google inventory
- Integrate consumer and business insights into media to enhance targeting and tracking efforts
- Optimize performance marketing campaigns to meet and exceed SEM and paid social campaign benchmarks through channel-specific levers utilizing industry best practices
- Responsible for monthly reporting on campaign performance with a keen eye toward media optimization to ensure efficient and effective campaign execution
- Responsible for tight management of paid media budget, providing timely management of platform setup, invoicing, and accruals
- Manage the creative development process, including writing creative briefs, trafficking, creative insights, ensuring timely delivery, and alignment with client direction. Requires a solid understanding of the creative process and creative development best business practices.

**Qualifications:**

- US-based applicants only
- 7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in SEM (Search, Display, Remarketing, App Install). 1+ years of Performance Max and Shopping experience.
- 5-7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in paid social (Facebook/Instagram)
- TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and Twitter are a plus
- Working knowledge of Local SEO, Google Business Profile, local listings/citation management, online reputation management, and organic social media management — sufficient to oversee specialist teams and confidently discuss performance and recommendations with clients on monthly calls
- Familiarity with AI Visibility / Answer Engine Optimization (AIO/GEO) concepts and how they intersect with traditional SEO
- 7+ years of experience in Client Management (Must be comfortable with a high volume of client meetings, some weeks)
- Experience working and developing strategies for clients with multiple franchise locations.
- Strong ability to multitask, prioritize, and respond with an appropriate sense of urgency in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Proven track record of successfully planning and executing Paid Search, Paid Social, Paid Display, and YouTube campaign management and optimizations at scale
- Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis, attribution, ads implementation, and platform integration (Excel skills required)
- Detail-oriented, able to build project plans and presentations with strategic input
- A proactive mindset, strong work ethic, and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional leads and existing teams
- Experience driving campaigns from concept through to execution, and performing post-campaign analysis
- Experience with analytics/tracking tools: Google Analytics (Universal & GA4), SEMRush, Google Tag Manager, Meta Business Suite
- Experience optimizing landing pages and performing A/B and multivariate testing
- Experience leveraging AI to improve the quality of work output and turnaround time
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a professional business environment
- Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree a plus
- Bing Ads Accredited Professional (Preferred)
- Google AdWords Certified (Preferred)
- Meta BluePrint Certified (Preferred)
- Google Analytics Certified is a plus

**Compensation & Benefits:**

- Salary range $90k - $120k depending on experience and location
- Remote environment
- Health/dental/vision benefits
- Unlimited PTO
- 401(k) plan

# Senior Ecommerce & Marketing Manager (New York)

Location:Grand Central, NYCompany:Greenwich St. Jewelers

## Description:

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid, 3 Days On-Site / 2 Days Remote

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a highly organized, analytical, and hands-on **Senior Ecommerce & Marketing Manager** to own the day-to-day execution, management, and optimization of Greenwich St. Jewelers' digital commerce experience across Shopify Plus, Email, and SMS.

Reporting to the Ecommerce & Marketing Director, this individual contributor role will have significant ownership across ecommerce operations, site merchandising, lifecycle marketing, testing and optimization, performance reporting, and digital project management. The Senior Manager will be expected to proactively identify opportunities, make strategic recommendations, and independently lead ecommerce initiatives from concept through execution and optimization.

The ideal candidate combines strong ecommerce expertise, operational rigor, creative sensibility, and analytical thinking. They are proactive, highly detail-oriented, comfortable making data-informed recommendations, and capable of independently managing multiple initiatives in a fast-paced luxury retail environment.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic thinking and execution and is comfortable taking ownership from concept and briefing through implementation, analysis, and optimization.

This is a hybrid role based in New York City. The position will require full-time onsite attendance during the initial 60–90 day onboarding and training period, after which the schedule will transition to three days per week in the office and two days working remotely.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Ecommerce Strategy & Site Experience**

- Own the day-to-day ecommerce experience across Shopify Plus, ensuring the site is accurate, compelling, on-brand, and optimized for conversion across desktop and mobile.
- Partner with the Ecommerce & Marketing Director to translate broader business and marketing strategy into ecommerce initiatives and site experiences, while proactively identifying opportunities and recommending priorities that support ecommerce growth, conversion, and customer experience.
- Lead site merchandising and digital execution for key commercial moments, including Holiday, Sale, Collaborations, product launches, and other strategic initiatives.
- Leverage site performance, customer behavior, and merchandising data to identify opportunities and make actionable recommendations.
- Own weekly and monthly ecommerce performance and merchandising reporting, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas requiring optimization.
- Develop and manage ongoing testing and optimization initiatives across merchandising, content, navigation, and site experience.
- Ensure press, promotional mentions, campaigns, and other brand moments are appropriately reflected throughout the website.

**Site Merchandising & Operations**

- Own the creation, merchandising, optimization, and ongoing maintenance of collection pages.
- Conduct regular audits of designer collections, Top Navigation, PDPs, and other key site areas to ensure accuracy, consistency, and relevance.
- Drive ongoing PDP optimization ensuring content is both consistent and up to date, while looking for opportunities to further enhance storytelling, product education, cross-selling, and UX.
- Manage product imagery updates, alternate metal photography, merchandising adjustments, and related site content.
- Identify opportunities to improve navigation, product discovery, merchandising, and the overall customer journey.
- Maintain a high standard of site accuracy and proactively troubleshoot ecommerce issues as they arise.

**Email & SMS**

- Own the monthly creative briefing process for Email Campaigns, Flows, and SMS.
- Develop campaign briefs, write copy, select imagery, and coordinate creative asset requirements with internal partners.
- Partner with the Ecommerce & Marketing Director and Graphic Designer to move campaigns from concept through final execution.
- Manage segmentation, scheduling, send-time optimization, and A/B testing strategies.
- Own Email and SMS performance reporting and provide recommendations based on campaign, flow, customer, and engagement data.
- Identify opportunities to improve lifecycle marketing performance, customer engagement, and retention through ongoing testing and optimization.

**Photography & Digital Asset Management**

- Manage ecommerce photography requirements and digital asset workflows to ensure product and campaign imagery needs are identified and completed on schedule.
- Maintain and prioritize photography shot lists based on ecommerce and marketing needs.
- Coordinate product availability and organization for scheduled photography.
- Partner with internal creative resources to ensure completed imagery is web-ready, appropriately organized, and implemented across PDPs and marketing channels.
- Ensure product imagery and alternate views are properly ordered and optimized across the website.

**Agency, Developer & Digital Project Management**

- Serve as a senior day-to-day point of contact for external developers and digital agency partners, independently driving ecommerce projects, establishing priorities, and ensuring accountability against timelines and business objectives.
- Create, prioritize, assign, and follow up on developer tickets covering feature requests, visual issues, promotions, site updates, new themes, and ongoing enhancements.
- Attend digital agency meetings alongside the Ecommerce & Marketing Director and take ownership of follow-up, execution, and project coordination.
- Manage digital project timelines and proactively identify risks, dependencies, or delays.
- Critically evaluate agency and developer recommendations, provide informed input, and partner with the Ecommerce & Marketing Director on prioritization and implementation.
- Own site updates supporting SEO and Paid Media initiatives, including collection creation, merchandising, landing destinations, and linking strategy.
- Coordinate cross-agency initiatives to maintain alignment, accountability, and timely execution.

**Analytics & Optimization**

- Monitor ecommerce, Email, and SMS performance using Shopify Analytics, Klaviyo Analytics, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, and other available reporting tools.
- Independently translate ecommerce and marketing performance data into clear insights, strategic recommendations, and prioritized opportunities for optimization.
- Identify trends in site behavior, merchandising performance, campaign engagement, and conversion.
- Establish and manage ongoing testing initiatives to improve customer experience and digital performance.
- Proactively communicate key findings, opportunities, and recommendations to the Ecommerce & Marketing Director and relevant cross-functional partners.
- Act as a senior ecommerce resource across the organization, partnering cross-functionally with Marketing, Creative, Sales, Inventory, and external partners to drive alignment and execution of digital initiatives.

**Qualifications & Skill Summary**

- 6+ years of professional ecommerce and/or digital marketing experience, preferably within luxury retail, fashion, fine jewelry, beauty, or another high-touch consumer brand.
- Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor, independently identifying opportunities, making recommendations, and leading complex ecommerce initiatives with limited day-to-day direction.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong proposal-writing ability.

We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

**About the Role:**

Headway has built the largest network of mental health providers in the country, with 85,000 active and growing. As we scale, we have an opportunity to deepen how providers understand, experience, and value Headway across their journey. Ultimately, we want to be the partner providers count on to build a thriving practice and help more patients make progress toward their goals.

We're looking for a Staff Product Marketing Manager to help more providers discover Headway, understand why we're the right partner for their practice, and take the first steps toward building a thriving business. You'll shape our provider growth strategy, build differentiated positioning and messaging, and lead GTM efforts that drive acquisition, activation, and early engagement.

This is a role for someone who likes building. You'll partner closely with Provider Growth, Design, Lifecycle Marketing, Research, Creative, and other marketing teams to turn provider insight into strategies that move the business.

- **You Will:**

 - **Build deep provider insight.** Understand the provider, market, and competitive landscape, and bring that perspective into Product and Growth decisions.

 - **Own provider positioning and messaging.** Turn provider insight and Headway's capabilities into a clear, differentiated story that attracts providers and builds trust.

 - **Lead Provider Growth GTM.** Own GTM strategies that drive provider acquisition, activation, and early engagement, from positioning and messaging through execution.

 - **Lead GTM channel planning and execution.** Translate GTM strategy into an integrated marketing plan and lead cross-functional marketing partners to execute against shared goals.

 - **Find the leverage.** Identify the highest-impact opportunities to attract and activate providers, even before a brief or roadmap exists.

 - **Equip teams to tell a consistent story.** Give Growth, Sales, Enablement, and Customer Success the frameworks and tools they need to bring our provider story to life.

- **You’d be a great fit if…**

 - You have **significant PMM experience (8+ years)** in consumer, marketplace, SMB, subscription, or product-led businesses, with a track record of driving customer acquisition and activation.

 - You **know the customer and market cold**, can build positioning and messaging, and have influenced Product and Growth strategy, not just supported launches.

 - You **understand how to drive provider acquisition and activation**, connecting customer insight, positioning, and GTM execution to measurable business outcomes.

 - You’re **comfortable with ambiguity**, can form a point of view without perfect information, and know how to prioritize what matters most.

 - You can **lead complex cross-functional work** across Product, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and Creative without formal authority.

 - You **hold strong points of view** with senior stakeholders and change them when the evidence changes.

 - You **use AI to improve your work** and build workflows that improve the quality or velocity of the broader team.

##### Digital Marketing Director

Project Slingshot exists to drag the truth into the light and break apart Big Ag's deliberately constructed illusion.

This is a remote position based in the US.

##### The Role

As Digital Marketing Director (US) you will lead our US marketing strategy, making sure our campaigns are not just seen, but felt. You'll build and run high-impact digital, email and paid media programs that mobilize supporters, grow audiences, and put Slingshot in front of the people who can shift this fight.

You'll work closely with our global team, but with the autonomy to localize and innovate for the US context – ensuring every piece of content, every email and every ad campaign resonates, drives action, and delivers ambitious, measurable outcomes. You will know how to leverage cultural moments that help to seed marketing narratives among targeted audiences, and influence them to act.

In this role you will manage a Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager to help drive engagement across our marketing and social activities in support of our campaign efforts.

##### What You'll Do

Digital strategy & execution Design and implement bold, high-impact digital and social media strategies tailored to US audiences, reaching diverse and varied communities. Drive paid media campaigns (primarily META and other key platforms), ensuring ROI and audience growth. Use data, testing and insights to evolve strategies and stay ahead of trends. Localize global campaign moments for the US market without losing the force of the original idea. Own the US marketing calendar and make sure it lines up with campaign and creative plans.

Email & CRM Lead segmented email marketing campaigns that drive engagement, action and donor conversion. Build automations and journeys that nurture supporters through the funnel. Constantly refine audience segmentation and personalization. Partner with fundraising to make sure marketing and giving journeys reinforce each other.

Content & storytelling

Oversee creation of disruptive, compelling and on-brand digital content (copy, visuals, video). Craft impactful storytelling and copywriting that inspires, provokes and mobilizes. Ensure consistency and quality across all channels. Brief and work closely with our creative team to turn campaign strategy into work that travels. Cultivate influences relationships, partnerships and collaborations that deliver innovative story telling and expand audience reach and engagement.

Analytics & optimization Monitor KPIs across social, email and digital campaigns. Produce actionable insights from analytics to inform strategy. Use performance data to test, iterate and continually improve. Report clearly to leadership on what is working, what is not, and what you are changing as a result.

Leadership & collaboration Build and mentor a Digital Marketing & Social Media Manager. Collaborate closely with global colleagues to align strategies, share learnings and identify opportunities. Ensure US digital campaigns amplify and complement Project Slingshot's global campaigns. Manage agency, freelance, influencer and platform relationships in the US market.

##### Requirements

We'd love someone who: Has significant experience in digital marketing, campaign strategy or movement-building – ideally with a cause-driven brand or a bold advocacy group. Is deeply familiar with social justice messaging, digital organizing and content-led engagement strategies. Has led teams and knows how to develop teams to deliver results. Has proven success in social media, paid ads and email/CRM strategies. Knows META Ads Manager, email marketing platforms (e.g. GetResponse, Mailchimp, Campaign Monitor or similar), analytics tools and automation systems in depth. Is skilled at using audience insights to craft strategies that inspire action. Writes strong copy, with a knack for storytelling that is bold, disruptive and emotionally compelling. Has a track record of driving audience growth and measurable impact. Is data-driven, experimental, and never satisfied with "good enough". Brings knowledge or experience of farmed animal advocacy, broader animal protection, or high-profile nonprofit campaigning – with the ability to translate complex issues into powerful, public-facing narratives. Is passionate about Project Slingshot's mission and hungry to play a part in ending factory farming.

##### Success Looks Like

Growing audience size and engagement across platforms, with clear evidence of what is driving it. Lead acquisition, conversion rates and supporter retention are all improving. High-impact US campaigns are landing – measured in reach, earned media and actions taken. Internal marketing processes are strong and cross-team collaboration is working without friction. Slingshot has real cultural presence and brand salience across US social justice spaces.

##### Benefits

This role is remote and based in the United States. Project Slingshot is a fully remote organization. Most collaboration happens online, and you will have regular overlap with colleagues in the UK. There will occasionally be opportunities and expectations to travel for team meet-ups, campaign shoots, conferences, planning sessions and other in-person events. Travel costs will be covered by Project Slingshot.

The Practical Details Location: Remote, US,, with some travel for in-person meetings Reports to: Chief Executive Officer, Co-Founders Compensation: $80,000 – $100,000 per year. Placement within the range is based on experience and location. Benefits: Paid time off, paid holidays, pension contribution

$150k - $165k

Monkee-Boy Web Design Inc

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Reports to: CMO

Direct Reports: 3-4 in-house specialists, 3-4 contractors

Please read the entirety of this job description. While we are values-driven and love to connect with people, only those who read the entire posting will be considered for the role.

Monkee-Boy is seeking an experienced Digital Marketing Director to lead strategy development and execution oversight for our growing digital marketing agency, which specializes in local service businesses.

We’re a digital strategy and execution company on a mission to help businesses thrive in the wild web. We do this by creating and growing compelling, accessible, easy-to-use, and effective digital experiences for our clients. We’re a company built on strong values and long-term relationships—both with our clients and our team. We believe in treating people as individuals, maintaining open communication, and creating an environment where everyone can do their best work.

This is a pivotal role for someone who thrives on developing comprehensive marketing strategies, managing multi-channel campaigns, and building scalable processes. You’ll be responsible for ensuring clients achieve measurable growth through our sprint-based delivery model while managing a hybrid team of in-house specialists and contractors. This role is positioned to grow into VP of Operations as we scale.

Does this sound like you?

You’re a strategic thinker who can also roll up your sleeves and execute. You understand the “why” behind marketing strategies and can translate that into actionable plans and measurable results.

You have deep expertise in digital marketing across multiple disciplines - SEO, PPC/Paid Media, content strategy, analytics, conversion optimization, and marketing automation. You know how these pieces work together to drive business results.

You’re a natural leader and mentor who enjoys developing talent, refining processes, and building systems that scale. You’ve successfully managed client relationships and internal teams.

You practice active listening and can unpack complex client needs, translating business objectives into marketing strategies. You handle client concerns with empathy and urgency while protecting team processes and company policies.

You’re equally comfortable presenting to C-suite executives as you are training junior team members. You can explain technical marketing concepts to non-technical audiences and make data-driven recommendations that clients understand and trust.

You have an ownership mindset - you see opportunities before they become problems, you document processes, you look for efficiencies, and you take initiative without waiting to be told.

You’re endlessly curious about marketing trends, testing methodologies, and what drives results across different industries and business models.

Primary Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership (40%)

Develop comprehensive quarterly marketing strategies for all client accounts

Lead client strategy sessions and quarterly business reviews

Create and maintain service delivery playbooks for all five service categories

Design custom sprint combinations to achieve each client’s specific goals

Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts

Ensure strategies align with each client’s industry, competition, and target audience

Execution Oversight (30%)

Plan and allocate monthly marketing sprints across all accounts

Manage sprint execution through a hybrid team of employees and contractors

Ensure consistent quality standards across all deliverables

Monitor sprint completion rates and delivery timelines

Coordinate between service areas for integrated campaign delivery

Oversee implementation of website, content, SEO, and local marketing initiatives

Team & Contractor Management (20%)

Build and manage a network of reliable freelance contractors

Assign sprints to appropriate team members based on expertise

Conduct weekly check-ins with core contractors

Review and approve contractor deliverables

Mentor in-house team members on strategy and best practices

Foster collaboration between in-house staff and contractors

Performance & Optimization (10%)

Establish KPIs and success metrics for each client

Analyze campaign performance across all channels

Prepare monthly and quarterly performance reports

Identify optimization opportunities and testing priorities

Lead conversion rate optimization initiatives

Present results and recommendations to clients

Required Qualifications
Experience

6+ years of digital marketing experience with progressive responsibility

2+ years in an agency environment (preferred)

Proven track record managing multi-channel campaigns for SMB clients

Experience with local service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, legal, medical, home services)

Demonstrated success in improving lead generation and conversion rates

Portfolio of successful client campaigns with measurable results

Technical Skills

Website/UX: Understanding of CRO, Core Web Vitals, user experience principles

SEO Expertise: Technical SEO, local SEO, content optimization, link building

Content Marketing: Content strategy, buyer journey mapping, email marketing

Local Marketing: Google Business Profile optimization, review management, citations

Paid Media Management: paid search, paid social, display, retargeting, PerformanceMax

Analytics/Reporting: GA4, Google Search Console, call tracking, attribution modeling, Looker Studio Reports

Strategic Capabilities

Ability to develop comprehensive, multi-channel marketing strategies

Experience with marketing campaign/sprint planning and execution

Strong understanding of local service business models, lead generation and customer acquisition

Capability to translate business goals into actionable marketing plans

Experience managing budgets and allocating resources effectively

Leadership & Communication

Excellent client presentation and communication skills

Ability to manage and motivate hybrid teams (in-house and remote contractors)

Strong project management and organizational abilities

Experience leading client strategy sessions and QBRs

Comfort with ambiguity and building processes from scratch

Preferred Qualifications

Google Ads Certification and experience managing PPC campaigns

Experience with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, MailChimp)

Knowledge of technical SEO and website development basics

Previous experience building and scaling agency operations

Track record of creating SOPs and training materials

Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.We’re hiring a Marketing Communications Director in Austin, TX. This position will focus on developing and implementing communications and marketing plans that promote the American Heart Association’s strategic priorities, events, and cause initiatives. This role reports to the Executive Director.This is an office-based position that offers a hybrid schedule in a fast-paced environment. The office is in Austin, TX.Responsibilities involve working with the Executive Director, Development Directors, and Community Impact Directors to build and implement strategic marketing campaigns and deliverables to support major fundraising events; to develop communications and marketing relationships and strategies to deepen engagement with existing sponsors and high-level volunteers for major events. Responsibilities

Develops and implements local strategic communications plans that promote the American Heart Association's nationally driven priorities, local events, community impact, Science news, and cause initiatives.Writes, distributes, and pitches news releases and other supporting media materials to local traditional and non-traditional media.Secures media sponsorships for local events and priority initiatives, as appropriate.Implements awareness campaigns around heart and stroke-related topics and works collaboratively with other key market staff to develop an integrated approach to such campaigns.Works with staff to ensure that national branding guidelines are followed.Develops and implements communications plans for sponsor-funded activations.Coordinates and implements communications plans in conjunction with strategic alliances.Identifies, secures, and media trains local spokespersons.Provides marketing and communications support for development and fundraising events and activations, as appropriate.Identifies human interest stories for media coverage, social media posts, internal and external communications channels, and event integration.Tracks all media coverage via a media tracking system and manages a spokesperson database. Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in communications, marketing, public relations, journalism or related field, or equivalent experience.Requires a minimum of 3 years of work experience in communications, social media, public relations, and journalism, or any equivalent combination of training and work experience.Experience applying the principles and practices of communications and marketing to the non-profit environment.Experience working as a team member with multiple internal and external constituencies at varying levels: staff, media, external corporations, and volunteers.Experience with crisis communications and sensitive issues.Experience implementing communications campaigns, pitching to media, planning media events, and writing news releases.Exceptional oral and written communications skills, including experience with speech writing, news writing for broadcast and print, and general business writing.Working knowledge of news media operations, newsgathering, and technology.Must have at least intermediate knowledge and skills with Microsoft Office for word processing, email, PowerPoint, and spreadsheets.Ability to do daily local travel approximately 70%; requires access to reliable transportation at all times on an immediate basis.Intermediate knowledge and experience using Canva preferred.

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. # Head of Digital Marketing

ICBD Holdings

[Fort Lauderdale, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Fort-Lauderdale%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8180243683444692000?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9251&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4024640524923109814&crId=US_0US_0)

About ICBD ICBD is a robust single-family office focused on private investment and business development, supporting exceptional companies in healthcare, technology, and beyond.
We own and operate a growing portfolio of high-performance businesses united by a shared commitment to people, operational excellence, and long-term value creation. But we’re not just building businesses – we’re building a legacy of leadership, innovation, and purpose.
Joining ICBD means you’ll be part of the team behind some of the fastest-growing companies in healthcare, technology, and business services. We are proudly self-funded, committed to sustainable growth, and led by visionary thought leaders—including our CEO and Founder, the 2024 Ernst & Young U.S. Entrepreneur of The Year® National Overall Award winner.
Our most visible success is ABA Centers, a revolutionary leader in autism care and diagnostics, ranked #5 on the 2024 Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.
The ICBD portfolio includes these dynamic organizations united by strategic vision, operational expertise, and unwavering commitment to excellence:
ABA Centers – The leading provider of autism care in the U.S., with 13 regional brands and 70+ operating areas.
GateHouse Treatment – A comprehensive network of substance use disorder programs that address the full spectrum of recovery needs from medical treatment to supportive housing and respite services.
Marquis MD – A concierge medicine concept redefining healthcare by prioritizing convenience, connection, and care powered by advanced technology.
Exact Billing Solutions – Innovative revenue cycle management and advanced billing support systems for healthcare providers.
The Christopher M. Barnett Family Foundation – The philanthropic heart of ICBD, advancing programs that address autism care, food insecurity, homelessness, women’s empowerment, and underserved children.
Recognition & Awards At ICBD, our commitment to operational excellence, ethical leadership, and transformative care has earned us recognition across industries. Our portfolio companies and leadership team have been honored with multiple awards, including:
Inc. 5000 – 5th Fastest-Growing Private Company in America (2024).
Financial Times – #1 on “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies.”
EY Entrepreneur of The Year® U.S. Overall.
South Florida Business Journal’s Top 100 Companies.
Florida Trend Magazine’s 500 Most Influential Business Leaders.
Inc. Best in Business, Health Services
The Role Overview As VP, Head of Digital Marketing, you will lead all efforts in the digital space. In this highly visible leadership role, you will define and execute the enterprise digital growth strategy across all channels, driving measurable demand generation, brand visibility, and patient acquisition outcomes across a high growth portfolio of operating companies.
You will lead a high-performing, multi-discipline digital team and act as the strategic owner of performance marketing, digital experience, marketing technology, and AI-enabled growth disciplines including emerging search and discovery ecosystems.
Key Responsibilities Digital Strategy & Growth Leadership Define and lead the enterprise-wide digital marketing strategy aligned to customer acquisition, brand growth, and revenue objectives.
Own the end-to-end digital funnel strategy, optimizing across awareness, acquisition, conversion, and retention using a “test and learn” approach with a focus on continuous improvement.
Translate business priorities into scalable, data-driven digital campaigns that deliver measurable performance outcomes.
Be accountable for ROI of all digital marketing efforts, tracking metrics on all campaigns.
AI, GEO & Next-Generation Search Leadership Lead strategy for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to ensure strong brand visibility across AI-driven answer engines, generative search platforms, and large language model ecosystems.
Drive AI Search (AEO) initiatives to strengthen discoverability across evolving search behaviors and conversational interfaces.
Establish frameworks to optimize content, structured data, and digital assets for both traditional search engines and generative AI discovery systems.
Evaluate and implement AI-powered marketing technologies that enhance targeting, personalization, content generation, and performance.
Stay ahead of emerging trends in generative AI, multimodal search, and AI-mediated consumer journeys.
Performance Marketing & Channel Ownership Oversee all digital performance channels including SEO, SEM, PPC, paid social, email automation, and CRM-driven lifecycle marketing.
Drive continuous optimization to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.
Ensure consistent execution across enterprise, multi-location, and clinic-level marketing initiatives.
Analytics, Measurement & Optimization Own digital marketing measurement frameworks, attribution modeling, and ROI reporting across all channels.
Build and institutionalize a culture of experimentation, A/B testing, and rapid optimization.
Deliver actionable insights into the full digital patient journey, from first touch through conversion and retention.
Budget & Resource Management Develop, manage, and optimize digital marketing budgets across enterprise, regional, and clinic-level allocations.
Allocate investment based on performance data, scalability, and strategic growth priorities.
Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing digital marketing organization across multiple disciplines, including the areas of SEO, SEM, email automation, PPC, and social media.
Partner closely with clinical operations, sales, analytics, and executive leadership to align marketing strategy with organizational goals.
Influence senior stakeholders through clear, data-driven insights and strategic recommendations.
Qualifications, Personal Attributes & Education Education: This role requires a minimum of a BS/BA in Marketing, Business Administration or relevant field.
Experience: 10 + years of progressive leadership experience in digital marketing.
Proven success driving measurable growth in complex, multi-location or multi-brand environments through highly sophisticated digital marketing strategies.
Technical & Functional Expertise: Deep expertise in performance marketing including SEO, SEM, PPC, paid social, and lifecycle or email marketing.
Strong experience with marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar.
Hands-on experience with AI-powered marketing tools, automation platforms, and analytics ecosystems.
Deep understanding of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), including how content is surfaced, ranked, and synthesized by AI-driven search and answer engines.
Strong knowledge of AI Search (AEO), modern SEO, and evolving discovery ecosystems.
Advanced data analytical skills with expertise in attribution modeling, performance tracking, and ROI optimization
Personal Attributes: Highly responsive, execution-oriented leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and rapid change.
Strong executive presence and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
Proven ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing marketing teams.
Must be confident and decisive but be a good listener and be highly flexible/adaptable.
Willingness to travel nationwide (10-15%) to support marketing initiatives, events, and strategic partnerships.
Location, Travel and Role Expectations This is a full-time position based in ICBD’s corporate offices in Fort Lauderdale, FL with ability to travel as needed; possibly for extended periods of time.
Compliance with all applicable laws, professional responsibility obligations, and Company policies.
Compensation and Benefits Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
21 paid days off (15 days of PTO, which increases with tenure, plus 6 holidays).
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.
Medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and life insurance.
Generous 401(k) with up to 6% employer match.
Closing Statement ICBD is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to building an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
ICBD participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and employment. If you require assistance or accommodation, please let us know.

Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.About this position:We're looking for a VP of Growth Marketing to own the marketing to revenue generation engine. This is a player-coach role: you'll lead a team of 12+ product marketers, marketing channel experts, and growth marketers, owning product marketing for both our brand and creator audiences and, on the growth side, paid media, SEO/AEO, email and in-app lifecycle, CRO and web, and ABM. You'll also carry work yourself, building the model, writing the brief, reading the attribution, and stepping directly into a channel when it needs a senior operator. You'll own the growth marketing budget and be accountable for driving measurable action across the full customer journey, acquisition, retention, expansion, and reactivation, and for pipeline, signups, and revenue across all three lines of business (Later Influence, Later Social, and Creator/Affiliate). You'll partner closely with Sales, Product, Product Marketing, RevOps, and Web, and you'll have regular exposure to executive leadership. This role is ideally a hybrid position with 3 days in office in our Boston or New York hubs, but remote applicants are considered.What you'll be doing:Growth strategy and ownershipOwn Later's growth # Vice President, Growth Marketing

Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM)

[Alexandria, VA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Alexandria%2C-VA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-92706345400628560?p=1&pos=0&rgn=2882&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8846437044196822775&crId=US_0US_0)

### Summary

The Vice President, Growth Marketing is responsible for developing and executing SHRM’s Business-to-Moment (B2M) growth strategy, aligning marketing efforts with customer needs, behaviors, and moments of opportunity to drive measurable business results. This leader leverages emerging marketing capabilities—including AI, audience intelligence, journey orchestration, personalization, modern search and discovery, experimentation, and performance media—to accelerate revenue growth across SHRM’s consumer and business markets.

The Vice President leads the end-to-end growth marketing function, translating business priorities and customer insights into integrated strategies spanning brand, content, digital experience, e-commerce, demand generation, and sales enablement. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring the ability to set strategic direction, lead execution, and continuously optimize performance through data-driven experimentation and measurement.

Success is primarily measured by revenue growth, including increased sales of SHRM memberships, certifications, and HR-related products through direct e-commerce and qualified demand generation for corporate sales.

### Responsibilities

- **Growth Strategy** : Develop and execute an integrated B2M growth strategy aligned with SHRM’s business priorities, revenue objectives, and customer needs.

- **Revenue Generation** : Drive revenue growth across memberships, certifications, and HR-related products by improving customer acquisition, conversion, e-commerce performance, and qualified corporate sales pipeline.

- **Integrated Marketing** : Align brand, content, digital experience, e-commerce, demand generation, and sales enablement to deliver cohesive customer experiences and measurable business outcomes.

- **Customer Journey and Personalization** : Leverage audience intelligence, customer signals, journey orchestration, and personalization to identify high-value moments and deliver relevant, timely engagement.

- **Marketing Technology and AI** : Apply AI, automation, modern search and discovery capabilities, and emerging marketing technologies to improve marketing effectiveness, scalability, and customer experiences.

- **Performance Optimization** : Establish and manage performance metrics, experimentation, and measurement frameworks to evaluate results, optimize investments, and improve marketing contribution to revenue.

- **Customer Lifecycle and Retention** : Improve member engagement, loyalty, retention, customer lifetime value, and cross-sell and upsell performance through targeted lifecycle strategies.

- **Cross-Functional Leadership** : Partner with business leaders and teams across sales, product, content, technology, and operations to align marketing priorities, coordinate execution, and accelerate growth.

- **Team and Capability Development** : Build and develop a high-performing growth marketing team with the capabilities, operating model, and tools needed to deliver sustained business results.

### Education & Experience Requirements

### Education

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Master’s degree preferred.

### Experience

- Fifteen (15) or more years progressive experience leading growth marketing, digital marketing, demand generation, e-commerce, or integrated marketing functions, including leadership at the director or senior director level.

- Demonstrated success developing and executing marketing strategies that deliver measurable revenue growth, customer acquisition, and conversion.

- Experience managing marketing performance, budgets, and investment decisions using data, analytics, and business outcomes.

- Experience applying marketing technology, AI-enabled capabilities, automation, personalization, and experimentation to improve business performance.

- Experience leading cross-functional teams and translating enterprise priorities into actionable marketing strategies.

### Certifications - NA

### Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong commercial acumen and ability to connect marketing strategy to revenue generation and business growth.

- Expertise in growth marketing, customer acquisition, e-commerce, demand generation, and customer lifecycle management.

- Ability to translate customer insights, behavioral signals, and market trends into effective growth strategies.

- Knowledge of marketing technology, AI-enabled marketing, audience intelligence, personalization, journey orchestration, and performance media.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to use marketing performance data to guide decisions, evaluate return on investment, and optimize results.

- Demonstrated ability to set strategic direction while remaining accountable for execution and measurable outcomes.

- Strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions.

- Ability to lead experimentation, adapt to changing customer behaviors, and continuously improve marketing effectiveness.

- Ability to effectively leverage artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and improve overall work quality.

### Physical Requirements

This position operates in a typical office environment (which includes a home office setting) and requires the ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation. Physical requirements may include:

- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

- Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and using office equipment.

- Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching.

- Ability to lift and carry up to 30 pounds as needed.

- Clear verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with colleagues and stakeholders.

### Work Environment

### Hybrid Schedule (3 Days In-Office/2 Days Remote)

This position follows a hybrid work schedule, with Tuesday through Thursday in office and Monday and Friday remote. Employees must be available during standard business hours, with core hours beginning between 8:00–9:00 a.m. and concluding between 5:00–6:00 p.m. local time.

### Travel: Occasional 0 – 10%

#LI

The hiring range for this position is $180,000 to $230,000 per year. This range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications. SHRM offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package. The benefits for this position include professional growth and development, health, dental, vision, well-being, health savings, flexible spending, retirement, open leave, and annual discretionary bonus and incentives.

# Head of Performance Marketing/ CMO

Full-time

Melotech

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3138284913958419763?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=378&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5574053603373795814&crId=US_0US_0)

## **Who we are** Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide. Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, Melotech has raised more than $16M from Drive Capital and Europe’s leading VCs: Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and Global Founders Capital, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

## **What you will do**

Your mission as Head of Performance Marketing is to get us in front of every person on the planet through scalable performance marketing across all major platforms. You tackle the critical questions: How can our ads dominate TikTok or Snapchat, convert amazingly on Instagram or Facebook, and scale on Google and YouTube? Which formats and targeting drive results, not just clicks? And how can we launch new campaigns in minutes instead of days with the help of AI? Working fully autonomously alongside our founder and the team, your answers to these questions will directly influence our company's success. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

- Developing and maintaining a comprehensive brand, targeting and content strategy optimized for paid marketing

- Setting up and managing campaigns at scale across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google, TikTok, Snapchat and other platforms

- Building and scaling creative production workflows to generate endless content variations with the help of AI

- Optimizing campaign performance through large-scale A/B testing to maximize reach, conversion and revenue

- Staying ahead of trends across social media platforms to lead the curve in our creatives rather than follow it

- Building comprehensive libraries of visual assets, prompts, and workflows for rapid content iteration

- Managing partners in a scalable yet productive manner

- Collaborating with our engineering team to optimize processes, systems and outputs


## **Who you are**

You're a performance marketing powerhouse with extensive experience in paid ads. Your expertise lies in managing hundreds of simultaneous campaigns while maintaining creativity and artistic attention to detail. Typically, your profile will look like this:

- Degree in Marketing, Business, Mathematics, or related quantitative field

- 3+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, preferably in creative industry or entertainment marketing

- Expert-level proficiency across Facebook Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, and Snapchat Ads

- Proven track record managing 100+ simultaneous campaigns and conducting large scale A/B testing on creative

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to read performance data and make rapid campaign optimization decisions

- Self-directed approach thriving in fast-paced, metric-driven environments focused on cultural impact

- You thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

- Colleagues would describe you as hard-working, ambitious and persistent

- You’re obsessed with music, video or social media


## **What makes this exciting**

You are one of the first employees of an ambitious team, changing the world of media and entertainment. Being early means every decision you make shapes our trajectory. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

## **What the process will look like**

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

1. **Online assessment** : Motivational questionnaire and aptitude test - are you made for the job?

2. **Initial interview** : 30-minute introductory call - getting to know you

3. **Take-home case study** : Real-world project - showcase your skills and working style

4. **Case interview** : 90-minute case discussion - present and debate your results with a team member

5. **Founder interview** : 90-minute interview with our CEO - going deep on all topics

6. **Team interview** : Individual or group interview with other team members - depending on position

7. **Offer, contract signing and onboarding**


**Note** : As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

# Director of Performance Marketing

Addison Group

[Austin, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Austin%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7302132278671647149?p=1&pos=0&rgn=47831&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2379791922001821208&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Director of Performance Marketing

We are seeking an experienced Director of Performance Marketing with a strong background in B2C performance marketing, marketing analytics, digital media, and measurement strategy. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who combines sophisticated marketing analytics expertise with the ability to influence business leaders and remain actively involved in the work. This is not a traditional brand marketing position.

The successful candidate will use data and performance insights to guide significant marketing investments, evaluate media effectiveness, and help business leaders determine where and how marketing dollars should be deployed.

The role supports a multi-market organization where regional business units have responsibility for their own marketing investments while operating under one unified consumer brand. The Director will help connect those two priorities by developing performance strategies that support individual markets while maintaining consistency across the broader organization.

Experience marketing high-consideration consumer purchases is required. Relevant backgrounds may include hospitality, resorts, travel, entertainment, luxury or premium consumer products, automotive, high-end retail, or other industries where consumers make significant, research-driven purchasing decisions.

The Director of Performance Marketing will:

- Develop and advance performance marketing strategies across multiple consumer markets.
- Use marketing data and analytics to recommend how advertising budgets should be allocated across channels and initiatives.
- Evaluate campaign and media effectiveness using measurement, attribution, and marketing-mix methodologies.
- Translate complex performance data into clear recommendations for senior executives and business leaders.
- Develop presentations and business cases that demonstrate marketing performance, opportunities, and recommended investment strategies.
- Partner with regional leaders to understand market-specific priorities and advise them on effective use of their marketing budgets.
- Collaborate with digital advertising, content, website, technology, analytics, and marketing communications teams.
- Work with external media, advertising, technology, and agency partners as needed.
- Identify opportunities to improve advertising effectiveness, measurement capabilities, and return on marketing investment.
- Balance regional marketing needs with the goal of presenting one consistent brand to consumers.
- Challenge assumptions and facilitate productive conversations about marketing strategy, performance, and spending.
- Remain hands-on with analysis, presentations, strategy development, and problem solving rather than operating solely as a people manager.
- Contribute to broader marketing analytics and measurement initiatives across the organization.

Qualifications include:

- Approximately 10–15 years of progressive experience in performance marketing, digital marketing, marketing science, media analytics, or a closely related discipline.
- Significant B2C marketing experience required.
- Strong knowledge of digital advertising strategy and performance measurement.
- Demonstrated experience with marketing attribution, media optimization, measurement strategy, and/or marketing mix modeling.
- Ability to analyze marketing performance and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
- Experience advising senior leaders on significant marketing investments and budget allocation.
- Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
- Experience working across multiple locations, markets, business units, or regional teams.
- Ability to operate successfully in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.
- Comfortable partnering with both technical/data-oriented teams and business-facing marketing leaders.
- Willingness to remain highly involved in day-to-day strategy, analytics, and deliverables.
- Experience marketing high-consideration, premium, or complex consumer purchases strongly preferred.
- A combination of corporate/in-house and agency experience is preferred.
- Experience within a decentralized, franchise, multi-location, or regional operating model is a plus.
- Previous leadership experience is beneficial but is not required for candidates being considered for a remote individual-contributor structure.

# Director of Performance Marketing

$170k - $185k

Visual Comfort

[Houston, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Houston%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1667683207208828187?p=1&pos=0&rgn=46481&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6788227163336872635&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Performance Marketing Manager

Visual Comfort & Co. is the premier resource for decorative and architectural lighting, ceiling fans, system controls and automated shading solutions from the most influential designers in the world. We are proud to offer a market-leading range of premium products across categories, styles and price points, remaining committed to beautiful design and, above all, a world-class customer experience.

This role is responsible for collaborating with Sales, CRM, Brand & Creative, Ecommerce, Product Marketing, and Analytics to lead customer acquisition and performance marketing across the business. Duties include developing and executing integrated, full-funnel strategies that accelerate profitable growth across Consumer, Trade, and key commercial channels; driving Consumer acquisition across digital and physical retail while building sophisticated acquisition strategies for the Trade customer; and leading investment and performance across Paid Search, Shopping, Paid Social, Affiliate, Display, CTV/Video, and emerging channels. This role supports Sales with translating commercial priorities into targeted audience and media strategies that create demand across the business and connect marketing investment to broader business priorities.

Visual Comfort Offers:

- Work-Life Balance: Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm
- Training & Development: A comprehensive and structured training program, complemented by ongoing education and opportunities for career advancement.
- Paid Time Off: Generous vacation accrual and paid time off policies.
- Holidays: 7 paid holidays per year, in addition to 2 floating holidays.
- Compensation: Competitive compensation plan
- Health Benefits: Visual Comfort covers the majority of employee medical premiums, and offers competitive vision and dental coverage available starting the first of the month following your start date.
- Insurance: Company-provided life insurance and short-term disability coverage.
- Retirement: 401(k) plan with company matching up to 4%, available beginning the first of the month following your hire date.

How Success Is Defined:

- Develop and lead Visual Comfort's enterprise customer acquisition strategy across Consumer, Trade, and key commercial opportunities, driving profitable growth across digital and physical retail channels.
- Manage strategy, investment, and performance across Paid Search, Shopping, Paid Social, Affiliate, Display, CTV/Video, and emerging acquisition channels, including annual and seasonal media planning, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization.
- Identify and analyze new audiences, channels, markets, and growth opportunities, balancing near-term revenue objectives with customer quality, lifetime value, incrementality, marketing efficiency, and long-term profitable growth.
- Collaborate with Sales, CRM, and Analytics to develop differentiated audience and acquisition strategies for Trade, Retail/Showrooms, Wholesale, and other business priorities, while supporting customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
- Develop and manage a rigorous testing strategy across audiences, channels, creative, messaging, and landing experiences, leveraging performance and customer insights to drive continuous improvement.
- Partner with Brand & Creative, CRM & Lifecycle, and Ecommerce to optimize channel-specific creative, customer journeys, landing experiences, merchandising, conversion, retention, and reactivation while maintaining Visual Comfort's premium brand positioning.
- Monitor and communicate marketing effectiveness across new customer growth, CAC, incremental revenue, ROAS/MER, conversion, customer quality, attribution, incrementality, and lifetime value; prepare forecasts, investment recommendations, and performance narratives for the CMO and senior leadership.
- Lead and develop a high-performing performance marketing team over time, manage agency and external media partners, and foster a culture of experimentation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
- Works effectively with others in a team environment to accomplish organizational goals and to identify and resolve problems. Exhibits and adheres to the established Visual Comfort Company Values.
- Must demonstrate commitment, dependability, punctuality, and adherence to agreed-upon schedule while maintaining a consistent presence in the workplace to effectively collaborate and communicate amongst co-workers and teams.

What You Will Bring:

- 8 - 12+ years' previous experience in performance marketing, growth marketing and/or customer acquisition, ideally within premium consumer, retail, ecommerce, home, fashion and/or luxury-oriented businesses
- College graduate; advanced degree and/or relevant certification a plus
- Strong aptitude for and proficiency navigating performance marketing systems and platforms, including Paid Search/Shopping, Paid Social, Affiliate, Display, CTV/Video and emerging channels
- Experience developing and scaling multi-channel customer acquisition, audience and media strategies across digital and physical customer journeys, with a strong understanding of customer acquisition economics, LTV, incrementality, attribution and marketing effectiveness
- Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with a strong attention to detail and demonstrated experience managing significant media investments and agency relationships
- Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and changing priorities, while effectively navigating between enterprise strategy and detailed performance
- Ability to achieve results both independently and through others by fostering a spirit of teamwork and cooperation, including strong cross-functional partnership across Sales, Marketing, Ecommerce and Analytics
- Demonstrate exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate commercial priorities into customer audiences and actionable marketing strategies
- Commercially minded and intellectually curious, with a strong understanding of the relationship between media, creative, customer experience and conversion
- Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered for this role

Compensation Range: $170,000 - $185,000

Compensation is based on individual factors, including skill set, relevant experience, and work location

Qualified applicants are considered for employment, and employees are treated during employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

To be eligible for this role, you must be authorized to work in the United States. We do not offer any type of employment-based immigration sponsorship for this role. Likewise, Visual Comfort & Co., will not provide any assistance or sign any documentation in support of any other form of immigration sponsorship or benefit including optional practical training (OPT) or curricular practical training (CPT).

We have a responsibility and privilege to honor the voices of those whose stories we tell.

We approach our content with empathy, compassion, and a genuine desire to make a difference. Advocacy is an essential part of the Audiochuck culture as we strive to positively impact victims and their families through the use of our time, money, and resources.

Committed to developing our people and fostering a long-term team of talented media professionals, we are seeking a commercially minded advertising operations leader to own the performance and delivery of our advertising business.

About the Director of Ad Operations

The Director of Ad Operations is a senior, cross-functional role responsible for owning advertising performance and delivery across Audiochuck's portfolio of shows, including Crime Junkie, the #1 most-downloaded true crime podcast in the United States.

Reporting to the CEO, this role is the senior point of accountability for an advertising business that touches Revenue, Content, Production, Marketing, Finance, and our third-party sales partner. The Director owns the internal systems, processes, analytics, and cross-functional workflows behind our advertising, ensuring that what is sold can be delivered and that campaigns are executed flawlessly without compromising our editorial standards, audience trust, or mission.

Our third-party sales partner leads much of our advertising sales activity. While this role is not responsible for direct ad sales, it is a critical commercial role. The Director will be Audiochuck's senior operational and commercial counterpart to our sales partner, using data and a deep understanding of our business to identify opportunities, advocate for Audiochuck's interests, challenge constructively when needed, and help maximize revenue.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable in a revenue model and a cross-functional workflow, and who can balance commercial opportunity with brand, editorial, and audience considerations.

What You’ll Do

Campaign Operations & Execution

- Own the end-to-end internal advertising workflow, with clear processes, decision points, and handoffs from opportunity through approval, production, and completion

- Review opportunities from our sales partner to ensure they can be delivered without compromising quality, editorial standards, or the client experience

- Build visibility into campaign placement, flighting, delivery, and make-goods so Audiochuck always understands campaign status and performance

- Proactively identify risks, then escalate and resolve issues with our sales partner and internal teams

- Oversee and support the Senior Ad Ops Specialist and continuously improve the systems and controls behind ad delivery, including Salesforce and AdsWizz


Commercial Performance & Sales Partner Management

- Serve as Audiochuck's senior operational and commercial counterpart to our third-party sales partner, advocating for our interests and challenging constructively when appropriate

- Own deal-level pricing and CPM analysis, assessing each opportunity for financial value, brand fit, and operational feasibility

- Present opportunities to the CEO and relevant hosts for approval with a clear recommendation

- Act as the primary conduit between our sales partner and internal teams so information, decisions, and feedback move quickly in both directions

- Monitor the sales partner's monthly reporting and performance against contractual obligations, including impression delivery and decline percentages


Revenue Operations & Analytics

- Own the RevOps Scorecard, bottom-up revenue models, and forecasts, providing clear and actionable reporting for the CEO, executive team, and Board

- Improve forecast accuracy and clearly explain performance, trends, and drivers of variance

- Build visibility into inventory, demand, utilization, sell-through, advertiser and category mix, RPM and CPM trends, and placement performance

- Translate data into action, going beyond reporting what happened to recommend where Audiochuck should focus and where it can perform better


Editorial Standards & Brand Alignment

- Partner with Content and Production to protect the editorial standards, host considerations, and brand parameters that shape what Audiochuck will and will not accept

- Ensure advertisers, campaigns, and integrations move through the appropriate internal review and QC processes

- Surface advertiser expectations and editorial requirements early, and act as a senior escalation point when they need to be reconciled


Commercial Opportunities & Custom Solutions

- Develop a strong understanding of Audiochuck's audiences, brands, and capabilities to recognize new commercial opportunities

- Identify advertiser categories and prospective clients that Audiochuck and our sales partner should pursue

- Partner with Content, Production, and Marketing on custom treatments and sponsorships that are compelling, achievable, and true to our editorial standards

- Stay closely involved in customized campaigns where internal knowledge or coordination is critical to success


Cross-Functional Leadership

- Build strong relationships across Revenue, Content, Production, Marketing, Finance, and Operations, with clear ownership so work does not fall between teams

- Balance the needs of advertisers, our sales partner, and internal stakeholders to deliver an excellent client experience without compromising what makes Audiochuck distinctive

- Move quickly on shifting priorities while maintaining rigorous quality standards and strong communication


What Success Looks Like

- What we sell is right for Audiochuck, what we promise is achievable, and what we deliver is flawless

- Every step of the advertising workflow has a clear owner, and work moves smoothly between teams

- Audiochuck has clear, regular visibility into campaign delivery, inventory, and sell-through

# Head of Lifecycle Marketing

Manychat

[Austin, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Austin%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1933474707382254096?p=1&pos=0&rgn=47831&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-9048553012523159392&crId=US_0US_0)

### WHO WE ARE

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

### WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We're seeking a Head of Lifecycle Marketing to own the entire customer journey from first touch to loyal advocate. You'll design and run the lifecycle engine that turns signups into activated users, free users into paying customers, and customers into long-term fans.

You will report to our VP of Growth Marketing and collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Product, Creative, Engineering, Analytics, and Content to build lifecycle programs that support our GTM motion and drive activation, conversion, retention, and expansion at scale.

### YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES

### Meet the Marketing team:

We're the voice of Manychat. A voice that's loud, creative, opinionated, and weird in the best possible way. We combine passion, data, and storytelling to cut through the noise and fuel mad growth.

### WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle strategy - onboarding, activation, free-to-paid conversion, engagement, retention, churn prevention, win-back, and expansion that is aligned with business objectives and audience segments.
- Build and orchestrate automated programs across email, in-product messaging, push, and chat channels, delivering the right message to the right user at the right moment.
- Design a segmentation and personalization framework based on user behavior, product usage, and audience type.
- Run a rigorous experimentation program: hypothesize, A/B test, measure, iterate. Every campaign should teach us something.
- Partner with Product Marketing and Product on launches, promotions, and feature-adoption campaigns; partner with Analytics to build the measurement infrastructure lifecycle deserves.
- Establish KPIs across the funnel (activation rate, trial conversion, retention curves, LTV, reactivation), report on performance, and translate insights into action.
- Own the lifecycle tech stack and continuously improve tooling and processes.
- Hire, lead, and develop a team of lifecycle marketers, setting a high bar for craft and speed.
- Stay ahead of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies (including AI-driven personalization) to keep our lifecycle engine world-class.

### TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE

### You’ll need

- 8+ years in lifecycle, CRM, or marketing automation ideally in product-led growth companies with a proven track record of moving activation, conversion, and retention metrics.
- Deep hands-on experience with a modern marketing automation platform (e.g., Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, HubSpot) and an understanding of deliverability, data flows, and event-based triggering.
- Strong analytical skills: you're fluent in funnel analysis, cohort retention, and experiment design, and comfortable in analytics tools.
- Experience leading and growing a team, with the communication skills to influence stakeholders at every level.
- Excellent project management: you prioritize ruthlessly, manage timelines, and deliver in a fast-paced environment.
- A creative, customer-obsessed mindset! You sweat the copy and the segmentation logic equally.
- Bonus: familiarity with the creator economy, chat marketing, or freemium business models.

### WHAT WE OFFER

### We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort

- Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.
- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents.
- Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.
- Work from where you need to — agreed with your team, not tied to a desk. Flexibility we built in on purpose, because location shouldn't get in the way of great work.
- In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.
- Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.
- AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.
