# Director, Affiliate Marketing

$130k - $200k

Rush Street Interactive

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4394839765259945285?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7212172957229881019&crId=US_0US_0)

Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI) is a market leader in online casino and sports betting, currently operating real-money gaming with our brands: BetRivers.com, PlaySugarHouse.com, and RushBet.co. We’re building bridges between online, social and land-based gaming businesses to create amazing, integrated experiences that keep players in the game.

We are seeking a Director, Affiliate Marketing to lead one of RSI’s largest and fastest-growing acquisition channels. Affiliate marketing has become a critical driver of new customer acquisition, and this leader will be responsible for evolving our strategy, technology, partner relationships, commercial model, and team as we continue expanding across regulated markets.

This is a highly visible leadership role that combines commercial ownership, technical expertise, people leadership, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll partner closely with Finance, Product, Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Legal, Compliance, BI, MarTech, and Performance Marketing while leading the strategic direction of RSI’s affiliate program.

What You’ll Do

Develop and execute RSI’s affiliate marketing strategy across all active and future regulated jurisdictions.

Build strategic relationships with leading affiliate partners and recruit new publishers.

Represent RSI at G2E, SBC Summit, ICE Barcelona, and iGB L!VE.

Lead affiliate strategy for new market launches.

Commercial Performance & Partner Economics

Own one of RSI’s largest acquisition budgets and optimize CPA structures using LTV and ROI.

Improve forecasting accuracy through stronger commercial governance and payment controls.

Partner with Finance on budgeting, accruals, and partner payment processes.

Affiliate Technology & Attribution

Own the affiliate technology roadmap from a Growth Marketing perspective.

Partner with MarTech, Product, and Engineering to improve attribution, measurement, and affiliate tracking.

Understand how affiliates acquire and convert users into a mobile-first business where a majority of revenue is generated through the app. Drive strategies that maximize app installs, deep linking, app-to-registration conversion, and mobile attribution.

Affiliate Operations & Compliance

Oversee affiliate operations across regulated jurisdictions.

Lead commission structure evolution, partner onboarding, and governance.

Partner with Legal and Compliance on licensing, T&Cs, responsible gaming, and fraud prevention.

Analytics & Business Intelligence

Partner with BI to operationalize partner-level LTV reporting and executive dashboards.

Use data to continuously optimize partner investment decisions.

Partner Enablement

Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing to ensure affiliates have access to current, high-performing marketing assets.

Develop scalable partner communications, business reviews, and promotional planning.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

Manage RSI’s Affiliate Manager while providing coaching, development, and strategic direction.

Oversee the managed services relationship with Affiliate Network, ensuring accountability, service quality, and continuous improvement.

Partner with Performance Marketing, CRM, Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and MarTech to drive integrated acquisition strategies.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Finance, Analytics, or related field preferred or equivalent relevant work experience.

10+ years of affiliate marketing experience, preferably within regulated gaming.

2+ years of people management experience.

Experience managing affiliate programs, agencies, or strategic partners.

Deep understanding of CPA, Rev Share, hybrid commission models, LTV, and ROI optimization.

Experience with Income Access, Impact, CJ, Partnerize, or similar platforms.

Strong commercial and analytical skills.

Excellent executive communication skills.

Ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Experience with a sportsbook or online casino operator, preferred.

Experience with AppsFlyer or other mobile measurement platforms, preferred.

Experience launching affiliate programs in newly regulated markets, preferred.

Knowledge of mobile attribution, deep linking, and app marketing, preferred.

Experience with Sigma, Tableau, or Power BI, preferred. #LI-REMOTE #LI-PROMOTE

# VP, Partner Marketing

LE200 Starz Entertainment, LLC

[Santa Monica, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Santa-Monica%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1768157782528057464?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6620&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5399105117086420073&crId=US_0US_0)

Job Description Maximize Starz Entertainment (STE) subscribers and revenue through marketing, promotional, and point-of-sale campaigns that position STE services with affiliated Distributors (MVPDs, OTT, OEMs, Mobile). This vital role serves as the strategic bridge between STE’s internal creative teams and our external distribution partners. The VP will leverage a deep understanding of distributor platforms to adapt STE overall content creative into highly effective partner campaigns, ultimately driving consumer demand, viewership, subscriber acquisition, and long term revenue.

### ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Annual Campaign Planning & Strategy: Define and execute year-round partner marketing strategies designed to drive subscriber acquisition, retention, and revenue growth across the affiliate and OTT ecosystem
- Marketing Strategy & Sell-In: Strategize on optimal marketing campaigns throughout the year to maximize revenue and effectively communicate STE’s high level content slate to distribution partners to successfully "sell in" marketing campaigns
- Creative Optimization: Collaborate directly with Originals Marketing, Brand, and Creative Services to ensure content creative is adapted and optimized for our partners' specific marketing channels for maximum effectiveness
- Operational Effectiveness: Work directly with marketing team to ensure efficient creation and distribution of STE marketing materials to support all distribution campaigns
- Platform Expertise: Leverage a deep understanding of MVPD and Streaming providers’ platforms, market trends, and user interfaces (UI/UX) to align partner capabilities with STE's audience and strategic goals, Lead company on optimizing to rapidly evolving algorithmic placements and UIs and Ensure flows conform to best practices and maximize value of STE placement
- Executive Representation & Relationship Building: Act as the lead voice for Partner Marketing in executive-level partner discussions, building strong relationships with key partners to drive acquisition, product launches, and retail initiatives
- Performance & Investment Optimization: Partner with Analytics, Finance, and Distribution teams to establish measurable KPIs, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and leverage consumer insights to optimize marketing fund investments
- Operational & Financial Management: Manage contractual marketing funds, conduct monthly budget reviews, and ensure all marketing initiatives adhere to legal compliance (e.g., LOAs, vendor contracts, sweepstakes rules)
- Project & Event Oversight: Track and manage the status of all cross-functional projects, seamlessly pivoting when necessary, and oversee affiliate participation in PR and consumer-facing events
- Team Leadership: Build, develop, and lead a high-performing partner marketing organization by establishing clear objectives, coaching talent, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability

### QUALIFICATIONS:

- Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing preferred; Master’s Degree in Business Administration desired.
- Experience: Minimum seven years’ experience as a senior marketing professional, including at least five years of industry experience and four years specifically driving consumer marketing initiatives
- Platform Knowledge: Exceptional understanding of distributor marketing platforms, encompassing multi-platform marketing initiatives with the top 5 MVPDs, VOD, TVE, and OTT products
- Technical Acumen: Strong knowledge of distinct user interfaces (UI) and user experiences (UX) across MVPD, OTT, and Mobile providers with a specific understanding of how recommendation engines and ML models impact placement and impressions / reach
- Communication Skills: Superb interpersonal and presentation skills required to pitch content strategies to partners, articulate vision, and motivate internal teams
- Additional Skills: Public relations and events experience is highly desirable.
- Software Proficiency: Knowledgeable in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Adobe Acrobat; experience with InDesign, Photoshop, Workfront, and SharePoint is preferred

### KEY RELATIONSHIPS:

- SVP, Account Management
- SVP, Distribution
- SVP, Creative and Campaign Management
- VP, Brand and Originals Marketing

### COMPENSATION:

$220,000 - $260,000

# Director of Brand Marketing

Full-time

Club Med

[Miami, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Miami%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3925069878593915091?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9649&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2425725782439319476&crId=US_0US_0)

**About us**

Established in 1950, Club Med is the pioneer of premium all-inclusive holidays. We have been continuously innovating over the last 70 years and now offer close to 80 ski and sun resorts across Europe, Asia, Africa, America, and the Caribbean as well as a ‘Club Med 2’ cruise. Club Med, a company structurally profitable and growing, offers a new way of experiencing holidays in its upscale friendly and multicultural resorts.

Our success comes from the strong commitment to exceed customers’ expectations and deliver an unforgettable experience.

**Role Overview:** The Brand, Content and Earn Media director is the head of Brand Paid media, Content creation & Earn Media (PR, Influence, Partnerships & Social media) for the North American markets. This person will be responsible for overseeing strategic and operational activities related to brand communication, content production, and the management of our local social media platforms for the North American Markets Business Unit. Their main responsibility relies on initiating and challenging relevant plans to support the development of Club Med brand awareness and its superiority in the North American markets. The role involves managing a team of 3 people, coordinating NAM brand teams and managing external agencies (Creative agency, PR & Influence agency and Brand media). The role involves direct management and strategy implementation for the US market, along with coordinating efforts for the markets in Canada and Central America.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. **Strategic Leadership & Innovation:**

- Develop and implement a strategy aligned with brand awareness, consideration, and performance objectives, supporting business goals.
- Lead and coordinate team activities to ensure the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of produced content.
- Maintain regular communication to ensure individual objectives align with the overall strategy.
- Assist the VP Marketing in constructing and coordinating annual marketing and commercial plan for markets and the region.
- Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving creative productivity and operational efficiency.
- Identify and implement new opportunities and trends to enhance brand presence.
- Track and report on campaign performance, using data-driven insights to refine strategies and improve ROI. Share results during our monthly Business Reviews or weekly meetings.

1. **Rollout of our brand campaigns across the US local market**

- Develop and implement comprehensive brand strategies to enhance brand awareness and market presence in the US.
- Lead the planning, execution, and optimization of brand campaigns across various channels, including digital, print, and social media.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and product development, to ensure cohesive brand messaging and alignment with business objectives.
- Analyze market trends, consumer insights, and competitive landscape to inform campaign strategies and identify growth opportunities.
- Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including media partners, and industry organizations.

1. **Operational Management of Brand Communication and Content across North & Central America:**

- Oversee the deployment and animation of our brand platform "Club Med L’Esprit Libre" and our visual identity across our markets.
- Schedule and supervise communication and activation kits for key commercial periods, as well as brand and product initiatives.
- Coordinate marketing projects with various stakeholders to ensure campaign coherence and effectiveness.
- Supervise content production and localization for North America markets, collaborating with internal departments and external agencies.

1. **Operational Management of Social Media:**

- Define editorial strategy and manage Instagram and Facebook accounts for North American markets.
- Analyze campaign performance and recommend strategic adjustments accordingly.
- Serve as the primary contact for social media-related queries within the business unit.
- Collaborate with Paid Media teams on sponsorship strategy.
- Oversee the production of Social-First content.

1. **PR, Influence & partnerships**

- Define and implement PR, influence and partnership strategies aligned with the brand image and objectives for recruiting new clients. Manage the relationship with our agency to enhance our Earn media efficiency.
- **Define and Implement a Partnership Strategy:**
- Define a partnership strategy including image partnerships with iconic brands, experience partnerships, tactical partnerships with local players, and event partnerships.
- Develop the necessary content for partnership activation
- Coordinate and monitor the communication plan with particular attention to the customer journey and commercial communication.
- **Develop and lead an Influence Strategy:**
- Develop an annual influence strategy aligned with business challenges and brand image.
- Build and maintain a network of key influencers and opinion leaders (KOL) to support product launches and brand experiences.
- Create an affiliate program to capitalize on the recommendation power of influencers.
- **Lead our Public Relations in the US market:**
- Develop and execute comprehensive PR strategies to enhance brand visibility and reputation in the US market.
- Identify, engage, and manage relationships with media partners to amplify brand messaging.
- Create and distribute compelling press releases, media kits, and other PR materials with the help of our PR & influence agency to support brand campaigns and initiatives.
- Monitor and analyze media coverage, providing insights and recommendations to improve PR strategies.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, and product development, to ensure cohesive brand messaging and alignment with business objectives.
- Manage crisis communication and reputation management efforts, ensuring timely and effective responses to any issues.

1. **Team Management:**

- Provide weekly support and prioritize topics.
- Create roadmaps.
- Help teams to frame topics and find solutions.
- Ensure talent development and skill enhancement.
- Monitor HR processes.
- Lead team life.
- Manage the budget dedicated to the brand strategy and ensure the profitability of activities.

**Profile:**

- Master's degree in marketing or communication.
- Strong background (5-10 years) in brand management, marketing strategy, and campaign execution
- Experience with an advertiser or communication agency, ideally for a B2C brand with high stakes in reputation and image.
- Significant and successful team management experience.
- Passionate about branding, strong interest in lifestyle & luxury sectors, excellent knowledge of branding strategy and social media.
- Able to have a cross-functional role and collaborate with diverse teams (technical, commercial, HR).

**Skills and Abilities:**

- Strategic & creative vision.
- Synthesizing ability.
- Leadership.
- Dynamism.
- Oral and written communication skills.
- Excellent interpersonal skills.
- Teamwork, co-construction approach.
- Excellent communication and project management skills.
- Positive and open-minded attitude.
- Ability to switch from strategic vision to more operational and detailed vision.
- Initiative, agility, proactivity, multitasking.
- Languages: English, French is a plus

**At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.**

**\| WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Slate sells direct to consumer. Every truck is reserved, designed, purchased and accessorized through channels we own: our website, vehicle configurator, online marketplace and app. That puts growth at the center of how Slate operates.**

**We’re looking for a Head of Growth to own the full customer funnel: from first visit to reservation, from reservation to order and delivery, and from delivery to accessories, wraps and referrals. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you will lead performance marketing, lifecycle and CRM, conversion optimization and marketing analytics. You’ll be accountable for the numbers that matter most as Slate moves into its first customer deliveries and beyond: reservation-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, accessory attach rate and payback.**

**The ideal candidate has built and scaled growth for a direct-to-consumer brand with a considered purchase. You are as comfortable in a media plan as you are in an experiment readout or a funnel query, and you run a team that is fast, frugal and scrappy with every dollar.**

**\| WHAT YOU GET TO DO**

**Growth Strategy & Ownership**

**- Own Slate’s growth strategy and targets across the customer lifecycle: awareness to order, order to delivery, and post-purchase accessories, wraps, service, loyalty, retention and referral.**
**- Build and maintain the growth model and forecast in partnership with Finance; set targets for volume, CAC, conversion and payback, and report against them every week.**
**- Own the paid media and growth budget, moving spend quickly toward what works and away from what doesn’t.**
**- Partner with the Head of Marketing to turn brand and launch plans into measurable demand programs, and represent growth performance in leadership reviews.**


**Acquisition**

**- Lead paid acquisition across search, direct, paid social, online video and CTV, programmatic, affiliate and emerging channels, with in-house and agency partners.**
**- Build launch and regional demand plans that match vehicle availability, SI&OP, delivery geography and Slate’s regional service and wrap installation network.**
**- Work with PR, Influencer and Brand teams to turn earned media, creator content, events and owner community into measurable acquisition.**
**- Design and launch referral and owner-advocacy programs that make Slate owners part of the growth engine.**
**- Partner with Fleet Sales on demand generation for small business and commercial fleet buyers.**


**Lifecycle, CRM & Retention**

**- Own lifecycle marketing across email, SMS, push and in-app, guiding reservation holders through configuration, financing, order and delivery.**
**- Grow post-purchase revenue through accessory, wrap and merchandise programs timed to the ownership journey.**
**- Build audience segmentation and personalized journeys in Salesforce Marketing Cloud.**


**Conversion & Experimentation**

**- Own the experimentation program across the website, configurator, reservation and checkout flows, with clear hypotheses, success metrics and guardrails.**
**- Partner with Digital Experience Design, Product and Engineering to prioritize the funnel improvements with the largest impact on conversion.**
**- Lead the CRO function, including test implementation, tooling and site performance during testing.**
**- Work with eCommerce Merchandising to improve accessory discovery and attach rate across the marketplace.**


**Measurement & Analytics**

**- Evolve a growth measurement stack leadership trusts: attribution, incrementality testing, media mix modeling and funnel dashboards.**
**- Define north-star and channel-level growth metrics, and keep data definitions consistent across Marketing, Sales, Product and Finance.**
**- Use AI and automation to speed up analysis, creative testing, demand projections, forecasting, demand modeling, and campaign operations.**


**Team Building & Leadership**

**- Lead and develop a team spanning performance marketing, lifecycle and CRM, CRO and marketing analytics, hiring to fill capability gaps as Slate scales.**
**- Select and manage agency, ad tech and martech partners with clear scopes, service levels and cost discipline.**
**- Build a team culture of curiosity, speed and direct feedback, grounded in data and customer insight.**


**\| WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM**

**Required**

**- 12+ years of experience in growth, performance or lifecycle marketing, including at least 5 years leading teams, with experience managing managers or leads.**
**- A track record of scaling a direct-to-consumer business with a high-consideration purchase (automotive, EV, consumer hardware, mobility, home or financial products), with results you can quantify.**
**- Hands-on ownership of a full-funnel growth model with budget accountability, including CAC, conversion, LTV and payback.**
**- Deep expertise in paid acquisition across major platforms, along with lifecycle and CRM program design.**
**- Experience running a disciplined experimentation program, with a working command of test design, statistical significance and incrementality.**
**- Strong analytical skills; comfortable working directly in GA4, Looker or similar BI tools, and in SQL or alongside analysts at the query level.**
**- Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or a comparable ESP, CRM and CDP stack.**
**- Clear, structured writing and communication, with the ability to present plans and results to executive leadership.**
**- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.**


**Preferred**

**- Experience leading growth through a major product launch, ideally from pre-order or reservations through first deliveries.**
**- Automotive, EV or direct-to-consumer vehicle experience.**
**- E-commerce or marketplace experience with accessories, add-ons or attach-rate economics.**
**- Experience with small business or B2B demand generation.**
**- Multicultural or Spanish-language marketing experience.**
**- Practical experience applying generative AI to marketing operations, creative testing or analytics.**


**\| LOCATION: This role can sit in any of the following:**

**Troy, MI, Carson, CA, NYC, NY**

**The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors.**

**Annual Base Pay Range: $141,000 to $233,000 USD**

**\| ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

**Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs.**

**At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles.**

# Head of Performance Marketing/ CMO

Marketing & Communications· Full-time

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1554075342210403602?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=354&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3269129173824473022&crId=US_0US_0)

## **Who we are**

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

## **What you will do**

Your mission as Head of Performance Marketing is to get us in front of every person on the planet through scalable performance marketing across all major platforms. You tackle the critical questions: How can our ads dominate TikTok or Snapchat, convert amazingly on Instagram or Facebook, and scale on Google and YouTube? Which formats and targeting drive results, not just clicks? And how can we launch new campaigns in minutes instead of days with the help of AI? Working fully autonomously alongside our founder and the team, your answers to these questions will directly influence our company's success. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

- Developing and maintaining a comprehensive brand, targeting and content strategy optimized for paid marketing

- Setting up and managing campaigns at scale across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google, TikTok, Snapchat and other platforms

- Building and scaling creative production workflows to generate endless content variations with the help of AI

- Optimizing campaign performance through large-scale A/B testing to maximize reach, conversion and revenue

- Staying ahead of trends across social media platforms to lead the curve in our creatives rather than follow it

- Building comprehensive libraries of visual assets, prompts, and workflows for rapid content iteration

- Managing partners in a scalable yet productive manner

- Collaborating with our engineering team to optimize processes, systems and outputs


## **Who you are**

You're a performance marketing powerhouse with extensive experience in paid ads. Your expertise lies in managing hundreds of simultaneous campaigns while maintaining creativity and artistic attention to detail. Typically, your profile will look like this:

- Degree in Marketing, Business, Mathematics, or related quantitative field

- 3+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, preferably in creative industry or entertainment marketing

- Expert-level proficiency across Facebook Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, and Snapchat Ads

- Proven track record managing 100+ simultaneous campaigns and conducting large scale A/B testing on creative

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to read performance data and make rapid campaign optimization decisions

- Self-directed approach thriving in fast-paced, metric-driven environments focused on cultural impact

- You thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

- Colleagues would describe you as hard-working, ambitious and persistent

- You’re obsessed with music, video or social media


## **What makes this exciting**

You are one of the first employees of an ambitious team, changing the world of media and entertainment. Being early means every decision you make shapes our trajectory. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

## **What the process will look like**

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

1. **Online assessment** : Motivational questionnaire and aptitude test - are you made for the job?

2. **Initial interview** : 30-minute introductory call - getting to know you

3. **Take-home case study** : Real-world project - showcase your skills and working style

4. **Case interview** : 90-minute case discussion - present and debate your results with a team member

5. **Founder interview** : 90-minute interview with our CEO - going deep on all topics

6. **Team interview** : Individual or group interview with other team members - depending on position

7. **Offer, contract signing and onboarding**


**Note** : As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work. A day in the life: As the Director of Paid Advertising, you are the leader of your pod, a hybrid of senior individual contributor, people manager, and product leader for your channel of expertise (Creative, Paid Media, Organic Search, or Social) within the division. This is a player-coach role, not a purely operational one. You are arguably the best generalist on your pod, not necessarily the single best specialist at any one skill, but the person who has demonstrated enough judgment, craft, and consistency that the team's trust in you is real and earned, not assumed by title. You protect your pod from unreasonable client pressure while holding the team to a high, non-negotiable bar of excellence. **Who We Are**

Xnurta is an AI-powered ad management platform for brands, sellers and agencies, on Amazon and beyond. We deliver exceptional advertising performance through AI-powered ad technology, advanced analytics and expert services that give advertisers unparalleled advantages. Our technology enables both advertisers and our own experts to create customized advertising programs that consistently increases sales, saves time in campaign creation and optimization, and delivers consistent campaign performance. By providing advertisers with flexibility and transparency in how they want to utilize the best of AI and human intelligence, we empower them to customize the level of automation and granularity of their advertising strategies.

**Our Values**

Our core values are the foundation of our culture and the driving force behind our innovative approach to retail media advertising.

● Humble Excellence: Humility is the cornerstone of excellence. We emphasize respect for clients and stakeholders, aiming to educate, serve and foster strong relationships.

● Always Learning Mindset: Continuous adaptation and a growth mindset are crucial to our team, as there’s always more to learn and new ways to innovate.

● Extreme Accountability: Everyone is expected to take full ownership, ensuring communication of any obstacles while delivering results.

● Diverse Thinking: While expertise in Amazon Ads is valued, we also prioritize diversity in experiences, including backgrounds from brand, agency, tech and other industries.

● Customer Obsession: A relentless commitment to understanding and prioritizing our clients' needs, ensuring exceptional service and value at every touchpoint to drive innovation and foster loyalty.

**Position Overview**

Xnurta is seeking a strategic, data-driven **Senior Director of Growth Marketing** to lead and scale our global demand generation and growth marketing organization. This executive-level leader will own the strategy, execution, and performance of the entire growth engine—from brand awareness and demand generation to pipeline creation and revenue acceleration.

You will develop the long-term growth strategy, build a world-class marketing organization, and partner closely with Sales, Product, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and executive leadership to achieve aggressive revenue goals.

This role requires a proven marketing executive who has successfully built scalable B2B SaaS growth engines, understands modern AI-powered marketing, and thrives in high-growth startup environments. While highly strategic, you are also comfortable diving into execution when needed and leading by example.

● Develop annual and quarterly growth plans, budgets, forecasting models, and executive reporting.

● Establish marketing KPIs that directly connect marketing performance to pipeline, revenue, CAC, LTV, and customer growth.

● Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on market opportunities, competitive positioning, and growth initiatives.

### Organizational Leadership

● Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing marketing organization.

● Develop leaders within Growth, Content, Digital Marketing, Events, and Demand Generation.

● Establish performance expectations, career development, and operational excellence across the team.

● Manage external agencies, consultants, technology partners, and strategic vendors.

### Revenue & Demand Generation

● Own pipeline generation targets and marketing's contribution to company revenue.

● Partner closely with Sales and Revenue Operations to optimize funnel performance.

● Lead enterprise ABM initiatives and integrated multi-channel campaigns.

● Continuously improve lead quality, conversion rates, attribution, and customer acquisition efficiency.

### Digital Experience & Growth Optimization

● Own the growth strategy for Xnurta.com and all digital acquisition channels.

● Drive website optimization, conversion rate optimization (CRO), experimentation, and customer journey improvements.

● Build scalable lifecycle marketing programs to improve customer acquisition and expansion.

### Brand, Content & Market Leadership

● Establish Xnurta as a thought leader within retail media and AI-powered advertising.

● Oversee content strategy, executive thought leadership, PR, analyst relations, sponsorships, and organic growth initiatives.

● Partner with Product Marketing to strengthen messaging, positioning, and go-to-market execution.

### Analytics & Business Performance

● Build executive dashboards that connect marketing investments to revenue outcomes.

● Own marketing forecasting, budget management, and ROI analysis.

● Present strategic recommendations and business performance updates to executive leadership.

● Champion data-driven experimentation and continuous optimization across the marketing organization.

**What You’ll Bring**

● 10+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including significant leadership in demand generation or growth marketing.

● 5+ years leading and developing high-performing marketing teams.

● Proven success owning multi-million-dollar pipeline generation and revenue targets.

● Experience building marketing organizations in high-growth SaaS companies.

● Deep expertise in demand generation, ABM, digital marketing, lifecycle marketing, paid media, SEO, content strategy, and conversion optimization.

● Strong understanding of revenue operations, attribution, forecasting, and marketing analytics.

● Experience partnering directly with executive leadership on company strategy.

● Expertise with HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, marketing automation platforms, and modern AI-powered marketing tools.

● Strong financial acumen with experience managing significant marketing budgets.

● Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.

● Startup mindset with the ability to balance strategic leadership and operational execution.

**What We Offer**

● Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

● Unlimited PTO

● A supportive and inclusive culture. Direct influence on product direction, brand positioning, and market leaders

# Director of Growth Marketing

Location:USCompany:Stagwell Global LLC

## Description:

**Title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager**

**Location:** _Remote, Anywhere in the United States or Canada_

**Who We Are**

Left Field Labs is the creative technology agency that builds what’s next. We partner with the world’s most ambitious brands to transform breakthrough technology into extraordinary human experiences. Since 2008, we’ve delivered end-to-end digital transformation services—from strategy to platform development to immersive experiences—for the biggest companies in the world, including Google, Amazon, and Meta.

**What We Do**

- **Digital Experience**: We architect seamless digital ecosystems that simplify complexity and drive measurable impact. Whether launching new platforms or evolving legacy systems, we strike the perfect balance between innovation and pragmatism
- **Product Innovation:** We build scalable platforms and products in lockstep with organizations, identifying and seizing new technology opportunities.
- **Immersive:** We create immersive, cross-media experiences that move beyond omnichannel thinking, blending digital, social, AI, and physical spaces to engage and delight.
- **Applied AI**: We transform AI from a tech tool to the infrastructure for business evolution—enhancing decision-making, unlocking new efficiencies, and expanding human capacity Our AI solutions power predictive intelligence, sharper decision-making, and game-changing innovation.

**Who You Are**

We are partnering with illumend to look for a strategic, hands-on marketing leader to drive demand generation and accelerate business growth. In this role, you'll lead a small, agile marketing team while staying actively involved in execution—leveraging AI, data, and experimentation to build pipeline and optimize performance. You'll oversee both marketing and product marketing, partnering closely with Sales, RevOps, and executive leadership to shape go-to-market strategy and deliver measurable results.

**What You Will Do**

- Own demand generation strategy to drive qualified pipeline and customer acquisition.
- Lead marketing and product marketing initiatives across digital channels.
- Leverage AI to improve marketing execution, decision-making, and operational efficiency.
- Use data and performance insights to inform strategy and optimize results.
- Test, measure, and scale high-impact marketing initiatives.
- Partner cross-functionally with Sales, RevOps, Product, and executive leadership.
- Lead and support a team through strategic initiatives, execution, and continuous improvement.
- Develop creative, customer-centric messaging that makes complex AI products approachable and compelling.

**What You Will Need to be Successful**

- 6-8 years of experience in a high-growth SaaS, AI, or technology company.

- Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution.
- Proven success leading demand generation and consistently driving measurable pipeline growth.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing strategy and performance marketing.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools to increase marketing productivity, creativity, and operational efficiency.
- Strong analytical mindset with experience using marketing data to guide strategic decisions.
- Experience leading small, cross-functional marketing teams and external agency or contractor relationships.
- Comfortable working in fast-paced startup or scaling environments where priorities evolve quickly.
- Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

**Bonus Points**

- Experience marketing AI or emerging technology products.
- B2C marketing experience or a consumer-first approach to storytelling.
- Marketing operations experience, including attribution, reporting, and campaign measurement.
- Experience with HubSpot, Gong, Claude, Supermetrics, Webflow, or similar modern marketing technology platforms.
- Experience building brands that simplify complex technical products through compelling messaging.


**Compensation**

The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $175,000 and applies only to jobs performed in Culver City, California. This range represents the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. Please note that we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

# Senior Director, Paid Media

Location:USCompany:Kaseya

## Description:

**About Kaseya**

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

**Position Summary**

Kaseya is seeking a **Senior Director, Paid Media** to own the strategy, execution, and performance of the company's global paid media investment. This leader will manage a significant multi-channel budget spanning paid search, paid social, programmatic display, video, content syndication, and emerging channels — with full accountability for pipeline contribution, efficiency, and return on spend.

Reporting to the VP, Digital Marketing, the Senior Director will build much of this function from the ground up — designing the processes, playbooks, measurement frameworks, and channel strategies that will scale with the business, not just inheriting and managing them. This is a builder's role for a leader who likes to get their hands dirty: someone as comfortable in the ad platforms, the data, and the campaign builds as they are in the boardroom presenting results. The right candidate combines deep channel expertise with rigorous financial discipline, treats paid media as a P&L rather than a cost center, and leads their team from the front.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Own the global paid media strategy and budget across paid search (Google, Bing), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube), programmatic display, video, content syndication, review sites, and emerging channels
- Build the operational foundation of the paid media function — processes, playbooks, campaign workflows, QA standards, and reporting cadences — designing for scale rather than inheriting legacy structure
- Stay hands-on in the work: in-platform strategy and optimization, campaign architecture, audience and bidding strategy, and budget pacing alongside the team
- Set channel-level targets for pipeline, CAC, ROAS, and efficiency; forecast, allocate, and reallocate spend based on performance data
- Build, lead, and develop a team of paid media managers and channel specialists; manage agency and vendor relationships where leveraged, including performance accountability and contract negotiation
- Own the measurement and attribution framework for paid media in partnership with marketing operations and analytics — including incrementality testing, media mix modeling, and full-funnel reporting from impression to closed-won revenue
- Partner with demand generation on integrated campaign strategy, ensuring paid media amplifies the right offers, segments, and buyer journeys
- Collaborate with product marketing and brand teams to ensure ad creative, messaging, and landing experiences convert — and run a disciplined testing program across creative, audience, and bidding strategies
- Drive continuous optimization of the paid funnel in partnership with web and conversion rate optimization teams
- Stay ahead of platform changes, privacy and signal-loss shifts, and emerging paid channels; pilot new opportunities with clear success criteria
- Present performance, forecasts, and investment recommendations to executive leadership on a regular cadence

**Required Qualifications**

- 10+ years of digital marketing experience with deep specialization in paid media, including 5+ years leading paid media teams and owning eight-figure or high seven-figure annual budgets
- Proven track record driving pipeline and revenue through paid channels in B2B software or technology, with fluency in the metrics that matter: CAC, ROAS, pipeline contribution, LTV, and payback
- Expert-level command of the major paid platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic DSPs) and the martech stack surrounding them
- Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including hands-on experience with attribution models, incrementality testing, and marketing analytics tools
- A builder's track record: you've stood up or significantly rebuilt a paid media function, program, or process infrastructure — not just optimized one you inherited
- Genuinely hands-on operator at the senior level — still fluent and current in-platform, willing to build campaigns, dig into the data, and prototype processes yourself before delegating them
- Demonstrated success building and developing high-performing in-house teams and managing agency relationships with clear accountability
- Executive communication skills — able to translate channel performance into business narrative for C-level audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience in high-velocity, high-volume B2B demand generation environments (SMB or mid-market motion with short sales cycles)
- Familiarity with the IT management, security, or infrastructure software landscape, or experience marketing to IT buyers
- Experience with media mix modeling and navigating privacy-driven measurement change (signal loss, cookie deprecation)
- Experience at a company that scaled through acquisition, consolidating paid programs across multiple brands or business units
- Familiarity with ABM platforms and paid ABM execution (6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks)

**Additional information**

# Senior Vice President, Paid Media Marketing

Location:New YorkCompany:BNY Mellon

## Description:

**Description**

SVP, Paid Media Marketing

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #LifeAtBNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of SVP, Paid Media Marketing to join our Marketing team. This role is located in New York City.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

- Define and lead BNY’s global paid media strategy in alignment with enterprise brand, business, and client growth priorities.

- Build paid media programs designed primarily for B2B audiences, with a strong focus on precision targeting, niche segments, and high-value decision-makers rather than broad consumer scale.

- Manage paid media investment with a disciplined approach, optimizing relatively modest budgets for maximum efficiency, effectiveness, and measurable business impact.

- Prioritize quality of audience reach over volume, using data, account-based marketing principles, and advanced segmentation to connect with institutional, intermediary, and specialized client audiences.

- Partner closely with brand, content, product marketing, analytics, digital, regional marketing, and business stakeholders to ensure paid media supports integrated campaign objectives and commercial priorities.

- Establish a rigorous measurement framework that links media performance to brand outcomes, engagement, lead quality, pipeline influence, and other business-relevant KPIs.

- Evaluate and select the right channel mix across search, social, programmatic, direct buys, and emerging platforms based on audience behavior, business value, and return on investment.

- Lead agency and external partner relationships, setting clear expectations on strategy, execution, testing, reporting, governance, and cost management.

- Ensure all paid media activity complies with legal, regulatory, risk, privacy, and brand standards across markets, while continuously improving operating models, testing approaches, and campaign performance.

- Collaborate across organic social and SEO/GEO functions, all reporting to the Director of Brand Visibility Channels. Role in an individual contributor who will partner closely with an associate team member.


To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

- Bachelor’s degree

- 8-10 years of paid media experience. Experience in both agency and corporate settings required. Experience leading paid media strategy for complex global organizations, ideally within financial services, professional services, or other highly regulated B2B environments.

- Deep expertise in B2B paid media, including audience-first planning, account-based approaches, long-consideration buying journeys, and optimization toward business outcomes rather than consumer-scale metrics.

- Demonstrated ability to market effectively to niche and hard-to-reach audiences, including senior business decision-makers, institutional buyers, ultra high net worth individuals, and specialized segments.

- Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with a track record of managing smaller budgets strategically and proving impact through disciplined measurement and optimization.

- Advanced knowledge of paid search, paid social, programmatic, publisher partnerships, audience targeting, attribution, testing, and performance reporting.

- Experience operating successfully in regulated environments with strong understanding of governance, compliance, privacy, approval processes, and reputational risk considerations.

- Proven ability to influence, including managing agencies, influencing senior stakeholders, and working across global, regional, and cross-functional teams.

- Ability to translate complex business objectives into clear media strategies, execution plans, and actionable insights for both marketing and executive audiences.

- Strong communication, judgment, and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance brand building, business performance, and operational discipline.

Reports to Managing Director

New York, NY · Full time · Hybrid

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Manhattan Strategies is seeking an Associate Director, Paid Media & Analytics to lead and grow two of our most essential practices. We've been recognized by ADWEEK among the fastest-growing agencies and by Inc Magazine as one of the fastest-growing companies in America. We've won dozens of awards across design, branding, web development and video production. The team is sharp, collaborative and genuinely passionate about making things that look and work great.

**THE ROLE**

This is a full-time hybrid role based in New York, NY. The Associate Director, Paid Media & Analytics will play a key role in leading the strategy and growth of Manhattan Strategies' Paid Media and Analytics practices, from campaign architecture through measurement and reporting. Responsibilities include setting practice-wide standards, managing senior client relationships, and building the frameworks that connect performance data to business outcomes. **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

- **Campaign Management:** Lead the strategy, planning, and oversight of paid media campaigns across platforms (Meta, TikTok, X, Reddit, Google, programmatic, and others), ensuring strong performance against KPIs.
- **Analytics & Measurement:** Develop and implement analytics frameworks, attribution models, and reporting infrastructure that connect activity to business outcomes for clients.
- **Team Leadership:** Manage, mentor, and develop a team of direct reports, providing performance feedback, growth opportunities, and clear expectations.
- **Business Development:** Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts, support new business efforts, and contribute to the strategic direction of both practices.

**WHO YOU ARE**

This opportunity is ideal for you if you:

- Are equally fluent in media buying platforms, BI/analytics tools, and senior client conversations
- Think in systems, you connect campaign mechanics to measurement, and measurement to business impact
- Have managed people before and genuinely enjoy developing talent and building team culture
- Operate with high ownership, you set the bar, hold it, and pull others up to it
- Thrive in a fast-paced, client-driven environment where your work is visible, timely, and directly tied to results
- Communicate clearly and persuasively with senior stakeholders, both internal and client-facing
- Are curious and experimental, you test, learn, and bring new ideas to platforms, measurement approaches, and team workflows
- Are comfortable managing multiple clients, platforms, and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball

**YOUR EXPERIENCE**

- 7+ years of experience in paid media, analytics, performance marketing, or related disciplines; agency experience strongly preferred
- Demonstrated expertise across major paid media platforms (Meta, TikTok, X, Google, programmatic, etc.) and analytics tools (GA4, Looker, Tableau, or equivalents)

- Experience managing and developing direct reports
- Strong analytical and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders
- Familiarity with attribution methodologies, A/B testing frameworks, and full-funnel measurement
- Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

- Familiarity with marketing automation/CRM platforms and campaign tracking tools
- A track record of managing vendor and agency relationships, including budget negotiation

American Home Design has proudly served Tennessee for nearly 50 years, offering bath remodeling, windows and doors, outdoor living products, and water treatment systems. # Associate Director, Paid Media

Location:San Diego, CACompany:KaramMD Skin

## Description:

**Associate Director, Paid Media & Performance Creative**

**About KaramMD Skin**

KaramMD Skin is a prestige anti-aging skincare brand founded by facial plastic surgeon Dr. Amir Karam. Built on clinical science, ingredient integrity, and a distinct point of view on skin aging, our mission is simple: help people look as young as they feel.

We’re growing quickly and looking for a creative performance marketer who can help build a paid acquisition engine that is as distinctive and disciplined as the brand itself. Someone who combines bold creative instincts with analytical rigor—and understands that great performance creative should strengthen the brand, not dilute it.

**About the role**

We’re looking for someone who lives at the intersection of **paid media, performance creative, and growth**.

You’ll own how we translate the KaramMD story, product science, founder authority, customer insights, and visible results into paid creative that performs. You’ll develop the paid media strategy, generate and test creative concepts, brief creators, manage our paid media agency, and use performance data to determine what we make and fund next.

You should be equally comfortable developing a great hook and digging into CAC, LTV, retention, and attribution.

You’ll report to our VP of Growth and work closely with our founder, Finance, and our creative, social, analytics, and agency partners.

**What you’ll do**

**Build winning paid creative**

- Own paid creative strategy across Meta, Google/YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels.
- Generate a constant pipeline of concepts, hooks, messages, formats, and creator ideas grounded in our brand story, approved messaging, product truths, and customer insights.
- Translate complex science, product differentiation, clinical evidence, and customer outcomes into compelling concepts that drive action without sacrificing credibility.
- Concept and art-direct static, video, UGC, creator, and other performance assets with designers and editors.
- Translate media performance into clear creative briefs: what to test, why we’re testing it, and what we learned.
- Identify creative fatigue, audience signals, and emerging opportunities and turn those insights into the next generation of creative.
- Ensure the story holds from ad to landing page to checkout.
- Protect KaramMD’s brand identity. We are not interested in copying what every other DTC skincare brand is doing simply because it is currently performing.

**Develop creator content that performs**

- Write sharp creator briefs with clear hooks, proof points, must-says and must-avoids while leaving room for an authentic creator voice.
- Help identify and vet creators, UGC talent, and expert voices who fit a prestige, science-first brand.
- Give direct creative feedback and push for alternate hooks, iterations, or reshoots when needed.
- Partner with our internal team and agencies to build an always-on pipeline of creator content for paid acquisition.
- Maintain rigorous standards around usage rights, FTC requirements, and claims accuracy.

**Test, learn, and optimize**

- Build a structured testing roadmap across concepts, messages, hooks, creators, formats, audiences, offers, and landing pages.
- Establish a clear hypothesis and success metric for every meaningful test.
- Break down performance by creative concept, hook, message, creator, format, and placement—not simply by campaign.
- Identify winners quickly, scale what works, and document learnings so every dollar we spend teaches us something.
- Build a performance-creative playbook that gets smarter over time.

**Own paid media performance**

- Own the paid media plan, execution, and performance within our overall growth strategy and approved budget.
- Manage our paid media agency day to day, set priorities, challenge assumptions, and hold partners accountable for results.
- Recommend how spend should be allocated and reallocated across channels based on performance and business objectives.
- Measure performance through CAC, LTV, retention, new-customer acquisition, subscription growth, profitability, attribution, and incrementality—not ROAS alone.
- Use platform lift studies, holdouts, attribution tools, and other methods to understand what is actually driving incremental growth.
- Present weekly and monthly performance with a clear point of view on what we should make, test, scale, reduce, or stop.

**Partner across the business**

- Work with the VP of Growth and Finance to establish forecasts, overall marketing budgets, and financial guardrails around CAC, LTV, retention, and profitability.
- Partner with social, creative, site, and email/SMS so winning ideas strengthen the entire customer experience.
- Work closely with our founder on medical, scientific, and expert-led content.
- Support product launches, promotions, and major brand initiatives.

**You’ll love this job if**

- You’re highly creative. You have more ideas than time to make them.
- You understand that **performance and brand are not competing objectives**.
- You can turn complicated science into simple, compelling creative without exaggerating it.
- You’re rigorous. You test with discipline and don’t fall in love with your own ideas.
- You’re analytical. You’re as comfortable discussing creative hooks as CAC, LTV, retention, and incrementality.
- You’re a builder. You like creating systems, not simply operating someone else’s playbook.
- You understand the prestige skincare customer and know that trust has to be earned through credibility and results—not hype.

**Qualifications**

- 8–10+ years in performance, growth, or paid media at a DTC/eCommerce consumer brand. Meaningful experience in beauty, skincare, wellness, or another science-backed consumer category is required.
- Demonstrated experience managing and scaling meaningful paid-media budgets across Meta, Google/YouTube, TikTok, or comparable channels.
- A portfolio of paid creative concepts and campaigns you personally helped develop, with measurable results.
- Proven ability to ideate, brief, and art-direct high-performing creative, including UGC and creator content.
- Experience translating complex or science-backed concepts into compelling consumer communication.
- Experience building structured creative and media testing programs with clear hypotheses and documented learnings.
- Strong understanding of CAC, LTV, retention, subscription economics, attribution, incrementality, and profitability.
- Fluency in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, and attribution/creative analytics tools.
- Strong Excel/Sheets skills.
- Clear, confident communicator who can present results and recommendations to a founder and leadership team.
- Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment and is equally comfortable setting strategy and rolling up their sleeves.

**Nice to have**

- Experience in prestige or clinical skincare, particularly marketing to women 40+.
- Experience with subscription businesses where retention matters as much as acquisition.
- Relationships with dermatologists, aestheticians, medical experts, or skin-science creators.
- Experience with TikTok Shop, Amazon, retail, or omnichannel growth.
- Hands-on familiarity with Figma, Canva, CapCut, Premiere, Motion, Foreplay, ShopMy, LTK, Cohley, or similar tools.

**Compensation**

Base salary range: $130–$160k, plus bonus eligibility and benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, skills, and qualifications.

At HV Talent Group, we help talented professionals connect with top employers nationwide. As a trusted recruiting partner to industry-leading companies, we focus on direct-hire opportunities that align with candidates’ career goals, values, and long-term growth.

- Social media
- Email marketing
- Content development
- Lead-generation campaigns
- Landing pages and conversion optimization
- Digital analytics and reporting
- Marketing automation
- External marketing vendor/agency relationships

- Develop and execute the overall digital marketing strategy.

- Develop and manage PPC and Google Ads campaigns.
- Plan and execute email marketing campaigns.
- Manage social media presence and digital content strategy.
- Develop blogs, videos, case studies, white papers, and customer success content.
- Execute industry-focused campaigns across Manufacturing, Healthcare, Education, Hospitality, Property Management, Commercial Real Estate, and Industrial markets.
- Partner with Marketing Operations to leverage Salesforce CRM and marketing automation.
- Track campaign performance, website analytics, lead quality, conversion rates, and ROI.

- 5+ years of B2B digital marketing experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field, **or BS in Business Admin** 7–10 years of strong hands-on experience.
- Strong B2B marketing background; primarily consumer marketing experience is not preferred.
- Demonstrated ownership of digital marketing strategy and execution.
- Experience managing websites and analyzing website traffic and performance.
- Hands-on experience with social media and email campaigns.
- Experience developing content and integrated marketing campaigns.
- Proven lead-generation experience.
- Experience with paid advertising, particularly Google Ads.
- Strong SEO knowledge, including experience managing outside SEO partners.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to determine what is and isn't working.
- Experience managing external marketing vendors/agencies.
- Strong communication, organization, and project management skills.

## Preferred Technology Experience

Experience with the following is specifically valuable:

- Salesforce CRM
- Salesforce Campaigns and reporting
- Salesforce Account Engagement
- HubSpot
- Constant Contact
- Apollo
- Google Ads
- Google Analytics 4
- LinkedIn Campaign Manager
- WordPress
- Power BI

## Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

- Marketing-generated pipeline
- Qualified leads
- Website conversion rate
- Organic traffic growth
- Campaign ROI
- Lead conversion
- Marketing contribution to revenue

The ideal candidate is someone who has personally owned digital marketing execution in a B2B environment. We are looking for a true subject matter expert who can establish the digital marketing function and strategy not someone whose background is primarily coordinating vendors or supporting consumer/social-media marketing.

# Global Marketing Director - Luxury RTW Brand

Location:USCompany:Mode Executive

## Description:

Mode Executive is partnering with an internationally recognised luxury Ready-to-Wear fashion house to appoint an exceptional Global Marketing Director. This is a key executive appointment for a commercially minded marketing leader with a strong luxury background, capable of shaping global brand strategy while driving commercial performance and customer engagement across international markets.

Based in New York, this position reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer and will work closely with senior leadership across Creative, Product, Commercial, Retail, Wholesale and E-commerce. The successful candidate will lead the global marketing function, overseeing brand communications, integrated campaigns, digital marketing, PR, partnerships and customer engagement to strengthen the brand's international presence and support its continued growth.

**The Role**

- Develop and deliver a global marketing strategy aligned with the company's commercial objectives and long-term brand vision.
- Lead the creation and execution of integrated seasonal campaigns, product launches, fashion week initiatives and brand activations across all consumer touchpoints.
- Drive consistent global brand positioning while ensuring relevance across key international markets.
- Oversee all marketing channels including digital, social media, CRM, content, paid media, events and experiential marketing.
- Partner closely with Creative and Product teams to ensure marketing initiatives accurately reflect the brand's identity, collections and storytelling.
- Lead global PR and communications strategies, managing agency relationships and cultivating strong networks across media, industry, cultural partners, influencers and VIPs.
- Identify and develop strategic partnerships and collaborations that enhance brand awareness and cultural relevance.
- Work alongside E-commerce teams to improve customer acquisition, retention, conversion and lifetime value through data-driven marketing initiatives.
- Support Retail and Wholesale teams with marketing programmes, client engagement strategies, store activations and international market launches.
- Manage global marketing budgets, agency partnerships and campaign performance, ensuring measurable return on investment.
- Build, mentor and develop a high-performing international marketing team while fostering collaboration across the wider business.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activity and evolving consumer behaviour to identify opportunities for innovation and growth.
- Establish clear performance metrics and regularly report on campaign effectiveness and commercial impact to the executive leadership team.

**Requirements**

- Significant senior marketing leadership experience within the luxury fashion industry, ideally within Ready-to-Wear.
- Demonstrated success developing and executing international marketing strategies for a global luxury brand.
- Strong understanding of luxury brand positioning, consumer behaviour and omnichannel marketing.
- Proven experience leading integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
- Extensive knowledge of PR, communications, influencer marketing, brand partnerships and cultural engagement.
- Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance long-term brand equity and short-term business objectives.
- Experience working collaboratively with executive leadership and creative teams in a fast-paced luxury environment.
- Excellent leadership skills with experience building and managing high-performing marketing teams.
- Strong analytical capabilities with experience using customer insights and performance data to inform strategic decision-making.
- Exceptional communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
- A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach with the ability to thrive in a dynamic, founder-led or high-growth environment.
- Passion for luxury fashion, craftsmanship and creating meaningful consumer experiences.
